cross_references.description_zh: 陈伯达与墨子同为批判方法论的代表人物，陈伯达重政治实践，墨子重理论建设。
cross_references.description_en: Chen Boda and Mozi were both representatives of critical methodology; Chen focused more on political practice, while Mozi focused more on theoretical construction.

cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲重'天下为主君为客'的制度批判，陈伯达重'阶级斗争为纲'的政治批判；黄宗羲的理论更具建设性，陈伯达的理论更具破坏性。
cross_references.description_en: Huang Zongxi emphasized institutional critique of 'Tianxia as master, ruler as guest', while Chen Boda emphasized political critique of 'class struggle as the key link'; Huang's theory was more constructive, Chen's more destructive.

cross_references.description_zh: 陈伯达作为毛泽东的政治秘书，是其理论阐述的重要执行者。但他因政治投机和权力欲望，最终背叛了毛泽东的信任。
cross_references.description_en: As Mao Zedong political secretary, Chen was an important executor of his theoretical elaboration. However, his political opportunism and power hunger ultimately led him to betray Mao trust.

H-DYC-001.school: 妇女解放理论/统一战线实践
representative_works: 《关于《蓝滩中一点淡漠》的批判》（抗日战争时期）
《在党的领导下，团结和发挥广大妇女群众的力量》（1956年八大报告）
H-DYC-001.historical_significance: 邓颖超（1904-1992，原名邓文诒，1992年7月11日逝世，享年88岁），伟大的无产阶级革命家、政治家，中国妇女运动的先驱和杰出领导人。从五四运动时期的天津女界爱国同志会创始人之一，到共产党早期妇女部负责人；从长征中的革命战士、抗日战争时期统一战线工作领导者，到建国后全国妇联第一任副主席、第五届全国人大常务委员会副委员长、全国政协主席。她是中共八大老干部中唯一的女性，在长达七十余年的革命生涯中，58年领导和关注中国妇女解放运动。
core_thoughts: 妇女解放理论
统一战线法
社会解放优先论
劳动参与法
立法保障思维
H-DYC-001.famous_quote: 个人名利淡如水，党的事业重如山
H-DYC-001.influence: 邓颖超的妇女解放思想为中国社会主义妇女运动奠定了理论基础，她参与制定的《婚姻法》和土地法成为新中国妇女解放的法律基石。

cross_references.description_zh: 邓颖超与毛泽东在革命实践中相互配合，毛泽东重理论，邓颖超重实践。
cross_references.description_en: Deng Yingchao and Mao Zedong complemented each other in revolutionary practice: Mao focused on theory, Deng focused on practical work.

cross_references.description_zh: 邓颖超以妇女解放为核心，重视制度建设；陈伯达重理论批判，最终反成革命。
cross_references.description_en: Deng Yingchao focused on women's liberation and institutional building, while Chen Boda focused on theoretical critique.

cross_references.description_zh: 邓颖超与万里同为改革开放时期的重要领导人，分工不同。
cross_references.description_en: Deng Yingchao led women's movement and united front work, while Wan Li focused on economic reform.

C-DYC-001_001.title_zh: 妇女解放经济分析——《经济压迫下的少女》的批判
C-DYC-001_001.description_zh: 邓颖超1923年在《经济压迫下的少女》中，运用马克思主义经济学原理，指出私有制是妇女受压制的根源。

C-DYC-001_002.title_zh: 社会解放优先综合——抗日战争时的妇女运动
C-DYC-001_002.description_zh: 邓颖超在《关于《蓝滩中一点淡漠》的批判》中，主张抗敌、解除封建压迫是妇女解放的前提。

C-DYC-001_003.title_zh: 统一战线协调——解放战争时的统一战线
C-DYC-001_003.description_zh: 邓颖超以中共方协代表身份，在重庆从事抗日民族统一战线工作。

C-DYC-001_004.title_zh: 劳动参与社会评价——八大妇女工作报告
C-DYC-001_004.description_zh: 邓颖超1956年在八大上作报告，明确提出'广泛动员妇女参加生产劳动，是争取妇女彻底解放的关键'。

C-DYC-001_005.title_zh: 立法保障实践——第一部《婚姻法》起草
C-DYC-001_005.description_zh: 邓颖超主持起草了中华人民共和国第一部《婚姻法》，坚持写入'一方坚迷离婚可以离婚'的条款。

C-DYC-001_006.title_zh: 婚姻自由倡导——苏维奥布区农妇工工作（1930）
C-DYC-001_006.description_zh: 邓颖超在《苏维奥布区农妇工工作》中明确规定'经双方同意而离婚，一方不同意时提交苏维奥政府解决'。

C-DYC-001_007.title_zh: 严格自律规范——'个人名利淡如水'的道路
C-DYC-001_007.description_zh: 邓颖超'个人名利淡如水，党的事业重如山'的人生品质，她严于律己，以身作则。

C-DYC-001_008.title_zh: 多层次协调管理——中央纪委第二书记
C-DYC-001_008.description_zh: 邓颖超1978年出任新设立的中央纪律检查委员会第二书记，同时被增选为中央政治局委员。

C-DYC-001_009.title_zh: 对台独立民主协调——对台工作思路
C-DYC-001_009.description_zh: 邓颖超1981年任中央对台工作领导小组组长，推动对台工作的实施。

C-DYC-010.title_zh: 妇女运动组织——天津女界爱国同志会（1919）
C-DYC-010.description_zh: 邓颖超1919年五四运动时，与郑立若、张若明等人组织'天津女界爱国同志会'。

C-DYC-001E_001.title_en: Women's Liberation Economic Analysis — Critique in 'Young Girls Under Economic Oppression'
C-DYC-001E_001.description_en: In 1923's 'Young Girls Under Economic Oppression,' Deng applied Marxist economic principles, identifying private ownership as the root of women's oppression.

C-DYC-001E_002.title_en: Social Liberation Priority — Women's Movement During Anti-Japanese War
C-DYC-001E_002.description_en: Deng criticized the view of 'women returning home' in her work, advocating that anti-fascism and removing feudal oppression are prerequisites for women's liberation.

C-DYC-001E_003.title_en: United Front Coordination — Revolutionary War United Front Work
C-DYC-001E_003.description_en: As the CCP representative in united front work, Deng worked on anti-fascist national united front.

C-DYC-001E_004.title_en: Labor Participation Evaluation — Women's Work Report at the Eighth Congress
C-DYC-001E_004.description_en: At the 1956 Eighth Congress, Deng stated: 'Extensively mobilizing women to participate in productive labor is the key to achieving thorough women's liberation.'

C-DYC-001E_005.title_en: Legislative Protection Practice — Drafting the First Marriage Law
C-DYC-001E_005.description_en: Deng presided over drafting China's first Marriage Law, insisting on including divorce freedom clauses.

C-DYC-001E_006.title_en: Marriage Freedom Advocacy — Soviet Marriage Regulations (1930)
C-DYC-001E_006.description_en: In her 1930 'Women's Work in Soviet Areas,' Deng stipulated: 'Divorce with mutual consent; if one party disagrees, submit to the Soviet government for resolution.'

C-DYC-001E_007.title_en: Strict Self-Discipline — The Path of 'Personal Fame is Like Light Water'
C-DYC-001E_007.description_en: Deng's life quality of 'personal fame is like light water, party affairs weigh heavy as mountains' — strict self-discipline and leading by example.

C-DYC-001E_008.title_en: Multi-level Coordination Management — Second Secretary of CCDI
C-DYC-001E_008.description_en: Deng served as Second Secretary of the newly established Central Commission for Discipline Inspection in 1978.

C-DYC-001E_009.title_en: Cross-Strait Democratic Coordination — Taiwan Work Direction
C-DYC-001E_009.description_en: Deng served as head of the Central Taiwan Work Leading Group starting 1981, proposing 'democratic judgment and economic development'.

C-DYC-010E.title_en: Women's Movement Organization — Tianjin Women's Patriotic Association
C-DYC-010E.description_en: During the May Fourth Movement (1919), Deng organized the Tianjin Women's Patriotic Association.

meta.methodology: 历史文献分析法、理论解析法、案例验证法
meta.validation: 与中国妇女运动史交叉验证，对照《邓颖超文集》

H-FXT-001.school: 中国社会学/人类学/差序格局理论
H-FXT-001.historical_significance: 费孝通（1910-2005），中国社会学家、人类学家，中国社会学和人类学的奠基人之一。他通过深入的农村田野调查，提出了'差序格局'与'中华民族多元一体格局'两大核心理论，构建了中国社会学的本土化理论框架。其代表作《乡土中国》和《江村经济》向世界输出了中国社会结构分析范式，将西方社会学理论与中国传统社会现实相结合，开创了中国社会学本土化的先河。
core_thoughts: 差序格局理论
中华民族多元一体格局
乡土中国分析
实地调查研究法
文化自觉理论
H-FXT-001.famous_quote: 各美其美，美人之美，美美与共，天下大同
H-FXT-001.influence: 费孝通的社会学理论为中国农村改革、民族区域发展和文化政策制定提供了重要的理论基础。他的差序格局理论成为理解中国传统社会结构的核心分析工具，多元一体格局理论为多民族国家的认同建设提供了框架。

cross_references.description_zh: 费孝通的实地调查方法与黄宗智的'过密化'理论形成互补：前者从社会结构角度分析乡村，后者从经济生产角度揭示内卷化问题。两者共同构成了理解中国农村问题的双重框架。

《妇女要翻身，必须自己站起来》
H-KKQ-001.historical_significance: 康克清（1911-1992），江西万安人，朱德同志夫人。中国共产党的优秀党员，久经考验的无产阶级革命家，中国妇女解放运动的卓越领导人，新中国妇女儿童事业的开拓者。
core_thoughts: 群众路线法——深入基层发动和组织广大妇女群众
组织建设法——建立各类群众组织网络实现广泛动员
妇女解放法——主张妇女解放必须与阶级解放相结合
儿童保育法——将儿童保育视为培养革命接班人的事业
实事求是法——坚持真理、在重大政治是非面前保持清醒
H-KKQ-001.famous_quote: 妇女要翻身，必须自己站起来
H-KKQ-001.influence: 康克清的思想方法体系围绕妇女解放和儿童保育展开，具有鲜明的实践性、制度性和人民性。

cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲强调'天下为主君为客'的民主思想，康克清强调妇女解放的制度性变革；黄宗羲的理论更具宏观哲学高度，康克清的实践更具基层操作性。
cross_references.description_en: Huang Zongxi emphasized the democratic thought of 'Tianxia as master, ruler as guest', while Kang Keqing emphasized institutional transformation for women's liberation; Huang's theory has greater macro-philosophical height, while Kang's practice is more grassroots-operational.

cross_references.description_zh: 康克清与邓颖超同为新中国妇女解放运动的核心领导人，都担任全国妇联主席。康克清更侧重妇女儿童事业的具体建设（托儿所、儿童基金会），邓颖超更侧重妇女经济独立和统一战线工作。
cross_references.description_en: Both Kang Keqing and Deng Yingchao were core leaders of New China's women's liberation movement, both serving as chairpersons of the National All-Women's Federation. Kang focused more on concrete construction (nurseries, children's foundations), while Deng focused more on women's economic independence and united front work.

C-KKQ-001.title_zh: 群众路线法——深入基层发动妇女群众案例
C-KKQ-001.description_zh: 康克清在井冈山时期深入农村发动妇女参加土地革命，创建中国第一个红军女子义勇队。她通过走访贫苦渔家、倾听妇女心声，将分散的诉求归纳为系统的改革方案，体现了'从群众中来，到群众中去'的群众路线思维。
C-KKQ-001.title_en: Mass Line Method — Grassroots Women Mobilization Case
C-KKQ-001.description_en: During the Jinggangshan period, Kang Keqing went deep into rural areas to mobilize women to participate in the land revolution and created China's first Red Army Women's Volunteer Brigade. She visited poor fishing families, listened to women's voices, and summarized scattered demands into systematic reform plans.

C-KKQ-002.title_zh: 组织建设法——晋东南妇救会建设案例
C-KKQ-002.description_zh: 康克清创建晋东南妇女救国会，发展会员数万人，建立了从乡妇救会到县妇联的层层组织体系。她重视组织网络的严密性，认为只有严密的组织才能凝聚妇女解放的力量，体现了系统化的组织建设思维。
C-KKQ-002.title_en: Organizational Construction Method — Jindongnan Women's Association Case
C-KKQ-002.description_en: Kang Keqing created the Jindongnan Women's Salvation Association, developing tens of thousands of members, and established a layered organizational system from township associations to county federations.

C-KKQ-003.title_zh: 妇女解放法——制度变革推动性别平等案例
C-KKQ-003.description_zh: 康克清撰写《没有中国共产党就没有中国妇女的解放》，系统论述妇女解放与社会主义的关系。她参与指导1979年《婚姻法》修改，推动废除封建婚姻制度，主张只有通过社会主义制度变革才能实现妇女的真正解放。
C-KKQ-003.title_en: Women's Liberation Method — Institutional Transformation for Gender Equality Case
C-KKQ-003.description_en: Kang Keqing wrote 'Without the Communist Party of China, There Would Be No Women's Liberation in China,' systematically discussing the relationship between women's liberation and socialism. She participated in guiding the 1979 Marriage Law revision.

C-KKQ-004.title_zh: 儿童保育法——孤儿抚养安置创举案例
C-KKQ-004.description_zh: 1960-1963年，康克清协调多方力量将2000多名孤儿送往内蒙古抚养，开创了新中国孤儿安置工作的新模式。她将儿童工作提升到'培养革命接班人'的高度，体现了对下一代的高度责任感。
C-KKQ-004.title_en: Childcare Method — Orphan Placement Innovation Case
C-KKQ-004.description_en: From 1960-1963, Kang Keqing coordinated multiple forces to send over 2,000 orphans to Inner Mongolia for foster care, pioneering a new model for orphan placement in New China.

C-KKQ-005.title_zh: 实事求是法——文革中坚持原则案例
C-KKQ-005.description_zh: 文革期间，康克清抵制林彪、江青反革命集团的阴谋，在复杂政治环境中始终保持清醒立场，坚持实事求是的工作方法，体现了无产阶级革命家的政治品格和原则坚守。
C-KKQ-005.title_en: Seeking Truth from Facts Method — Upholding Principles during Cultural Revolution Case
C-KKQ-005.description_en: During the Cultural Revolution, Kang Keqing resisted the conspiracy of Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary groups, maintaining a clear position in complex political environments.

C-KKQ-006.title_zh: 平等法治法——王子犯法与庶民同罪案例
C-KKQ-006.description_zh: 1983年，面对孙子朱国华犯罪问题，康克清表态'王子犯法，与庶民同罪'，体现了法律面前人人平等的坚定立场。她推动《婚姻法》修改和签署《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》，彰显法治精神。
C-KKQ-006.title_en: Equal Rule of Law Method — Even a Prince Shares the Same Crime Case
C-KKQ-006.description_en: In 1983, facing her grandson Zhu Guohua's crime, Kang Keqing stated 'Even a prince who breaks the law shares the same crime as commoners,' demonstrating firm commitment to equality before the law.

C-KKQ-007.title_zh: 国际视野法——联合国妇女会议外交案例
C-KKQ-007.description_zh: 1980年康克清代表中国出席联合国妇女十年中期会议，向世界展示中国妇女解放成就。她多次率团参加国际妇女会议，推动中国妇女参与全球治理，展现了宽广的国际视野。
C-KKQ-007.title_en: International Perspective Method — UN Women's Conference Diplomacy Case
C-KKQ-007.description_en: In 1980, Kang Keqing represented China at the UN Women's Decade Mid-Decade Conference, showcasing China's women's liberation achievements to the world.

C-KKQ-008.title_zh: 自力更生法——贫苦渔家女成长为革命家案例
C-KKQ-008.description_zh: 康克清出身贫苦渔家，不识一字入红军，通过刻苦学习成为卓越革命家。她一生俭朴，临终遗言'我什么都不要'，体现了自力更生、自强不息的革命者品格。
C-KKQ-008.title_en: Self-Reliance Method — From Poor Fishing Girl to Revolutionary Leader Case
C-KKQ-008.description_en: Born into a poor fishing family, Kang Keqing joined the Red Army without knowing any characters and became an outstanding revolutionary through diligent study. She lived frugally throughout her life, with final words 'I want nothing'.

C-KKQ-009.title_zh: 综合协调法——一手摘棉花一手抱娃娃案例
C-KKQ-009.description_zh: 康克清提出'一手摘棉花，一手抱娃娃'的工作方针，统筹兼顾妇女解放和儿童福利事业。她协调多方力量成立全国儿童少年工作协调委员会，体现了高超的综合协调能力。
C-KKQ-009.title_en: Comprehensive Coordination Method — Picking Cotton While Holding Baby Case
C-KKQ-009.description_en: Kang Keqing proposed the working principle of 'picking cotton with one hand, holding a baby with the other,' balancing women's liberation and child welfare work. She coordinated multiple forces to establish the National Children and Teenists Work Coordination Committee.

C-KKQ-010.title_zh: 四自精神法——激励妇女自主发展案例
C-KKQ-010.description_zh: 康克清倡导'四自'精神（自尊、自信、自立、自强），提出'四个现代化需要妇女，妇女需要四个现代化'的理念。她强调提高妇女文化科学素质，激发妇女主体意识和社会参与能力。
C-KKQ-010.title_en: Four Self-Spirits Method — Inspiring Women's Self-Development Case
C-KKQ-010.description_en: Kang Keqing advocated the 'Four Self-Spirits' (self-respect, self-confidence, independence, strength) and proposed the concept that 'the Four Modernizations need women, and women need the Four Modernizations.'

H-KS-001.school: 无产阶级革命思想/毛泽东思想/政治权谋理论
representative_works: 延安整风运动理论指导
H-KS-001.historical_significance: 康生（1898-1975），原名张宗可，山东诸城人。中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、书法家，原正国级领导人。延安整风运动、文化大革命主要推动者之一，在党内秘密战线、理论整肃、政治斗争等方面有重要影响。
core_thoughts: 秘密战工作法
整肃肃反法
政治权谋法
理论整肃法
机会主义法
H-KS-001.famous_quote: 整风必然转入审干，审干必然转入肃反
H-KS-001.influence: 康生对中共党史产生了深远影响，特别是在延安整风运动和文化大革命中的政治整肃理论和秘密战线工作。

cross_references.description_zh: 康生与陈伯达同为政治权谋与理论整肃的代表人物，康生重秘密战与肃反实操，陈伯达重理论批判与文字斗争
cross_references.description_en: Kang Sheng and Chen Boda were both representatives of political strategy and theoretical rectification; Kang focused on secret warfare and purge practice, while Chen focused on theoretical critique and literary struggle

cross_references.description_zh: 康生长期担任毛泽东的政治秘书和助手，是毛泽东思想的重要阐释者和执行者，但其政治投机最终导致自我毁灭
cross_references.description_en: Kang Sheng served as Mao Zedong's political secretary and assistant for long years, being an important interpreter and executor of Mao Zedong Thought, but his political opportunism ultimately led to his self-destruction

C-KS-331.title_zh: 延安时期情报体系建设案例
C-KS-331.description_zh: 康生在延安整风时期建立了严密的情报网络，通过秘密战线工作掌握了大量党内动态。他建立的中共中央社会部成为党的核心情报机构，体现了秘密战工作法的系统性和隐蔽性。
C-KS-331.title_en: Yan'an Period Intelligence Network Construction Case
C-KS-331.description_en: During the Yan'an Rectification Movement, Kang Sheng established a thorough intelligence network, mastering intra-party dynamics through secret frontline work. His creation of the CCP Central Social Department became the core intelligence organ of the Party.

C-KS-332.title_zh: 整风审干肃反三段论案例
C-KS-332.description_zh: 康生提出'整风必然转入审干，审干必然转入肃反'的著名论断，将延安整风运动发展为大规模政治清算。这一理论指导了整风-审干-肃反的三段式政治运动模式，造成了大量冤假错案。
C-KS-332.title_en: The Three-Stage Theory of Rectification, Cadre Review and Purge Case
C-KS-332.description_en: Kang Sheng proposed the famous thesis that 'rectification must transition to cadre review, and cadre review must transition to purge,' turning the Yan'an Rectification Movement into large-scale political liquidation.

C-KS-333.title_zh: 政治形势研判与立场调整案例
C-KS-333.description_zh: 康生在不同历史时期善于观察政治风向，适时调整自己的政治立场。从早期支持王明路线到后来迎合毛泽东，体现了其敏锐的政治权谋能力。
C-KS-333.title_en: Political Situation Assessment and Position Adjustment Case
C-KS-333.description_en: Kang Sheng was adept at observing political winds during different historical periods and adjusting his political stance accordingly.

C-KS-334.title_zh: 《农村调查》序言理论批判案例
C-KS-334.description_zh: 康生利用意识形态斗争打击政治对手，在延安时期通过理论批判确立自己的政治地位。他参与编纂《六大以来》，运用理论武器对博古、王明等人进行政治清算。
C-KS-334.title_en: Preface to 'Rural Investigation' Theoretical Critique Case
C-KS-334.description_en: Kang Sheng used ideological struggle to attack political opponents. During the Yan'an period, he established his political status through theoretical critique.

C-KS-335.title_zh: 文革中政治投机与权力博弈案例
C-KS-335.description_zh: 康生在文革初期迅速站稳脚跟，通过附和林彪、江青集团获取权力。他在政治斗争中寻求个人利益最大化，最终随着政治风向变化而失势，体现了机会主义的致命缺陷。
C-KS-335.title_en: Political Opportunism and Power Game during Cultural Revolution Case
C-KS-335.description_en: Kang Sheng quickly established himself at the beginning of the Cultural Revolution by aligning with the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing factions.

C-KS-336.title_zh: 群众运动动员策略案例
C-KS-336.description_zh: 康生善于组织和发动群众运动，将群众力量引向政治斗争目标。在延安整风中，他通过群众运动形式实施政治清洗，体现了政治运动法的双重性。
C-KS-336.description_en: Kang Sheng was skilled at organizing and mobilizing mass movements, directing popular力量 toward political斗争 goals.

C-KS-337.title_zh: 中央社会部权力整合案例
C-KS-337.description_zh: 康生通过建立和掌控中央社会部，整合了党的秘密战线和情报工作权力，建立了以他为核心的情报体系。这种权力集中体现了政治整合法的实际运作。
C-KS-337.title_en: Central Social Department Power Integration Case
C-KS-337.description_en: Kang Sheng integrated the Party's secret frontline and intelligence work power through establishing and controlling the Central Social Department.

C-KS-338.title_zh: 特务政治维护权力稳定案例
C-KS-338.description_zh: 康生运用特务政治手段维护政治安全和权力稳定，通过秘密监视、审查和控制党内人士。这种特务政治模式在特定历史时期发挥了重要作用，但也造成了严重的人权问题。
C-KS-338.title_en: Secret Police Politics Maintaining Power Stability Case
C-KS-338.description_en: Kang Sheng used secret police political methods to maintain political safety and power stability through secret surveillance and control.

C-KS-339.title_zh: 政治投机与地位起伏案例
C-KS-339.description_zh: 康生在文革后期因政治斗争失败而失去权力，死后被正式定性为'反革命集团首要分子'。他的政治投机生涯以悲剧收场，反映了政治投机的高风险和不可持续性。
C-KS-339.title_en: Political Speculation and Status Fluctuation Case
C-KS-339.description_en: After failing in political struggles late in the Cultural Revolution, Kang Sheng lost power and was officially designated as the 'ringleader of the counter-revolutionary group' after death.

C-KS-340.title_zh: 书法艺术与政治关系建立案例
C-KS-340.description_zh: 康生精通书法艺术，其书法作品在当时享有盛誉。他通过文化艺术手段与政治领导层建立特殊关系，体现了文化艺术法在政治生活中的作用。
C-KS-340.title_en: Calligraphy Art and Political Relationship Building Case
C-KS-340.description_en: Kang Sheng was proficient in calligraphy art, enjoying great reputation for his works. He used cultural and artistic means to build special relationships with political leadership.

C-KS-337E.description_zh: 康生通过建立和掌控中央社会部，整合了党的秘密战线和情报工作权力，建立了以他为核心的情报体系。这种权力集中体现了政治整合法的实际运作。
C-KS-337E.title_en: Central Social Department Power Integration Case
C-KS-337E.description_en: Kang Sheng integrated the Party's secret frontline and intelligence work power through establishing and controlling the Central Social Department.

C-KS-338E.title_zh: 特务政治维护权力稳定案例
C-KS-338E.description_zh: 康生运用特务政治手段维护政治安全和权力稳定，通过秘密监视、审查和控制党内人士。这种特务政治模式在特定历史时期发挥了重要作用，但也造成了严重的人权问题。
C-KS-338E.title_en: Secret Police Politics Maintaining Power Stability Case
C-KS-338E.description_en: Kang Sheng used secret police political methods to maintain political safety and power stability through secret surveillance and control.

C-KS-339E.title_zh: 政治投机与地位起伏案例
C-KS-339E.description_zh: 康生在文革后期因政治斗争失败而失去权力，死后被正式定性为'反革命集团首要分子'。他的政治投机生涯以悲剧收场，反映了政治投机的高风险和不可持续性。
C-KS-339E.title_en: Political Speculation and Status Fluctuation Case
C-KS-339E.description_en: After failing in political struggles late in the Cultural Revolution, Kang Sheng lost power and was officially designated as the 'ringleader of the counter-revolutionary group' after death.

C-KS-340E.title_zh: 书法艺术与政治关系建立案例
C-KS-340E.description_zh: 康生精通书法艺术，其书法作品在当时享有盛誉。他通过文化艺术手段与政治领导层建立特殊关系，体现了文化艺术法在政治生活中的作用。
C-KS-340E.title_en: Calligraphy Art and Political Relationship Building Case
C-KS-340E.description_en: Kang Sheng was proficient in calligraphy art, enjoying great reputation for his works. He used cultural and artistic means to build special relationships with political leadership.

H-LRH-001.historical_significance: 中国人民解放军杰出的政治委员，军队政治工作的奠基人之一

C-LRH-001-001.title_zh: 政治建军：党指挥枪原则确立案例
C-LRH-001-001.description_zh: 罗荣桓在古田会议后深入理解党指挥枪原则，在军队中建立党的组织体系，从师、团到连队层层设立党委和党支部，确立党对军队的绝对领导，确保军队永远听党指挥的政治方向。

C-LRH-001-002.title_zh: 系统工程：军队政治工作体系构建案例
C-LRH-001-002.description_zh: 罗荣桓将军队政治工作视为系统工程，从思想建设、组织建设到制度建设全面规划，构建了完整严密的军队政治工作体系。

C-LRH-001-003.title_zh: 实事求是：基层调查研究实践案例
C-LRH-001-003.description_zh: 罗荣桓坚持深入基层调查研究，了解部队实际情况，根据实际战场形势调整政治工作内容。

C-LRH-001-004.title_zh: 群众路线：官兵关系共建共治案例
C-LRH-001-004.description_zh: 罗荣桓在军队中贯彻群众路线，依靠官兵开展政治工作，推动建立士兵委员会。

C-LRH-001-005.title_zh: 榜样示范：英雄模范引领作用案例
C-LRH-001-005.description_zh: 罗荣桓高度重视典型榜样的示范作用，推动学习董存瑞、黄继光等战斗英雄事迹。

C-LRH-001-006.title_zh: 制度保障：军队政治工作规范化案例
C-LRH-001-006.description_zh: 罗荣桓主持制定《中国人民解放军政治工作条例》，为军队政治工作提供制度保障。

C-LRH-001-007.title_zh: 思想引领：政治理论学习案例
C-LRH-001-007.description_zh: 罗荣桓推动建立系统的政治学习制度，组织官兵深入学习马克思列宁主义和毛泽东思想。

C-LRH-001-008.title_zh: 组织建设：党组织战斗堡垒作用案例
C-LRH-001-008.description_zh: 罗荣桓推进各级党组织建设，确保党支部建在连上，发挥党组织战斗堡垒作用。

C-LRH-001-009.title_zh: 文化培育：军队特色文化建设案例
C-LRH-001-009.description_zh: 罗荣桓培育具有人民军队特色的文化，推动创作和传唱革命歌曲。

C-LRH-001-010.title_zh: 创新发展：新时代政治工作创新案例
C-LRH-001-010.description_zh: 罗荣桓根据新形势新要求，不断创新政治工作方式方法。

C-LRH-001-001E.title_en: Political Building: Party Command over Military Principle Case
C-LRH-001-001E.description_en: After the Gutian Conference, Luo Ronghuan established party organizations at all levels, ensuring absolute Party leadership over the military.

C-LRH-001-002E.title_en: System Engineering: Military Political Work System Construction Case
C-LRH-001-002E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan viewed military political work as a systematic project, building a complete political work system.

C-LRH-001-003E.title_en: Seeking Truth from Facts: Grassroots Research Practice Case
C-LRH-001-003E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan insisted on conducting grassroots investigations to understand actual conditions.

C-LRH-001-004E.title_en: Mass Line: Officer-Soldier Co-construction and Governance Case
C-LRH-001-004E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan implemented the mass line in the military, establishing soldier committees.

C-LRH-001-005E.title_en: Model Demonstration: Heroic Role Model Leadership Case
C-LRH-001-005E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan promoted learning from combat heroes like Dong Cunrui and Huang Jiguang.

C-LRH-001-006E.title_en: Institutional Guarantee: Military Political Work Standardization Case
C-LRH-001-006E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan formulated the Political Work Regulations providing institutional guarantees.

C-LRH-001-007E.title_en: Ideological Guidance: Political Theory Study Case
C-LRH-001-007E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan promoted systematic political learning systems for officers and soldiers.

C-LRH-001-008E.title_en: Organizational Construction: Party Organization as Fighting Fortress Case
C-LRH-001-008E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan ensured party branches were established at company level.

C-LRH-001-009E.title_en: Cultural Cultivation: Military Characteristic Culture Building Case
C-LRH-001-009E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan cultivated military culture with revolutionary songs and activities.

C-LRH-001-010E.title_en: Innovation Development: Contemporary Political Work Innovation Case
C-LRH-001-010E.description_en: Luo Ronghuan innovated political work methods according to new situations.

C-QGH-001-001.title_zh: 外交辞令——联合国大会著名演讲案例分析
C-QGH-001-001.description_zh: 乔冠华在1971年第26届联合国大会上发表的演讲，被誉为'外交辞令的巅峰之作'。他以精准的语言、优雅的修辞和有力的论证，向世界宣告了中国恢复联合国合法席位的正当性和必然性。这篇演讲不仅展现了他卓越的语言天赋，更体现了外交辞令在改变国际格局中的巨大力量。
C-QGH-001-001.title_en: Diplomatic Rhetoric — Analysis of Famous UN General Assembly Speech Case
C-QGH-001-001.description_en: Qiao Guanhua's speech at the 26th UN General Assembly in 1971, hailed as 'the pinnacle of diplomatic rhetoric'. Through precise language, elegant rhetoric and powerful argumentation, he declared to the world the legitimacy and inevitability of China's restoration of its lawful seat in the UN.

C-QGH-001-002.title_zh: 多边博弈——联合国席位恢复策略设计案例
C-QGH-001-002.description_zh: 乔冠华在推动中国恢复联合国合法席位的过程中，巧妙运用多边博弈思维，平衡各方利益关系。他准确分析国际力量对比，识别可利用的矛盾和分歧，通过团结第三世界国家、利用大国之间的战略分歧，最终成功推动联合国第2758号决议的通过。
C-QGH-001-002.title_en: Multilateral Game — Strategy Design for UN Seat Restoration Case
C-QGH-001-002.description_en: In promoting China's restoration of its lawful seat in the UN, Qiao Guanhua skillfully applied multilateral game thinking to balance interests of various parties.

C-QGH-001-003.title_zh: 联合国战略——中国重返联合国的平台运用案例
C-QGH-001-003.description_zh: 乔冠华将联合国作为推动国际秩序重构的核心平台，通过议程设置、联盟构建和规则运用来改变不利格局。他深知联合国外交的战略价值，通过系统性的联合国战略设计，成功推动了中国恢复合法席位的历史进程。
C-QGH-001-003.title_en: UN Strategy — Platform Utilization for China's Return to UN Case
C-QGH-001-003.description_en: Qiao Guanhua used the United Nations as a core platform for reconstructing international order.

C-QGH-001-004.title_zh: 语言天才——乔冠华多语种外交才能展示案例
C-QGH-001-004.description_zh: 乔冠华精通多国语言，具备卓越的语言天赋和修辞技巧。他在联合国大会上的即兴演讲、外交谈判中的临场发挥以及外交文件的精妙措辞，都展现了他将语言作为外交武器的非凡能力。
C-QGH-001-004.title_en: Linguistic Genius — Qiao Guanhua's Multilingual Diplomacy Showcase Case
C-QGH-001-004.description_en: Fluent in multiple languages, Qiao Guanhua possessed outstanding language talent and rhetorical skills.

C-QGH-001-005.title_zh: 外交风云——1971年联合国大会关键时刻案例
C-QGH-001-005.description_zh: 在1971年第26届联合国大会的关键时刻，乔冠华以果断决策和灵活应变创造了外交史上的经典案例。他准确把握历史机遇，在联合国大会表决通过第2758号决议的瞬间，以标志性的开怀大笑展现了中国外交的重大突破。
C-QGH-001-005.title_en: Diplomatic Storms — Critical Moment at 1971 UN General Assembly Case
C-QGH-001-005.description_en: At the critical moment of the 26th UN General Assembly in 1971, Qiao Guanhua created a classic case in diplomatic history through decisive decisions and flexible responses.

C-QGH-001-006.title_zh: 国际法理——联合国席位恢复的法律论证案例
C-QGH-001-006.description_zh: 乔冠华以扎实的国际法知识为基础，通过严密的法律逻辑论证中国恢复联合国合法席位的正当性。他在联合国大会上的法理论证，为后续多边国际事务中的法律外交提供了重要范本。
C-QGH-001-006.title_en: International Jurisprudence — Legal Argumentation for UN Seat Restoration Case
C-QGH-001-006.description_en: Building on solid international law knowledge, Qiao Guanhua demonstrated through rigorous legal logic the legitimacy of China's restoration of its lawful seat in the UN.

C-QGH-001-007.title_zh: 情报研判——联合国大会前的形势分析案例
C-QGH-001-007.description_zh: 乔冠华在联合国大会召开前进行了系统的情报收集和形势研判，准确评估了各国立场和投票倾向。他的情报分析为中国的联合国战略提供了科学依据，确保了外交决策的准确性。
C-QGH-001-007.title_en: Intelligence Analysis — Pre-UN General Assembly Situation Assessment Case
C-QGH-001-007.description_en: Before the UN General Assembly convened, Qiao Guanhua conducted systematic intelligence collection and situation analysis.

C-QGH-001-008.title_zh: 第三世界团结——亚非拉国家联合策略案例
C-QGH-001-008.description_zh: 乔冠华高度重视第三世界国家在联合国中的作用，通过团结亚非拉发展中国家来改变国际力量对比。他的实践证明，第三世界国家是恢复联合国合法席位的主力军，团结发展中国家是实现国际秩序变革的关键。
C-QGH-001-008.title_en: Third World Solidarity — Asian, African and Latin American United Strategy Case
C-QGH-001-008.description_en: Qiao Guanhua highly valued the role of Third World countries in the United Nations, seeking to change international power dynamics by uniting developing countries.

C-QGH-001-009.title_zh: 谈判策略——中美建交谈判中的博弈案例
C-QGH-001-009.description_zh: 乔冠华参与了中美关系正常化的多项关键谈判，运用灵活的谈判策略在复杂的双边关系中实现国家利益。他的谈判实践体现了外交中妥协与坚持的平衡艺术。
C-QGH-001-009.title_en: Negotiation Strategy — Game Theory in China-US Normalization Negotiations Case
C-QGH-001-009.description_en: Qiao Guanhua participated in multiple key negotiations of China-US normalization, applying flexible negotiation strategies to achieve national interests.

C-QGH-001-010.title_zh: 历史时机——1971年联合国恢复席位的关键窗口案例
C-QGH-001-010.description_zh: 乔冠华准确把握1971年联合国大会的历史机遇和战略窗口，在关键时刻做出正确决策。他的实践证明，外交成功很大程度上取决于对历史时机的准确把握。
C-QGH-001-010.title_en: Historical Timing — Critical Window of 1971 UN Seat Restoration Case
C-QGH-001-010.description_en: Qiao Guanhua accurately grasped the historical opportunity and strategic window of the 1971 UN General Assembly.

H-SQL-001.historical_significance: 宋庆龄（1893-1981），20世纪中国伟大的政治家、社会活动家，孙中山夫人，中华人民共和国名誉主席。作为中国近代史上杰出的女性领导人，她以博爱精神、国际主义立场和妇女解放实践著称于世。宋庆龄一生致力于妇女儿童福利事业、国际和平运动以及中国革命事业，在国共两党之间架起桥梁，为中国革命和建设事业作出了不可磨灭的贡献。她既是孙中山革命事业的忠实继承者，又是新中国建设的重要参与者，在复杂的历史环境中展现了非凡的政治智慧和人格魅力。

H-WL-001.school: 务实改革学派/Pragmatic Reform School
H-WL-001.historical_significance: 万里是中国改革开放时期的重要领导人之一，曾任国务院总理、全国人大常委会委员长。他以'实事求是、大胆改革'的思维方式著称，在安徽农村改革、经济特区建设、干部制度改革等方面作出了重要贡献。
core_thoughts: 实事求是改革法（从实际出发推进改革）
大胆探索先行法（敢于突破体制束缚）
注重实效决策法（以实践成果检验政策）
渐进稳妥推进法（改革与稳定并重）
实事求是用人法（任人唯贤、不拘一格）
调查研究决策法（深入实际掌握实情）
重点突破带动全局法（抓住关键环节）
党内民主决策法（集体讨论、集思广益）
制度创新思维法（推动体制变革）
历史经验总结法（从实践中提炼规律）
H-WL-001.famous_quote: 不管白猫黑猫，抓住老鼠就是好猫——实践是检验真理的唯一标准。
H-WL-001.influence: 万里的务实改革思想对中国改革开放进程产生了深远影响，其'敢于担当、注重实效'的思维方式成为政策制定的重要指导原则。

cross_references.description_zh: 陈云侧重经济建设的综合平衡思维，万里侧重改革推进的务实探索；前者重在'稳'，后者重在'闯'。
毛泽东强调'实事求是'的思想路线，万里将其应用于改革开放的具体实践；前者是理论创立者，后者是改革践行者。
郭沫若侧重文化与思想的创新融合，万里侧重政治体制改革；两者都体现了现代中国思想解放的时代特征。

C-WL-001.title_zh: 实事求是——安徽农村改革方向判断案例
C-WL-001.description_zh: 改革开放初期，万里在安徽省委领导岗位上，坚持从农村实际情况出发，支持小岗村'大包干'实践。他不唯上、不唯书，以农民的实际生活改善作为判断政策正确性的唯一标准。

C-WL-002.title_zh: 大胆探索——经济特区建设中的突破案例
C-WL-002.description_zh: 万里在中央领导层中积极支持经济特区的建立，主张突破传统计划经济的体制束缚，大胆探索市场经济的新路径。

C-WL-003.title_zh: 注重实效——政策效果检验案例
C-WL-003.description_zh: 万里在推动各项改革措施时，始终坚持以实践成果作为评判标准：农村增产、城市搞活、人民生活改善，用实际数据验证改革方向的正确性。

C-WL-004.title_zh: 渐进稳妥——改革与稳定并重案例
C-WL-004.description_zh: 万里在推进农村经济体制改革的过程中，始终坚持稳妥原则：先在小岗村等少数地区试点，成功后逐步推广，既推动了改革又保持了社会稳定。

C-WL-005.title_zh: 实事求是用人——干部制度改革案例
C-WL-005.description_zh: 万里在中央领导岗位上，大力推动干部制度改革，主张打破论资排辈的旧有体制，任人唯贤、不拘一格选拔年轻干部。

C-WL-006.title_zh: 调查研究——经济政策制定案例
C-WL-006.description_zh: 万里主持国务院工作期间，坚持深入各地调研实际情况，在制定经济政策前充分听取基层意见和掌握一手资料。

C-WL-007.title_zh: 重点突破——产业结构调整案例
C-WL-007.description_zh: 万里在国务院领导工作中，抓住农业和能源两个关键环节进行重点突破，同时兼顾轻工业发展和人民生活改善。

C-WL-008.title_zh: 党内民主——重大决策过程案例
C-WL-008.description_zh: 万里在担任全国人大常委会委员长期间，大力推动党内民主和人大制度的完善，强调集体讨论、集思广益的决策方式。

C-WL-009.title_zh: 制度创新——法治建设推进案例
C-WL-009.description_zh: 万里在人大工作期间，推动了一系列重要的立法和制度改革：完善人民代表大会制度、加强社会主义法制建设。

C-WL-010.title_zh: 历史经验——改革历程总结案例
C-WL-010.description_zh: 万里晚年回顾改革开放历程，从自身参与农村改革、经济特区建设的实践中提炼出宝贵的历史经验，为后续改革提供参考。

C-WL-001E.title_en: Seeking Truth from Facts — Anhui Rural Reform Direction Judgment Case
C-WL-001E.description_en: During the early reform and opening-up period, Wan Li, as a provincial party secretary in Anhui, insisted on judging policies based on actual rural conditions. He supported the Xiaogang Village 'contract responsibility' practice without deferring to established doctrines.

C-WL-002E.title_en: Bold Exploration — Economic Special Zone Development Case
C-WL-002E.description_en: Wan Li actively supported the establishment of economic special zones in central leadership, advocating breakthrough beyond traditional planned economy constraints and bold exploration of market-oriented pathways.

C-WL-003E.description_en: Wan Li consistently used practical outcomes as the evaluation criterion: increased agricultural production, revitalized cities, and improved people livelihoods.

C-WL-004E.title_en: Gradual and Prudent — Reform and Stability Balance Case
C-WL-004E.description_en: While advancing rural economic reform, Wan Li adhered to prudence: first piloting in Xiaogang Village and a few areas, then gradually expanding after successful results.

C-WL-005E.title_en: Merit-Based Personnel — Cadre System Reform Case
C-WL-005E.description_en: In central leadership positions, Wan Li vigorously promoted cadre system reform, advocating the abolition of seniority-based promotion and selection of young cadres based on merit.

C-WL-006E.title_en: Investigation and Research — Economic Policy Formulation Case
C-WL-006E.description_en: While presiding over the State Council, Wan Li insisted on visiting various regions for field investigations and fully listening to grassroots opinions before formulating economic policies.

C-WL-007E.title_en: Key Breakthrough — Industrial Structure Adjustment Case
C-WL-007E.description_en: In State Council leadership, Wan Li focused on agriculture and energy as two key breakthrough areas while balancing light industry development and people livelihood.

C-WL-008E.title_en: Intra-Party Democracy — Major Decision Process Case
C-WL-008E.description_en: As Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, Wan Li vigorously promoted intra-party democracy and improvement of the people congress system.

C-WL-009E.title_en: Institutional Innovation — Rule of Law Construction Case
C-WL-009E.description_en: During his NPC work, Wan Li promoted important legislative and institutional reforms: improving the people congress system and strengthening socialist rule of law.

C-WL-010E.title_en: Historical Experience — Reform Process Summary Case
C-WL-010E.description_en: In his later years, Wan Li reviewed the reform and opening-up process, extracting valuable historical experiences from his participation in rural reform and special zone development.

meta.source: 《万里文选》、《万里回忆录》、中共中央文献研究室编撰资料
meta.methodology: 历史文献分析法、案例验证法、实践经验总结法
meta.validation: 与改革开放经济政策实施效果交叉验证

cross_references.description_zh: 谢富治是毛泽东文革战略的忠实执行者，将毛泽东的政治意图转化为具体的安全清洗行动。
cross_references.description_en: Xie Fu zhi was a faithful executor of Mao Zedong's Cultural Revolution strategy, translating Mao's political intentions into concrete security purge actions.

cross_references.description_zh: 同为文革中利用安全机构进行政治清洗的核心人物，谢富治侧重公安系统实操，康生侧重理论整肃和秘密战线。
cross_references.description_en: Both were core figures in using security apparatus for political purges during the Cultural Revolution; Xie focused on public security system operations while Kang Sheng focused on theoretical rectification and secret front work.

cross_references.description_zh: 陈伯达是'理论家'型，擅长撰写政治批判文章；谢富治是'打手'型，擅长组织落实和执行清洗行动。
cross_references.description_en: Chen Boda was the 'theoretician' type, skilled in writing political critique articles; Xie Fu zhi was the 'enforcer' type, skilled in organizational implementation and purge operations.

C-XFZ-001-001.title_zh: 投机动荡——张国焘事件后的政治转向案例
C-XFZ-001-001.description_zh: 1935年张国焘分裂主义失败后，谢富治主动向毛泽东提供红四方面军内部情报，完成政治忠诚的迅速转移，保全自身并赢得毛的信任。

C-XFZ-001-002.title_zh: 忠诚检验——公安部反修防修运动案例
C-XFZ-001-002.description_zh: 谢富治取代罗瑞卿后，在公安部发起'反修防修'运动，以'忠于毛泽东思想'为标准清洗原罗瑞卿派系干部，完成权力再配置。

C-XFZ-001-003.title_zh: 组织操控——通过程序推进'砸烂公检法'案例
C-XFZ-001-003.description_zh: 作为公安部部长，谢富治通过公安部系统向下传达、组织落实'砸烂公检法'的政策，将个人政治意图转化为组织决策的合法形式。

C-XFZ-001-004.title_zh: 混乱红利——文革初期利用秩序真空扩张权力案例
C-XFZ-001-004.description_zh: 文革初期，谢富治利用秩序混乱之机，推动公安部向造反派提供武器，建立红色警卫力量，在旧秩序瓦解中获取超额政治资本。

C-XFZ-001-005.title_zh: 正面施压——陈毅追悼会事件中的公开批斗案例
C-XFZ-001-005.description_zh: 在陈毅追悼会事件中，谢富治默许造反派进入会场炮轰陈毅，当面指责陈毅是'老右倾机会主义者'，通过公开施压摧毁对手权威。

C-XFZ-001-006.title_zh: 底线突破——'砸烂公检法'击穿法治底线案例
C-XFZ-001-006.description_zh: 1967年8月提出'砸烂公检法'，使公安机关瘫痪、司法体系崩溃，将文革暴力升级为'国家授权'的合法行为。

C-XFZ-001-007.title_zh: 双重身份——革命将领与政治打手的并行身份案例
C-XFZ-001-007.description_zh: 谢富治生前享有'无产阶级革命家'身份待遇（高级别追悼会、八宝山安葬），死后8年被开除党籍并移出八宝山，两种身份在不同时期被不同力量认可。

C-XFZ-001-008.title_zh: 信息控制——红军肃反时期'怀疑一切'氛围营造案例
C-XFZ-001-008.description_zh: 谢富治在红军肃反时期提出'要勇于怀疑一切'，通过制造普遍的怀疑氛围使人人自危、人人自证，从而巩固自己的审查权力。

C-XFZ-001-009.title_zh: 实用效能——云南三年困难时期治理案例
C-XFZ-001-009.description_zh: 在云南主政期间，三年困难时期云南未发生大规模饿死事件，体现了谢富治在行政治理能力上的实用主义取向——在政治安全红线内追求治理效能最大化。

C-XFZ-001-010.title_zh: 制度重塑——北京市革命委员会成立案例
C-XFZ-001-010.description_zh: 推动北京市革命委员会的成立并担任主任，在废墟上主导新制度的设计和建立，使新制度天然有利于自身权力位置的巩固。

C-XFZ-001E-001.title_en: Opportunistic Recalibration — Political Shift After Zhang Guotao Incident Case
C-XFZ-001E-001.description_en: After Zhang Guotao's separatist failure in 1935, Xie proactively provided Mao with Red Fourth Front Army internal intelligence, completing a rapid political loyalty transfer to preserve himself and win Mao's trust.

C-XFZ-001E-002.title_en: Loyalty Test — Anti-Revisionism Campaign in Ministry of Public Security Case
C-XFZ-001E-002.description_en: After replacing Luo Ruiqing, Xie launched an 'anti-revisionism' campaign in the Ministry of Public Security, purging Luo's faction using 'loyalty to Mao Zedong Thought' as the standard to complete power redistribution.

C-XFZ-001E-003.title_en: Organizational Manipulation — Pushing 'Smash Public Security Organs' Through Procedures Case
C-XFZ-001E-003.description_en: As Minister of Public Security, Xie used the ministry's organizational channels to transmit and implement the 'smash the public security organs' policy, transforming personal political intent into legitimate organizational decisions.

C-XFZ-001E-004.title_en: Chaos Dividend — Power Expansion During Early Cultural Revolution Vacuum Case
C-XFZ-001E-004.description_en: In the early Cultural Revolution, Xie exploited the chaotic order to push the Ministry of Public Security to arm Rebel factions and establish a red guard force, acquiring excess political capital during the collapse of old order.

C-XFZ-001E-005.title_en: Direct Pressure — Public Denunciation at Chen Yi's Memorial Service Case
C-XFZ-001E-005.description_en: At Chen Yi's memorial service, Xie tacitly allowed Rebel factions to enter and attack Chen Yi, publicly calling him an 'old right-deviationist,' destroying the opponent's authority through direct pressure.

C-XFZ-001E-006.title_en: Bottom-Line Transgression — 'Smash Public Security Organs' Breaching Rule of Law Case
C-XFZ-001E-006.description_en: Proposing 'smash the public security, procuratorate, and courts' in August 1967, paralyzing public security organs and collapsing the judicial system, upgrading Cultural Revolution violence to 'state-authorized' legal behavior.

C-XFZ-001E-007.title_en: Dual Identity — Revolutionary General and Political Hitman Parallel Identity Case
C-XFZ-001E-007.description_en: During his lifetime, Xie enjoyed the identity of 'proletarian revolutionary' (high-level memorial, Babaoshan burial); 8 years after death, stripped of that identity (expelled from Party, removed from Babaoshan).

C-XFZ-001E-008.title_en: Information Control — 'Dare to Doubt Everything' Atmosphere Creation in Red Army Purges Case
C-XFZ-001E-008.description_en: Xie proposed 'dare to doubt everything' during the Red Army purges, creating an atmosphere of universal suspicion where everyone was anxious and self-incriminating, thereby consolidating his review power.

C-XFZ-001E-009.title_en: Pragmatic Effectiveness — Yunnan Three Years of Difficulty Governance Case
C-XFZ-001E-009.description_en: During his tenure in Yunnan, no large-scale starvation occurred during the Three Years of Difficulty, demonstrating Xie's pragmatic orientation in administrative governance—maximizing governance effectiveness within political safety red lines.

C-XFZ-001E-010.title_en: Institutional Reshaping — Establishment of Beijing Municipal Revolutionary Committee Case
C-XFZ-001E-010.description_en: Pushing for the establishment of the Beijing Municipal Revolutionary Committee and serving as its chairman, leading the design and establishment of new institutions on the ruins to consolidate his own power position.

cross_references.description_zh: 心即理 vs 性即理：王阳明批评朱子'析心与理为二'，主张理不在事物而在吾心；朱子格物穷理是外向认识论，阳明格物正念头是内向实践论。这是宋明理学'理学'与'心学'两系的分水岭。
cross_references.description_en: Mind-is-Principle vs Nature-is-Principle: Wang criticized Zhu Xi's splitting of mind and principle; Zhu's investigation of things is outward-directed epistemology, Wang's is inward-directed praxis. This is the watershed between Neo-Confucian rationalism and the School of Mind.

cross_references.description_zh: 王阳明承陆九渊'心即理''六经注我'之旨，以'致良知'完成心学体系化；陆发其端而未畅，阳明扩充到底，故并称'陆王心学'。
cross_references.description_en: Wang inherited Lu Jiuyuan's 'mind is principle' and 'the classics annotate me,' completing the systematization of the School of Mind through 'extending innate knowledge'; hence the joint name Lu-Wang.

cross_references.description_zh: 王阳明自述'所学皆由孔子之统绪'，知行合一与万物一体之仁直承孔子'吾道一以贯之'与仁学传统。
cross_references.description_en: Wang claimed his learning continued Confucius's line: unity of knowledge and action and the benevolence of all-things-one-body carry forward 'my way is strung on one thread' and the ren tradition.

cross_references.description_zh: 王阳明'满街都是圣人'的人人皆可为圣论，与黄宗羲以《明夷待访录》批判君主专制一脉相通：黄宗羲师承刘宗周，刘宗周承阳明蕺山一系，阳明学的心性平等观为明清批判思想提供了内在资源。
cross_references.description_en: Wang's doctrine that 'the whole street is full of sages' connects to Huang Zongxi's critique of despotism: Huang, heir of Liu Zongzhou in the Yangming line, drew on the Yangming view of moral equality of all minds.

cross_references.description_zh: 良知内在自律 vs 天人感应他律：董仲舒以超验之天制约君权，王阳明以人人内在良知作为道德最高法庭。外在权威与内在权威构成中国政治伦理思想史的两极。
cross_references.description_en: Innate-conscience autonomy vs heaven-human heteronomy: Dong constrained rulers through transcendent Heaven; Wang made each person's innate moral knowing the supreme court. External versus internal authority as two poles of Chinese ethical-political thought.

cross_references.description_zh: 王阳明'心外无物'与司马迁'究天人之际'：两者都把探究焦点从外在天命转向人的世界——司马迁转向历史人事，王阳明转向本心良知。
cross_references.description_en: Wang's 'nothing outside the mind' and Sima Qian's 'probing heaven and humanity': both shifted inquiry from external mandate to the human world—Sima to history and affairs, Wang to the mind's innate knowing.

cross_references.vs_wangyangming: 王阳明重心学修养，王震重实践建设；前者向内求良知，后者向外建功业

H-CY-001.school: 务实思维学派/Pragmatic Thinking School
representative_works: 《陈云的思维方式与实践智慧》

cross_references.description_zh: 陆沉侧重方法论层面的深度思维技术，陈云侧重实践导向的务实决策；前者面向现代复杂系统分析，后者面向经济改革与政策制定。
陆一波侧重系统整合与创新的理论框架，陈云侧重从实践中来的经验总结；前者重理论建构，后者重实践检验。
黄宗羲的'综合平衡'思维侧重古代经济思想，陈云的'综合平衡'面向现代经济建设的实际运作；前者是理论建构，后者是实践经验。
商君师从李悝，继承法家思想并发展为可操作的制度体系。
cross_references.description_en: Lord Shang studied under Li Kui, inheriting Legalist thought.

cross_references.description_zh: 商君重'法'，韩非综合三者为'法、术、势'三位一体。
cross_references.description_en: Lord Shang emphasized 'law'; Han Fei synthesized all three.

cross_references.description_zh: 商君变法为秦始皇统一六国奠定了制度基础。
cross_references.description_en: Lord Shang's reforms provided institutional foundation for Qin Shi Huang.

cross_references.description_zh: 非人概念中的法家机器化治理思想直接源自商君的'徙木立信''连坐法'等制度设计，将'非人'概念首次引入战国政治实践。
cross_references.description_en: The Legalist machine governance concept in 'non-person' directly originates from Lord Shang's institutional designs like 'wood-credibility' and 'mutual responsibility', introducing the 'non-person' concept into Warring States political practice for the first time.

cross_references.description_zh: 苏咸与苏秦处于同一时代，都是战国纵横家的代表人物，但苏咸更早提出合纵连横的战略思想。
cross_references.description_en: Su Xian and Su Qin were contemporaries, both representatives of Warring States diplomacy; however, Su Xian proposed the horizontal-vertical strategy earlier.

cross_references.description_zh: 苏咸与商鞅同时代，但侧重点不同：商君重内政法制，苏咸重外交纵横。
cross_references.description_en: Su Xian and Lord Shang were contemporaries but focused on different domains: Shang emphasized domestic legal reform, while Su Xian emphasized foreign diplomacy.

cross_references.description_zh: 苏咸的游说活动直接影响了秦国统一六国的战略进程，其合纵连横策略是秦始皇最终成功的重要外交背景。
cross_references.description_en: Su Xian's diplomatic activities directly influenced the strategic process of Qin Shi Huang's unification; his vertical-horizontal strategy was an important diplomatic background.

cross_references.description_zh: 连横对手的镜像关系（事一强以攻众弱 与 合众弱以攻一强 的战略对偶）——传统叙事以张仪为苏秦同门师弟与合纵的正面拆解者：苏秦把诸弱焊成整体，张仪在诸弱之间逐个插楔。帛书出土后二人年辈错开，但'苏张'作为纵横两极的文化原型已定格。
cross_references.description_en: The mirror relation of horizontal versus vertical ('serve one strong to attack the many weak' vs 'unite the many weak to attack the one strong')—Su Qin welded the weak into one body; Zhang Yi drove wedges between them. The Mawangdui silk texts later pulled their careers apart, yet 'Su-Zhang' as the two poles of the persuasion schools is fixed in cultural memory.

cross_references.description_zh: 张仪与商君同为战国功利主义大师的内政/外交分野：商君改造一国的内部结构（法、耕、战），张仪操纵多国的外部关系（盟、诈、纵）——秦的强盛由内政与外交两条腿走路，二人各撑其一。
cross_references.description_en: Zhang Yi and Shang Yang, both Warring States utilitarians, split domestic versus foreign: Shang Yang rebuilt the internal structure of one state (law, farming, war) while Zhang Yi manipulated external relations among many (pacts, ruses, alignments)—Qin's rise walked on both legs.

cross_references.description_zh: 张仪与韩非同为战国纵横/法脉代表，但张仪侧重外交权变的即时操作，韩非侧重制度理论的系统建构。
cross_references.description_en: Both Warring States strategists, but Zhang focused on the real-time craft of diplomatic maneuver while Han Fei built systematic institutional theory.

C-ZY-001E.title_zh: 连横破纵——以弱事强的外交战略
C-ZY-001E.description_en: 'Lianheng unites the weak to serve one strong state.' Breaking encircling alliances through bilateral relationships.

C-ZY-002E.title_zh: 势合权变——动态评估国际格局
C-ZY-002E.description_en: 'Serve one strong power to establish advantage'—dynamically adjusting strategies based on real-time balance of power.

C-ZY-003E.title_zh: 以利导之——利益驱动的外交博弈
C-ZY-003E.description_en: 'Guide by interests'—Zhang Yi used the land of Shangwu (600 li) as bait to break the Qi-Chu alliance.

C-ZY-004E.title_zh: 虚实并用——信息操控的外交核心
C-ZY-004E.description_en: 'Combine falsehood and reality'—Zhang Yi promised 600 li, delivered 6 li, while using real military threats.

C-ZY-005E.title_zh: 量权度力——系统化战略评估
C-ZY-005E.description_en: 'Assess power and strength'—Zhang Yi analyzed geographic terrain, military strength, and internal conflicts before each mission.

C-ZY-006E.title_zh: 因势利导——利用既有矛盾
C-ZY-006E.description_en: 'Guide according to circumstances'—Zhang Yi utilized existing international situations and conflicts among states.

C-ZY-007E.title_zh: 先破后立——拆解合纵新秩序
C-ZY-007E.description_en: 'Break first, establish later'—Zhang Yi began by dismantling the Qi-Chu alliance.

C-ZY-008E.title_zh: 以诈破坚——战略欺骗的艺术
C-ZY-008E.description_en: 'Use deception to break firmness'—Zhang Yi's deceptive tactics broke the solid vertical alliance.

C-ZY-009E.title_zh: 一使制多国——个人外交的极限
C-ZY-009E.description_en: 'One envoy subdues multiple states'—Zhang Yi visited six states as a commoner, freeing Qin from eastern concerns.

C-ZY-010E.title_zh: 以地为饵——资源杠杆化战略
C-ZY-010E.description_en: 'Use land as bait'—Zhang Yi used 600 li of Shangwu as diplomatic leverage to break the Qi-Chu alliance.

cross_references.description_zh: 司马迁与董仲舒在太学论辩'天命与人事'：董主张天人感应、灾异谴告，司马迁则在肯定天道存在的同时更强调人事的自主性。这场学术论争奠定了汉代思想的基本格局。
cross_references.description_en: Sima Qian's debate with Dong Zhongshu at the Grand Academy on 'Heaven and Human Affairs': Dong advocated heaven-human resonance and disaster warnings, while Sima Qian affirmed cosmic order yet emphasized human agency more strongly. This academic dispute shaped the basic intellectual landscape of the Han dynasty.

cross_references.description_zh: 司马迁在《史记》中以客观态度评价秦始皇和李斯，既肯定秦制统一之功，也批判其严刑峻法之弊。他的'通古今之变'方法论直接继承了李斯制度建构的历史视野，但超越了单向度的法家立场。
cross_references.description_en: Sima Qian objectively evaluated Qin Shi Huang and Li Si in Sima Qian's Records—affirming the unifying achievement of Qin institutions while criticizing harsh penal governance. His 'tracing historical changes' methodology inherited the institutional vision of Li Si while transcending one-sided Legalist positions.

C-SMQ-001.description_zh: 探究天道（自然法则、宇宙秩序）与人事（人类行为、社会变迁）之间的深层关系。司马迁既承认天道的存在，又强调人事的自主性，在灾异祥瑞的记录中保留批判空间。此法超越了单纯的天命论与纯粹的人本主义，建立了辩证的历史本体论框架。
applications_zh: 复杂系统的天人关系建模
生态伦理与可持续发展理论

C-SMQ-002.description_zh: '述往事，思来者'——以历史书写服务于未来治理者的实用史学观。《史记》不是单纯的历史记录，而是为后世政治提供借鉴的智慧宝库。此法将历史从被动记载提升为主动的政治预测与治理指导工具，体现了史学的现实关怀。
applications_zh: 政策制定的历史经验借鉴
战略决策中的历史类比

C-SMQ-003.description_zh: '其文直，其事核，不虚美，不隐恶'——以客观真实为首要原则的史学方法。司马迁在遭受宫刑的政治迫害后，仍以独立意志坚持如实记录历史真相，不美化也不隐恶。此法代表了史学家的最高道德标准与求真意志。
applications_zh: 学术研究的客观性标准

C-SMQ-004.description_zh: 将同一人物的复杂事迹分散于不同篇章，通过篇目间的互文关系构建多维立体的历史叙事。如项羽本纪侧重其军事成就，而高祖本纪则记录其政治手腕；伯夷列传表彰气节，货殖列传肯定商业。通过分散叙事避免单一视角的偏颇。

C-SMQ-005.description_zh: '太史公曰'——在每篇末尾以独立评论总结，将叙事与价值判断结合。司马迁通过'太史公曰'不仅总结历史事件，更表达政治哲学立场与价值评判。此方法开创了史学评论的传统，使历史书写兼具叙事功能与思辨深度。
applications_zh: 政策评估报告中的独立分析
历史研究的批判性评论

C-SMQ-006.description_zh: 首创本纪、表、书、世家、列传五种体裁，以人物传记为主体构建历史叙事。从帝王将相到游侠刺客、商贾医卜，赋予各阶层人物以历史书写的地位。此法打破了单纯按时间顺序排列史事的传统，开创了以人物为中心的历史书写范式。

C-SMQ-007.description_zh: 通过比较不同时代相似人物的命运与选择，提炼历史规律。如将陈胜列入世家以肯定其开创之功，将伯夷叔齐列入列传以表彰其气节。此法强调跨越时代的历史相似性，通过类比发现深层规律而非表面差异。
applications_zh: 历史经验的可迁移性分析

C-SMQ-008.description_zh: 突破单纯政治军事叙事，将文化、经济、科技纳入历史书写。《平准书》论经济，《游侠列传》论社会底层，《货殖列传》论商业文明，构建了多维度的文明史框架。此法将历史从帝王将相的独角戏扩展为全社会的立体画卷，确立了经济、文化在历史进程中的独立地位。
applications_zh: 多维度的社会发展分析

C-SMQ-009.description_zh: '人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛'——在遭受宫刑的巨大屈辱后，将个体苦难转化为历史责任与文明贡献。司马迁以超越个人荣辱的历史使命感完成《史记》，体现了将个体痛苦升华为文化创造的能力。此法是对逆境中精神超越的深刻阐述。
applications_zh: 逆境管理的心理转化理论
创伤后成长与创造力激发

C-SMQ-010.description_zh: 既承认天道的存在（如灾异祥瑞），又强调人事的主观能动性。在《陈涉世家》中肯定底层革命，在《项羽本纪》中批判霸王刚愎，体现了超越单纯天命论的复杂历史观。此法在承认宇宙秩序约束的同时，为人类自由意志保留了充分空间。
applications_zh: 风险决策中的主观能动性发挥
复杂系统的不确定性管理

C-SMQ-001E.description_en: Exploring the deep relationship between cosmic order (heaven) and human affairs. Sima Qian acknowledged both the existence of heavenly patterns and human agency, creating a dialectical historical ontology that transcends pure fatalism and pure humanism.
applications_en: Heaven-human relationship modeling in complex systems
Ecological ethics and sustainable development theory

C-SMQ-002E.description_en: 'Record the past to enlighten the future'—a practical historiography that serves as a wisdom repository for future statesmen. Sima Qian's work elevates history from passive recording to active political forecasting and governance guidance, demonstrating the practical relevance of historiography.

C-SMQ-003E.description_en: 'Straightforward words, verified facts; no false praise, no concealed evil'—the historiographical method prioritizing objective truth. After suffering castration as political persecution, Sima Qian maintained independent will to record historical truth faithfully. This method represents the highest moral standard and求真 will of a historian.

C-SMQ-004E.description_en: Distributing complex events of one figure across multiple chapters, creating multi-dimensional narrative through inter-chapter textual relationships. Xiang Yu's military achievements in his Basic Annals contrasted with Liu Bang's political maneuvering in his. This distributed narrative avoids the bias of a single perspective.

C-SMQ-005E.description_en: 'Grand Historian says'—independent commentary at the end of each chapter integrating narrative with value judgment. Through 'Grand Historian says', Sima Qian expressed political philosophy and value assessments beyond mere event summary. This method established the tradition of historiographical commentary.
applications_en: Independent analysis in policy evaluation reports

C-SMQ-006E.description_en: Pioneering five genres: basic annals, tables, treatises, hereditary houses, and biographies. By making character biographies the core of historical narrative—from emperors to warriors, assassins, merchants and scholars—Sima Qian gave all social strata a place in history writing. This broke the tradition of purely chronological arrangement.

C-SMQ-007E.description_en: Comparing the fates and choices of similar figures across different eras to extract historical patterns. Placing Chen Sheng in hereditary houses to affirm his founding contribution, or Bo Yi with Shu Qi to honor integrity. This method emphasizes trans-era historical similarities, discovering deep patterns rather than surface differences.

C-SMQ-008E.description_en: Transcending purely political and military narrative by incorporating culture, economy, and technology into historical writing. Treatise on Standardization (economy), Biographies of Wandering Knights (grassroots society), and Money-makers (commercial civilization) together form a multi-dimensional framework. This expanded history from emperors' solo to society's立体 painting.

C-SMQ-009E.description_en: 'Death is inevitable for all; some are heavier than Mount Tai, others lighter than a goose feather'—after suffering castration's humiliation, transforming individual suffering into historical responsibility and civilizational contribution. Sima Qian completed his monumental work through a historical mission transcending personal glory and shame, demonstrating the capacity to elevate individual suffering into cultural creation.
applications_en: Psychological transformation theory in adversity management

C-SMQ-010E.description_en: Acknowledging both cosmic order (disasters, omens) and human agency. Affirming grassroots revolution in Chen She's Basic Account while criticizing Xiang Yu's arrogance—reflecting a complex historical view transcending simple fatalism. This method preserves full space for human free will while acknowledging cosmic constraints.

cross_references.description_zh: 董仲舒继承并改造孔子儒家思想，将其宇宙论化、神学化，使孔子从教师升格为素王，开创汉代经学传统。
cross_references.description_en: Dong Zhongshu inherited and transformed Confucius thought, cosmologizing and theologizing it, elevating Confucius from teacher to suwang, founding the Han dynasty classic tradition.

cross_references.description_zh: 司马迁与董仲舒在太学论辩天命与人事：董主张天人感应、灾异谴告，司马迁则在肯定天道存在的同时更强调人事的自主性。
cross_references.description_en: Sima Qian debate with Dong Zhongshu at the Grand Academy on Heaven and Human Affairs: Dong advocated heaven-human resonance and disaster warnings, while Sima Qian affirmed cosmic order yet emphasized human agency.

cross_references.description_zh: 董仲舒为汉武帝提供独尊儒术的意识形态蓝图，贾谊早于董仲舒提出礼义教化的重要性，二人共同奠定汉儒正统的理论基础。
cross_references.description_en: Dong Zhongshu provided Emperor Wu exclusive Confucianism ideological blueprint, while Jia Yi earlier emphasized ritual教化 importance; together they laid theoretical foundation for Han Confucian orthodoxy.

cross_references.description_zh: 王充在论衡中以经验验证批判董仲舒的天人感应论，主张天道自然而非天有意志，形成汉代最重要的唯物论反题。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chong used empirical verification in Lunheng to critique Dong heaven-human resonance theory, advocating natural cosmic way rather than heaven has will, forming most important materialist counter-thesis of Han dynasty.

cross_references.description_zh: 班固在汉书中系统记载董仲舒的思想贡献，继承并发展了董氏公羊学的史学传统，使董仲舒成为汉代经学的标志性人物。
cross_references.description_en: Ban Gu systematically recorded Dong Zhongshu contributions in Han Shu, inheriting and developing the Gongyang school historiography tradition, establishing Dong as标志性 figure of Han dynasty经典学.

cross_references.description_zh: 董仲舒以天人感应神学化儒家，葛洪则以道教神仙体系建构替代儒家政治神学，代表了汉代思想多元竞争的不同路径。
cross_references.description_en: Dong Zhongshu theologized Confucianism through heaven-human resonance, while Ge Hong constructed alternative through Daoist immortality systems, representing diverse competing paths in Han intellectual pluralism.

cross_references.description_zh: 王充以气论自然主义解构董仲舒的天人感应神学，主张天地合气万物自生，构成汉代儒学与自然主义的深刻对话。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chong deconstructed Dong heaven-human theological system through qi-naturalism, advocating heaven and earth combine qi for spontaneous generation, forming profound dialogue between Han Confucianism and naturalism.

C-DZS-001.description_zh: 将天象变化与人间政治建立因果对应关系。董仲舒认为天是有意志的最高主宰，通过灾异祥瑞表达对君主施政的肯定或警示。核心命题：天之道，人之道一也。

C-DZS-002.description_zh: 以春秋经义论证政治统一与思想统一的必然性。核心命题：《春秋》大一统者，天地之常经，古今之通谊也。

C-DZS-003.description_zh: 以阴阳宇宙论为三纲五常提供形上学论证。核心命题：王道之三纲，可求于天。

C-DZS-004.description_zh: 将人性划分为圣人之性、中民之性、斗筲之性三等。核心命题：性有善质，而未能以为善也。

C-DZS-005.description_zh: 主张以道德教化为主、刑罚为辅。核心命题：阳为德，阴为刑，刑主杀而德主生。

C-DZS-006.description_zh: 将天置于君之上的最高仲裁者位置，以灾异说制约君权。核心命题：屈民而伸君，屈君而伸天。

C-DZS-007.description_zh: 以阳尊阴卑的宇宙论原理为社会等级秩序提供哲学论证。核心命题：阳尊阴卑，天之制也。

C-DZS-008.description_zh: 以教化作为人性改造的核心手段。核心命题：质朴之谓性，性非教化不成。

C-DZS-009.description_zh: 将奉天法古作为政治合法性的双重来源，提出三统循环历史哲学。核心命题：承天意以从事。

C-DZS-010.description_zh: 以行为动机而非外在结果作为道德评判和法律裁断的首要依据。核心命题：本其事而原其志。

C-DZS-001E.description_en: Establish causal correspondence between cosmic phenomena and human governance. Core proposition: The Way of Heaven and the Way of humanity are one.

C-DZS-002E.description_en: Demonstrate the necessity of political and ideological unity through Spring and Autumn doctrine. Core proposition: The Great Unity is the constant principle of heaven and earth.

C-DZS-003E.title_en: Three Bonds and Five Constants Method
C-DZS-003E.description_en: Provide metaphysical grounding for ethical order through Yin-Yang cosmology. Core proposition: The three bonds of the royal way can be sought in Heaven.

C-DZS-004E.title_en: Three Grades of Human Nature Method
C-DZS-004E.description_en: Classify human nature into three grades: sages, common people, and incapable. Core proposition: Nature has goodness potential but cannot yet be called good.

C-DZS-005E.description_en: Advocate virtue-primacy and punishment-auxiliary as governing strategy. Core proposition: Yang is virtue, yin is punishment.

C-DZS-006E.description_en: Position Heaven above the ruler as ultimate arbiter, checking imperial authority through disaster warnings.

C-DZS-007E.description_en: Use cosmological principle to justify social hierarchical order. Core proposition: Yang superior, yin inferior is Heaven ordinance.

C-DZS-008E.description_en: Position education as core mechanism for human nature transformation. Core proposition: Innate disposition is nature, but nature cannot become virtue without education.

C-DZS-009E.title_en: Emulate Heaven and Follow Antiquity Method
C-DZS-009E.description_en: Establish following Heaven and emulating antiquity as dual source of political legitimacy. Core proposition: Receive Heaven will and act accordingly.

C-DZS-010E.description_en: Use behavioral motive as primary criterion for moral judgment and legal adjudication. Core proposition: Examine the facts and trace the intent.

cross_references.description_zh: 伊本·西那把亚里士多德的'四因分析'推向存在论层面：追问'存在'本身的地位——本质与存在的区分使'亚里士多德的存在类概念'被彻底重构。中世纪拉丁学者是通过伊本·西那的透镜读到亚里士多德的，阿奎那的'本质与存在'学说几乎是阿维森纳框架的基督教化改写。
cross_references.description_en: Ibn Sina pushed Aristotle's four-cause analysis to the ontological level—asking about the status of 'existence' itself. The essence-existence distinction thoroughly reconfigured Aristotle's conception of being; Latin scholastics read Aristotle through Avicennian lenses, and Aquinas's essence-existence doctrine is nearly a Christianized rewrite of the Avicennian framework.

cross_references.description_zh: 商羯罗与伊本·西那相隔约两百年，却互为'绝对一元论'的东西镜像：商羯罗以'梵我同一'吞并多，世界被降为摩耶幻现；伊本·西那以'流溢层级'安置多，世界是从必然存在者必然溢出的实在层级。面对同一问题——'绝对唯一者如何给出多'——一个以幻现取消世界的实在性，一个以流溢赋予世界层级的实在性，构成'幻现一元论'与'流溢一元论'的对极。
cross_references.description_en: Separated by two centuries, Shankara and Ibn Sina mirror each other as East and West versions of absolute monism: Shankara absorbs the many into Brahman-Atman, the world demoted to maya's appearance; Ibn Sina accommodates the many in an emanation hierarchy, the world as a real tiered overflow from the Necessary Existent. To the same problem—'how does the absolutely One give the many'—one cancels the world's reality by appearance, the other confers tiered reality by emanation.

cross_references.description_zh: 伊本·鲁世德以'回到亚里士多德本身'为纲领，用三级评注体系把亚里士多德从新柏拉图主义的流溢说框架中剥离出来，论证《论原因》并非亚里士多德所作——他主张亚里士多德的学说是人类理智所能达到的最高点，其论证无需修补即可与启示相容；拉丁西方正是通过他的评注读到'真正的亚里士多德'。
cross_references.description_en: With 'back to Aristotle himself' as his program, Averroes used the three-tier commentary system to strip Aristotle from the Neoplatonic frame of emanationism and demonstrated that the Liber de Causis was not Aristotle's—the claim that Aristotle's doctrine is the summit of human intellect, needing no patch to accord with revelation, brought the Latin West its 'real Aristotle' through his commentaries.

cross_references.description_zh: 与安萨里的世纪对决：安萨里《哲学家的矛盾》以二十题清算希腊化理性主义并解构因果必然性；八十年后伊本·鲁世德以《矛盾的矛盾》逐题反驳（同构的内部批判作业），重立因果必然论与哲学合法性，M-IBR-003 与 M-GHZ-003 互为镜像：一个把'必然'拆解为神圣常道，一个把'必然'从理性秩序中重建。
cross_references.description_en: A century duel with al-Ghazali: al-Ghazali's Incoherence reckoned with Hellenized rationalism in twenty propositions and deconstructed causal necessity; eighty years later Averroes's Incoherence of the Incoherence rebutted question by question (isomorphic internal critique), restoring causal necessity and philosophy's license—M-IBR-003 and M-GHZ-003 mirror each other: one dissolves 'necessity' into divine custom, the other rebuilds it from rational order.

cross_references.description_zh: 与香农的信息论对照：香农把'信息'从语义中剥离，只度量传输的不确定性；伊本·鲁世德把'真理'统一于实在而把冲突定位在表达层——两者都在做'分层'：一个把信道与语义分层（编码定理因此可能），一个把演示/辩证/修辞分层（受众适配因此可能）——两种'分辨率工程学'相隔八百年。
cross_references.description_en: An epistemic contrast with Claude Shannon: Shannon stripped 'information' from semantics, measuring only transmission uncertainty; Averroes unified truth in reality while locating conflict at the level of expression—both do 'layering': Shannon separates channel from meaning (making coding theorems possible), Averroes separates demonstration, dialectic, and rhetoric (making audience-fit possible)—two 'resolution engineerings' eight centuries apart.

cross_references.description_zh: 与伊本·鲁世德的世纪对决：《哲学家的矛盾》二十题清算与解构因果必然性，八十年后《矛盾的矛盾》逐题反驳重立必然论——理性主义与苏菲-凯拉姆传统的正面交锋，M-GHZ-003 与伊本·鲁世德因果必然论互为镜像。
cross_references.description_en: A century duel with Averroes: the Incoherence's twenty-proposition reckoning deconstructed causal necessity; eighty years later the Incoherence of the Incoherence rebutted point by point and restored necessity—the head-on clash of rationalism with the Sufi-kalam tradition; M-GHZ-003 and Averroes's necessitarianism mirror each other.

cross_references.description_zh: 与笛卡尔的平行先声：《迷途指津》的怀疑—重建程序早于《第一哲学沉思集》约五百年，同一程序在两个文明独立出现，方法论怀疑结构的比较研究经典案例。
cross_references.description_en: A parallel anticipation of Descartes: al-Munqidh's doubt-then-rebuild sequence predates the Meditations by some five centuries; the same program arising independently in two civilizations is a classic case for comparative study of methodic doubt.

cross_references.description_zh: 与荀子的认识论对照：两者都认定'求知先于修己'、都把主体条件作为知识的前置门槛——一个把主体改造交给礼义师法，一个交给苏菲净化阶梯——两大传统的'认识主体工程学'。
cross_references.description_en: An epistemic contrast with Xunzi: both insist self-cultivation precedes knowing and make subject-conditions the gate of knowledge—one entrusts remaking the subject to ritual and teachers, the other to the Sufi purification ladder—two traditions of 'epistemic subject engineering'.

cross_references.description_zh: 安萨里《迷途指津》（约1108年）记录的'从怀疑感官到怀疑理性、最终抵达不可怀疑的明晰性'的怀疑—重建程序，比笛卡尔《第一哲学沉思集》（1641年）早约五百年；比较哲学界常并置研究二者。本档案 M-DKR-001 与安萨里 M-GHZ-001 互为镜像：安萨里以苏菲体验收束怀疑，笛卡尔以'我思'与明证性收束怀疑。安萨里档案的 H-DKR-001 跨引用条目即指向本档案。
伊本·西那'悬浮人'（Floating Man）思想实验：设想人凭空而造、感官全闭，仍必确证自我存在——这是'我思'论证的阿拉伯前声。笛卡尔经拉丁经院哲学（阿维森纳主义）间接承接此结构，将其从'自我确证'扩展为'普遍怀疑后的第一支点'，并成为整个近代认识论的出发点。

cross_references.description_zh: 与伊本·西那的医学系统论镜像：伊本·西那以《医典》把医学组织为'原理-药物-疾病-疗法'的四分百科，以七则药物检验法逼近对照实验；张仲景以六经辨证把临床组织为状态机、以方证对应实现诊断-治疗闭环。二人相隔约八个世纪、互不知晓，却独立收敛于同一答案：医学要成为科学，先要成为系统。
cross_references.description_en: A mirror of medical systematization: Ibn Sina organized medicine as a fourfold encyclopedia in the Canon with seven drug-testing rules approximating controlled trials; Zhang Zhongjing organized the clinic as a state machine via the six meritians and closed the diagnosis-treatment loop through formula-pattern correspondence. Eight centuries apart and mutually unknowing, they converged independently on the same answer: for medicine to become a science it must first become a system.

cross_references.description_zh: 与司马迁的'书写者'对偶：司马迁以列传体为人物立传，仲景以条文体为疾病立传——两种文体的共同内核是'以文本对抗遗忘'。差异在立场：史家面向读者叙事，医家面向同行发布可复现规程；司马迁写别人，仲景写自己的实验记录。二者合观，构成中国'知识存续'的文史两翼。
cross_references.description_en: A duality of the text-preservation stance: Sima Qian wrote biographies of people in narrative form; Zhang Zhongjing wrote 'biographies' of diseases in clause form—the shared core is 'fighting oblivion with text.' The stances differ: the historian narrates for readers; the physician publishes reproducible protocols for peers; one wrote others, the other wrote his own experiment log. Together they form the literary and scientific wings of knowledge survival in China.

cross_references.description_zh: 与张仪的棋盘对偶：张仪在多国棋盘上建模对手的联盟结构并逐国拆解，仲景在人体棋盘上建模疾病的传变结构并逐经拦截——同为'状态机思维'，一个用于外交博弈，一个用于临床演进。张仪的杠杆是信息不对称，仲景的杠杆是疾病规律的可预测性；一个操纵别人的判断，一个预测自然的进程。
cross_references.description_en: A board-game duality with Zhang Yi: on the multi-state chessboard Zhang Yi modeled opponents' coalition structures and dismantled them state by state; on the human-body board Zhang Zhongjing modeled the disease's transmission structure and intercepted it meridian by meridian—both state-machine thinking, one for diplomacy, one for clinical evolution. Zhang Yi's lever was information asymmetry; Zhang Zhongjing's was the predictability of disease law—one manipulates judgments, the other forecasts natural processes.

cross_references.description_zh: 与张仲景的系统化镜像：仲景把临床组织为六经状态机、以方证对应闭环验证；沈括把自然知识组织为条目数据库、以实验与器物闭环验证。一个面向疾病建模，一个面向天地取证，共同回答同一个问题：如何让经验成为可复核的系统。
cross_references.description_en: A mirror of systematization: Zhang Zhongjing organized the clinic as a six-meridian state machine closed by formula-pattern verification; Shen Kuo organized natural knowledge as an entry database closed by experiment and artifacts. One models disease, the other interrogates heaven and earth—both answer the same question: how to make experience a checkable system.

cross_references.description_zh: 与司马迁的存续同盟：司马迁以列传为人物立传，沈括以条目为技艺立传——毕昇正史不载而赖《笔谈》留名，与太史公为刺客游侠立传同一逻辑：正史遗忘的，由另一种文体收容。
cross_references.description_en: An alliance of preservation with Sima Qian: the Grand Historian wrote biographies of people; Shen Kuo wrote biographies of techniques—commoner Bi Sheng lives only in the Brush Talks, by the same logic that gave assassins and wanderers their chapter: what official history forgets, another genre shelters.

cross_references.description_zh: 与伊本·西那的百科全书式镜像：伊本·西那以《医典》整理医学为体系，沈括以《笔谈》整理整个经验世界为体系；二人相隔约一个世纪、互不知晓，同为跨域百科的建造者——证据：二人都坚持一手观察高于转述。
cross_references.description_en: An encyclopedist's mirror with Ibn Sina: the Canon systematized medicine; the Brush Talks systematized the whole empirical world. A century apart and mutually unknowing, both were builders of cross-domain encyclopedias—and both held first-hand observation above transmitted texts.

cross_references.description_zh: 与沈括的实证镜像：沈括以亲验裁决文献之争于天地万物，贾思勰以'验之行事'裁决农书之争于田间地头——两人相隔五百年，不约而同把'亲手做过'置于'书上写过'之上，共同确立'行事高于经传'的中国实证传统。
cross_references.description_en: An empiricist mirror with Shen Kuo: Shen adjudicated textual disputes against heaven and earth, Jia adjudicated agricultural disputes against the field—five centuries apart, both place 'having done it' above 'having read it,' jointly establishing the Chinese empiricist tradition of deeds over texts.

cross_references.description_zh: 与司马迁的存续同盟：太史公为人物立传使失败者留名，贾思勰以九百余条佚文使已佚农书留魂——《氾胜之书》《四民月令》皆赖《要术》存其骨干，与正史不载刺客而赖《史记》同一逻辑：正典遗忘的，由另一种文体收容。
cross_references.description_en: A preservation alliance with Sima Qian: the Grand Historian's biographies gave the failed a name; Jia's nine hundred quoted fragments gave lost agricultural books a soul—the Fansheng zhi Shu and Simin Yueling survive inside the Yaoshu, by the same logic that shelters the forgotten in another genre.

cross_references.description_zh: 与张仲景的经典化镜像：仲景把临床经验定著为《伤寒杂病论》的方证规程使其千年可复用，贾思勰把农业手艺定著为《齐民要术》的定量规程使其千年可复现——一个为医病立法，一个为养民立法，同是'把个人经验铸成公共规程'的文献机器。
cross_references.description_en: A canonization mirror with Zhang Zhongjing: Zhang fixed clinical experience into formula-pattern protocols reusable across a millennium; Jia fixed farming craft into quantified protocols reproducible across a millennium—one legislated for healing, one for feeding; both are literary machines casting personal experience into public protocols.

cross_references.description_zh: 与荀子的师承改造：荀子以'性恶'立论而归于礼治教化——人性恶是道德工程的起点；韩非把同一前提推到底：既然性恶，则礼乐教化是脆弱的，唯有赏罚利害才能稳定导出秩序。师徒二人共享'人性趋利'的缺省假设，一个押注教化可胜之，一个押注制度可算之——儒家工程与法家工程的分岔点。
cross_references.description_en: A teacher transformed: Xunzi argued human nature is bad yet bet on ritual and education to redeem it; Han Fei pushed the same premise to its end—if nature is bad, ritual is fragile and only interest-calibrated sanctions stably produce order. Master and student share the self-interest baseline; one bets education wins, the other bets institutions compute—the fork between Confucian and Legalist engineering.

cross_references.description_zh: 与商鞅的制度综合：商君重'法'——公开成文的赏罚使秦国强盛但'徒法而无术'，终为张仪甘茂之流窃权；韩非在《定法》中逐条诊断其偏，把'法'纳入'法术势'三位一体的完整机器——商鞅提供了引擎，韩非提供了整车设计。
cross_references.description_en: A synthesis of Shang Yang: Shang Yang's 'law' made Qin strong, yet 'law without technique' let capable ministers usurp leverage; in 'Determining the Two,' Han Fei diagnoses the deficiency line by line and folds law into the complete law-technique-power machine—Shang Yang built the engine; Han Fei designed the whole car.

cross_references.description_zh: 与张仲景的诊籍镜像：仲景以六经辨证把疾病编码为可复用状态，韩非以《八奸》《七术》《亡征》把国家病理编码为可对照的症状清单——一个为病立法，一个为国立法，同是'把无穷病例穷举为有限条目'的诊断工程。
cross_references.description_en: A diagnostic mirror with Zhang Zhongjing: Zhang encoded diseases into reusable six-meridian states; Han Fei encoded state pathology into checkable symptom lists ('Eight Deceits,' 'Seven Techniques,' 'Marks of Ruin')—one legislated for disease, one for states; both are diagnostic projects exhausting infinite cases into finite entries.

cross_references.description_zh: 与张仲景的医学正典镜像：仲景以《伤寒杂病论》把临床经验定著为方证规程，李时珍以《本草纲目》把千年药物知识重整为纲目体系——一个为辨证立法，一个为药物立法，共同构成中国医学'临床端+药物端'两部正典；且李时珍自言撰纲目时'采其方附于条'，附方栏大量取自仲景方。
cross_references.description_en: A medieval-canon mirror with Zhang Zhongjing: Zhongjing fixed clinical experience into syndrome-formula protocols in the Treatise on Cold Damage; Li Shizhen reorganized a millennium of drug knowledge into the gang-mu system in the Compendium—one legislating for diagnosis, the other for drugs, together forming the two canons of Chinese medicine's clinical and pharmacological ends; Li himself 'adopted their formulas beneath each entry,' drawing heavily on Zhongjing's prescriptions.

cross_references.description_zh: 与沈括的实证镜像：沈括以'亲验'裁决天地万物之疑（《梦溪笔谈》），李时珍以'予尝试之'裁决药物之疑（曼陀罗自试、穿山甲解剖）——相隔五百年的两位博物学家同持'实证高于传闻'的裁决标准，一个广及物理天文，一个专精草木虫鱼。
cross_references.description_en: An empiricist mirror with Shen Kuo: Shen adjudicated doubts about heaven, earth, and things by personal testing (Brush Talks); Li adjudicated doubts about drugs with 'I have tried it' (the datura self-trial, the pangolin dissection)—two naturalists five centuries apart holding the same standard of evidence over hearsay, one spanning physics and astronomy, the other mastering plants, insects, and fish.

cross_references.description_zh: 与屠呦呦的方法论血脉：屠呦呦从葛洪《肘后备急方》'青蒿一握，以水二升渍'获得低温提取的关键启发，其'文献考据→工艺破解→交叉验证→标准化'路径与李时珍'渔猎群书→亲验访采→正误辨疑→附方落底'的范式同构——一部《本草纲目》的检索架构使'按图索骥式的文献启发'在四百年后依然可行。
cross_references.description_en: A methodological bloodline to Tu Youyou: Tu's breakthrough came from Ge Hong's 'a handful of qinghao steeped in two sheng of water'—her path of textual excavation, process crack, cross-validation, and standardization is isomorphic with Li's harvest-the-libraries, field-verification, error-correction, prescription-anchoring; the compendium's retrieval architecture made 'follow-the-clue textual inspiration' still workable four centuries later.

cross_references.relation_type: 德力两极：真理之力与刑名之力的对照
cross_references.description_zh: 韩非与甘地同为'弱者如何在大结构中行动'的方法论家，但给出的答案在德力两极：韩非以参验核言、法术势一体把秩序建立在可计算的强力与制度上，认为人性趋利避害、道德感化不可依赖；甘地以萨提亚格拉哈把秩序建立在可验证的真理与自苦上，认为强权的根基是被治者的合作、故撤回合作即可撼动。两人在'言辞裁决'上意外同构——韩非要求'循名实而定是非，因参验而审言辞'，甘地要求任何诉求'公开、可验、经不起对账即撤回'——一个是把真相当证据链，一个是把真相当信用本位。差异在对手假设：韩非的机器假设人性不可改造故只能驯化，甘地的假设对手良知可唤醒故只做转化。本档案 M-GAN-001（萨提亚格拉哈）与韩非档案 M-HFZ-001（参验核言法）构成'弱者方法论的德力对照链'。

cross_references.relation_type: 非暴力人道主义的两代接力（道德压强 vs 制度建构）
cross_references.description_zh: 宋庆龄与甘地同以道德而非武力为政治的根本资源：宋庆龄以国际主义与人道主义立场把中国问题转写为世界良知问题，甘地以非暴力把印度问题转写为'帝国良知对自身不义'的问题——两人都精通'把国内斗争翻译成世界语言'。差异在落点：宋庆龄的路径是制度建构与国际组织（保卫中国同盟、福利会），甘地的路径是群众自苦与村社建设；宋庆龄面对的对手常需被消灭（法西斯、侵略），甘地的对手被设定为可转化。本档案 M-GAN-003（自苦感化）与 M-GAN-006（道德规范统一战线）与宋庆龄档案的博爱法与国际主义团结法构成'道德压强与制度建构'的互补对照链。

cross_references.relation_type: 改造主体先于改造世界的两端（礼义师法 vs 自苦修行）
cross_references.description_zh: 荀子与甘地在方法论深处同构：都认定政治问题首先是主体问题——荀子以'化性起伪'把乱世的根源归于人性之恶需要礼义师法的改造，甘地把运动的失败归于群众'尚未配得上非暴力'需要自苦修行的改造；两人都把'改造人'置于'改造制度'之前，都以教育、纪律与日常操练（礼的习练/纺车与宣誓）为改造手段。差异在改造的媒介：荀子靠外在规范（礼义师法之化），甘地靠内在自觉（真理之光照）；荀子的改造由师与国家推动（自上而下），甘地的改造由自省与共同体推动（自下而上）。本档案 M-GAN-005（自我净化纠错）与 M-GAN-007（纺车群众路线）与荀子档案的礼义师法构成'主体改造工程学'的跨文明对照链。
cross_references.description_en: 荀子与甘地在方法论深处同构：都认定政治问题首先是主体问题——荀子以'化性起伪'把乱世的根源归于人性之恶需要礼义师法的改造，甘地把运动的失败归于群众'尚未配得上非暴力'需要自苦修行的改造；两人都把'改造人'置于'改造制度'之前，都以教育、纪律与日常操练（礼的习练/纺车与宣誓）为改造手段。差异在改造的媒介：荀子靠外在规范（礼义师法之化），甘地靠内在自觉（真理之光照）；荀子的改造由师与国家推动（自上而下），甘地的改造由自省与共同体推动（自下而上）。本档案 M-GAN-005（自我净化纠错）与 M-GAN-007（纺车群众路线）与荀子档案的礼义师法构成'主体改造工程学'的跨文明对照链。

cross_references.relation_type: 弱者方法论接力：抗争之问与胜后之问
cross_references.description_zh: 甘地与曼德拉同属'弱者如何在大结构中行动'的谱系，但各答一问：甘地答'弱者如何翻转强权'——以 satyagraha 把受苦变论证、以撤回合作瓦解统治合法性；曼德拉答'翻转之后如何不自毁'——以包容阵线收编旧敌、以自我限权防止解放者神化。两人在'纪律'上同构：甘地以乔里·乔拉事件中止整个运动（宁失 momentum 不失方法纯度），曼德拉以1990年后压下'人民战争'升级（宁缓胜利不失谈判信号可信度）。差异在对手观：甘地的对手是可唤醒的共同受难者，曼德拉的对手是可切分定价的利益体——前者向对手的良知要胜利，后者向对手的利益要胜利。本档案 M-MAN-002（胜利者包容阵线）与甘地档案 M-GAN-007（道德规范统一战线）构成'对抗阵线 vs 包容阵线'的对照链。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 甘地档案未来修订时可在 M-GAN-007 处补一条指向 H-MAN-002 的跨引用（对抗阵线与包容阵线的接力对照）。

cross_references.relation_type: 权力哲学两极：自我限权与法术势
cross_references.description_zh: 韩非与曼德拉都在回答'权力如何才安全'，但方向相反：韩非把安全寄托在'术'——君主深藏不露、以参验控制臣下，权力靠信息不对称与制度设计自固；曼德拉把安全寄托在'让渡'——主动卸任、公开自贬、以认错赎回公信，权力靠可核查的自我削弱而免于神化与政变。韩非的模型里领袖的软弱即是国祸，曼德拉的模型里领袖的恋栈才是国祸。两人在'威胁识别'上意外同构——韩非列'八奸''亡征'，曼德拉识别'big man 终身执政'是非洲解放运动的头号亡征——各自开出的药方（控制臣下 vs 限制自己）构成 Protreptic 中'权力安全'的一对镜像。本档案 M-MAN-003（掌权者自我限权法）与韩非档案 M-HFZ-001 构成对照链。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 韩非档案未来修订时可在 M-HFZ-001 处补一条指向 H-MAN-003 的跨引用（控制臣下与限制自身的镜像药方）。

cross_references.relation_type: 和解与和平的政治工程对照
cross_references.description_zh: 宋庆龄与曼德拉都以'个人声望作为政治中间件'运作：宋庆龄以孙夫人身份在国共之间做'桥'（保盟的中间人政治、1948年后对民革的号召力），曼德拉以囚徒-总统的双重身份在黑白之间做'桥'（1995橄榄球、TRC的政治担保）。两人的共同签名是'以道德信用担保不可担保之事'——宋庆龄担保左翼与中间派的合作，曼德拉担保白人阵营的转型安全。差异在制度产出：宋庆龄的桥多止于个人信道的维护（晚年以纪念机构存续），曼德拉的桥沉淀为宪法结构（民族团结政府、TRC、双声部国歌）。本档案 M-MAN-001/M-MAN-007 与宋庆龄档案构成'桥型政治人物'的方法对照。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 宋庆龄档案未来修订时可在跨引用处补一条指向 H-MAN-001（个人信用担保与宪法化沉淀的对照）。

cross_references.relation_type: 经济版本 vs 哲学表述：市民社会的两位作者
cross_references.description_zh: 斯密与黑格尔是'市民社会'概念的共同作者，各写一半：斯密以《国富论》给出经济版本——'互通有无、以物易物'的普遍交换如何自发生成秩序、如何不需要仁爱也能让陌生人合作（'看不见的手'）；黑格尔读斯密（经斯图亚特与李嘉图的转译）后给出哲学表述——在《法哲学原理》中把'需要的体系'（System der Bedürfnisse）立为伦理生活的中间环节，但立即补上斯密未及处理的两个后果：劳动的异化与'贱民'（Pöbel）的生成，并把解药交给警察与同业公会而非市场本身。两人共享同一底层判断：秩序可以是人造物的涌现而非主权的直接设计；分歧在边界——斯密信任交换的自我修复力，黑格尔认定纯粹市场必然生产它自身无法消化的贫困与依附，须由伦理国家接住。Protreptic 中，M-ASM-002（看不见的手）与黑格尔档案的'市民社会辩证法'构成'市场自发秩序 vs 伦理国家中介'的对照链，两者合并阅读才是完整的市民社会理论。
cross_references.description_en: Smith and Hegel are co-authors of the concept of 'civil society,' each writing one half of it. Smith supplies the economic version: how the universal propensity to truck and barter generates order spontaneously, and how strangers can cooperate without benevolence (the 'invisible hand'). Hegel, reading Smith through Steuart and Ricardo, supplies the philosophical formulation: in the Philosophy of Right the 'system of needs' becomes the middle moment of ethical life, but Hegel immediately adds the two consequences Smith had not worked out—labour's alienation and the generation of the rabble (Pöbel)—and hands the remedy to police and corporations rather than the market itself. The two share one underlying judgment: order can be the emergent product of human artifice rather than a direct design of sovereignty. They differ at the boundary: Smith trusts exchange's self-repair, while Hegel holds that the pure market necessarily produces poverty and dependence it cannot digest, which the ethical state must catch. In Protreptic, M-ASM-002 and Hegel's dialectic of civil society form the contrast chain 'spontaneous market order vs. ethical-state mediation,' and only read together do they yield a complete theory of civil society.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 黑格尔档案未来修订时可在'市民社会/需要的体系'处补一条指向 H-ASM-001（M-ASM-002）的跨引用（经济版本与哲学表述的对照）。

cross_references.relation_type: 启蒙同代：共感的道德与义务的道德
cross_references.description_zh: 斯密（1723-1790）与康德（1724-1804）几乎同龄，同属启蒙的'方法自觉一代'，且康德极可能读过《道德情操论》——学界长期争论其'尊重'（Achtung）概念与斯密'公正旁观者'的亲缘。两人都在回答'道德如何可能'，却从相反的引擎出发：斯密把道德建在想象性共感上——我通过把自己放入你的处境、把旁观者放入我与你的之间而判断善恶，道德是社会的、可错的、逐例演化的；康德把道德建在纯形式的义务上——定言命令不依赖任何情感与任何具体处境，道德是先验的、无例外的。这一对照在 Protreptic 中极具方法论价值：斯密的路径说明道德判断可以像分工一样在'换位'中专业化（公正旁观者即内化的第三方），康德的路径说明道德判断可以像公理一样脱离经验而成立；M-ASM-003（同情共感与公正旁观者）与康德档案的定言命令构成'共感伦理 vs 义务伦理'的对照链。此外两人在'目的-手段'上暗合：康德'人是目的'与斯密'富国裕民'（wealth 是手段，人是目的）共享对把人当工具的拒绝。
cross_references.description_en: Smith (1723-1790) and Kant (1724-1804) were near-contemporaries in the Enlightenment's 'method-conscious generation,' and Kant very likely read The Theory of Moral Sentiments—scholars have long debated the kinship between his concept of respect (Achtung) and Smith's 'impartial spectator.' Both ask how morality is possible, but from opposite engines: Smith grounds morality in imaginative sympathy—I judge by placing myself in your situation and a spectator between us—and morality is social, fallible, and case-by-case; Kant grounds it in pure formal duty—the categorical command depends on no feeling and no situation, and morality is a priori and exceptionless. This contrast is methodologically valuable for Protreptic: Smith's route shows moral judgment can specialize in 'position-taking' the way labour divides (the impartial spectator is an internalized third party), while Kant's shows it can stand outside experience like an axiom; M-ASM-003 and the categorical imperative form the contrast chain of sympathy-ethics vs. duty-ethics. The two also converge on ends and means: Kant's 'persons as ends' and Smith's opulence as a means to human flourishing share the refusal to treat people as instruments.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 康德档案未来修订时可在'道德情感与尊重'处补一条指向 H-ASM-001（M-ASM-003）的跨引用（公正旁观者与定言命令的同代对照）。

cross_references.relation_type: 德力对照：富国强兵 vs 富民自由
cross_references.description_zh: 商君与斯密是'国家财富观'的两极模板，中间隔着两千年与整个政治哲学：商君把财富从属于国家能力——'国富而贫治'，民须弱、须愚、须专于农战，财富与勤劳是喂养战争机器的燃料，'利出一孔'使全社会只有一个向上通道；斯密把国家能力从属于财富——'富国裕民'，财富的源泉在民间'私人的节俭与良好操守'，主权者被压缩到国防、司法、公共工程三义务，'利出一孔'的反面是'利出万孔'的自然自由体系。两人在方法上却惊人地同构：都从'人性恒常'出发（商君'民之性，饥而求食'；斯密'自爱、互通有无'），都把制度设计为对人性的机械式响应而非道德劝勉，都警惕既得利益集团对政策机器的俘获（商君治官吏之'数'；斯密警告同业密谋与商人游说）。差异在财富的目的论：商君的富国是为了战，斯密的富国是为了民——'消费是一切生产的唯一目的'与商君'民弱国强'正相对照。Protreptic 中，M-ASM-006（节俭积累与富人之源）与商君(H-SY-001)档案的农战/利出一孔构成'富民 vs 富国'的对照链。
cross_references.description_en: Shang Yang and Smith are the two polar templates of 'national wealth,' separated by two millennia and an entire political philosophy. Shang Yang subordinates wealth to state capacity—'enrich the state and keep the people poor,' keep the people weak, simple, and locked into agriculture and war, with 'benefits flowing from a single channel' so all society has one ladder upward; Smith subordinates state capacity to wealth—opulence is the end, its source is the private 'frugality and good conduct of individuals,' the sovereign is compressed to three duties (defence, justice, public works), and the anti-single-channel is the natural liberty of ten thousand outlets. Yet in method they are startlingly isomorphic: both start from constant human nature (Shang Yang: 'the people by nature seek food when hungry'; Smith: self-love and the truck-and-barter propensity), both design institutions as mechanical responses to human nature rather than moral exhortation, and both warn of vested interests capturing the policy machine. The difference lies in wealth's telos: Shang Yang enriches the state for war, Smith for the people—'consumption is the sole end and purpose of all production' stands directly against 'the people weak, the state strong.' In Protreptic, M-ASM-006 and Shang Yang's farming-war/single-channel modes form the contrast chain 'enrich the people vs. enrich the state.'
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 商君档案未来修订时可在'利出一孔/农战'处补一条指向 H-ASM-001（M-ASM-006）的跨引用（富国强兵与富民自由的对照）。
