modes.domain_zh: 哲学方法论/把理性形式与心理结构还原为人类漫长实践的沉淀物：社会性沉淀为个体性，历史沉淀为心理，理性沉淀为感性——一切'先验'皆为凝缩的'后验'
modes.domain_en: Philosophical methodology / reducing rational forms and psychic structures to sediments of long human practice: the social settles into the individual, history into the psyche, reason into the senses — every 'a priori' is a condensed 'a posteriori'
modes.definition_zh: 哲学方法论/李泽厚把康德'先验认识形式'的问题改写为发生学问题：那些仿佛先于个体的逻辑范畴、审美形式与道德律令，并非天赋，而是人类百万年使用工具、协作劳动、结成语言共同体的实践中反复操作、反复巩固、最终凝缩下来的'积淀'——就像水滴石上留下钙层，实践在心理上留下结构；'积淀'不是一次性事实而是持续过程：每一代人的文化经验都再沉淀为下一代人的感知底层，因此审美才有时代性（先秦的狞厉之美、盛唐的丰满之美、宋元的淡远之美），理性才有历史性；方法论上要求：遇到任何'永恒''普遍''先验'之物，先问它的实践来源与沉淀层次——它沉淀于哪个时代、哪个群体、哪类活动之上
modes.definition_en: Philosophical methodology / Li Zehou rewrites Kant's question of 'a priori forms of knowledge' as a genetic question: the logical categories, aesthetic forms and moral laws that seem prior to the individual are not innate but 'sedimented' from a million years of practice — tool use, cooperative labour, linguistic community — operated and consolidated again and again until condensed into structure, as water leaves its calcareous layer on stone; 'sedimentation' is not a one-time fact but an ongoing process: each generation's cultural experience settles again into the perceptual ground of the next, hence the epochal character of taste (the grim beauty of the pre-Qin, the full beauty of High Tang, the pale distance of Song-Yuan) and the historicity of reason; methodologically: whenever confronting anything 'eternal', 'universal' or 'a priori', first ask its practical source and sedimentary stratum — upon which era, which group, which activity it settled
modes.source_chapter: 《批判哲学的批判》(1979) 与《美的历程》(1981)：'美是有意味的形式——它不是自然属性，而是人类社会实践中积淀下来的成果'
modes.key_quote_zh: 人类的心，是历史的地质层——你以为是直觉的，其实是经验；你以为是天性的，其实是文化；你以为是今天的，其实是百万年。
modes.key_quote_en: The human heart is a geological stratum of history — what seems intuition is experience; what seems nature is culture; what seems today's is a million years.
key_concepts: 积淀 sedimentation（实践的操作反复凝缩为心理结构——像水流沉积成地质层，'先验'是凝缩的'后验'）
sedimentation (repeated operations of practice condensed into psychic structure — 'a priori' is condensed 'a posteriori', as water deposits geological strata)
社会性先于个体性 the social precedes the individual（个体的感知、直觉与道德感都是群体历史的中介物——'两次出现定律'的哲学版）
the social precedes the individual (individual perception, intuition and moral sense are intermediaries of collective history — the philosophical version of the law of double appearance)
感性积淀的层次分层 stratification of the sensuous（工具-操作层→语言-逻辑层→审美-情感层：越深层越稳定，越表层越可变）
stratification of the sensuous (tool-operation layer, language-logic layer, aesthetic-emotional layer: the deeper the stratum the stabler, the shallower the more mutable)
发生学追问 genetic interrogation（对一切'永恒之物'先问：它沉淀于哪个时代、哪个群体、哪类实践——普遍性即最大跨度的历史性）
genetic interrogation (of every 'eternal' thing first ask: which era, which group, which practice — universality is historicity at its widest span)
process_zh: 锁定待解释的'先验之物'：一种逻辑范畴、一种审美偏好或一种道德直觉——承认它在个体身上确实'先天'有效
做发生学还原：追问它在人类历史中的实践原型——范畴来自操作秩序，形式感来自劳作与仪式，道德感来自协作约束
划分沉淀层次：区分其中稳定底层（百万年尺度）与易变表层（数百年尺度），说明'变'与'不变'各自的边界
回到当下：说明该沉淀结构如何继续塑造今人的直觉判断，以及新的实践正在沉淀什么新的结构
process_en: Pin down the 'a priori' to be explained: a logical category, an aesthetic preference, a moral intuition — admitting that in the individual it does operate as if innate

Run the genetic reduction: trace its practical prototype in human history — categories from operational order, the sense of form from labour and ritual, moral feeling from the constraints of cooperation
Divide the sedimentary strata: separate the stable depths (million-year scale) from the mutable surfaces (century scale), marking the boundaries of change and fixity
Return to the present: show how the sedimented structure still shapes contemporary intuition, and what new structures present practice is now depositing
representative_cases_zh: 《美的历程》对'龙飞凤舞'青铜狞厉之美的解读：饕餮纹的恐怖美不是怪癖，而是早期巫史时代'暴力—权威'实践的审美沉淀——它沉淀着'历史必然的力量'，后世才转化为凶神与装饰
《批判哲学的批判》对康德因果范畴的处理：因果性不是'心灵先验框架'而是人类在长期操作工具中反复体验的'前后相继的必然顺序'的积淀——休谟的心理习惯与康德的先验范畴被统一于实践
《华夏美学》对'礼乐'传统的处理：儒家的审美-伦理结构（温柔敦厚、中和之美）是数千年宗法农业社会协作秩序在情感形式上的沉淀——所以它能超越王朝存续而进入民族心理底层
representative_cases_en: The reading of the grim beauty of archaic bronzes in The Path of Beauty: the terror of the taotie mask not an eccentricity but the aesthetic sediment of the 'violence-authority' practice of the early shaman-historian age — depositing 'the force of historical necessity', transmuted only later into demon and ornament

The treatment of Kant's category of causality in Critique of Critical Philosophy: causality neither 'transcendental frame of mind' nor Humean habit, but the sediment of the necessary succession experienced in long operation of tools — Hume and Kant unified in practice

The treatment of the rites-and-music tradition in Chinese Aesthetics: the Confucian aesthetic-ethical structure (gentleness and truth, beauty of the mean) as the sediment on emotional form of millennia of patriarchal-agrarian cooperative order — hence outlasting dynasties into the depth of the national psyche
modern_applications_zh: 产品与品牌研究：把'用户直觉'当作沉淀层——功能操作沉淀为界面习惯，时代体验沉淀为审美偏好；改版失败常因误把'底层沉淀'当'表层装饰'去动
组织文化诊断：把'公司价值观'追问到其实践沉淀——哪类行为被反复奖励了几十年，才沉淀为'这就是我们做事方式'的直觉
个人成长方法论：把'天赋'重新解释为长期专注实践的积淀产物——与其寻找'先验优势'，不如设计能让优质经验反复沉淀的实践循环
modern_applications_en: Product and brand studies: treating 'user intuition' as a sedimentary layer — functional operations settle into interface habits, era-experience into aesthetic preference; redesigns fail by mistaking deep sediment for surface decoration

Organisational culture diagnosis: interrogating 'company values' down to their practical sediment — which behaviours were rewarded repeatedly for decades, settling into the intuition 'this is how we do things'
Personal growth methodology: reinterpreting 'talent' as the sediment of long focused practice — seek not a priori advantage but design cycles of practice in which good experience deposits repeatedly
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
康德（问题源头：'先验认识形式'——李泽厚用实践论将其发生学化）
马克思（实践论资源：以'使用工具的劳动'作为积淀的物质基础）

modes.domain_zh: 思想史方法论/把一个民族的思想文本当作其'文化心理结构'的切片：不问'谁说得对'，先问'这样说暴露了什么样的心理构造与生存处境'——从典章、范畴与文体的细节读出民族心灵的地形图
modes.domain_en: Methodology of intellectual history / treating a nation's texts as sections of its 'cultural-psychological structure': not first 'who is right' but 'what psychic construction and existential predicament does this way of speaking expose' — reading the map of a national mind from the details of canon, category and genre
modes.definition_zh: 思想史方法论/李泽厚写思想史的方法与一般哲学史不同：他不满足于罗列命题与师承，而是追问命题背后共有的'心理构造'——中国思想为何长于伦理短于逻辑、长于实用短于思辨、长于现世短于彼岸？他把答案落在'一个文化如何安顿其成员的存在'这一心理-生存结构上：'实用理性'是认识构造，'乐感文化'是情感构造，'一个世界'是宇宙构造；方法上要求：把文本的措辞、范畴的选择、文体的偏好都当作'心理证据'——孔子为何罕言性与天道？庄子为何以寓言代替论证？这些'沉默'与'绕行'比正面主张更暴露心灵的地形；思想史由此从'观念的谱系'变成'心理的地层学'
modes.definition_en: Methodology of intellectual history / Li Zehou's way of writing intellectual history differs from the general history of philosophy: not content to list propositions and lineages, he interrogates the shared 'psychic construction' behind the propositions — why is Chinese thought strong in ethics and weak in logic, strong in the practical and weak in the speculative, at home in this world and without a beyond? He locates the answer in the psycho-existential structure of 'how a culture shelters the existence of its members': 'practical reason' as cognitive construction, 'a culture of joy' as affective construction, 'one single world' as cosmological construction; methodologically: treat diction, choice of category and preference of genre all as 'psychological evidence' — why does Confucius seldom speak of human nature and the Way of Heaven? Why does Zhuangzi replace argument with fable? These silences and detours expose the terrain of the mind better than explicit doctrines; intellectual history thus becomes not a genealogy of ideas but a stratigraphy of the psyche
modes.source_chapter: 《中国古代思想史论》(1985) 总论：'中国哲学的实用性……表现为一种实用理性，即把理智的、逻辑的东西溶化在日常生活之中'
modes.key_quote_zh: 不问一个民族说了什么，先问它为何只这样说——沉默之处比宣言之处，更能照见心灵的形状。
modes.key_quote_en: Ask not what a nation said, but why it said only this — the places of silence mirror the shape of the soul better than the places of declaration.
key_concepts: 命题即症候 proposition as symptom（一个流行命题暴露的是它回应的心理需求——'天人合一'是农业文明对不确定性的安顿术）
proposition as symptom (a popular proposition exposes the psychic need it answers — 'unity of Heaven and man' as an agrarian civilisation's way of settling uncertainty)
沉默考据学 hermeneutics of silence（文本不谈什么与它谈什么同等重要——孔子罕言'性与天道'暴露了'一个世界'的现世取向）
hermeneutics of silence (what a text omits matters as much as what it states — Confucius's silence on human nature and Heaven exposing the this-worldly 'one world' orientation)
文体作为心理证据 genre as psychological evidence（经史子集的体裁等级、语录体的盛行、论文让位于注疏——文体史即心灵史的形式面）

genre as psychological evidence (the hierarchy of classics-histories-masters-collections, the prevalence of the recorded-saying form, commentary displacing treatise — the history of genre as the formal face of the history of mind)
结构高于学派 structure above school（儒法道释互相攻讦却共享同一心理底层——诊断要在学派分歧之下找结构共识）
structure above school (Confucians, Legalists, Daoists and Buddhists attack one another yet share one psychic subsoil — diagnose the structural consensus beneath sectarian dispute)
process_zh: 选定一个民族或一种文化的思想整体，暂时悬置'对错评价'与'阵营归属'
做命题普查：该传统反复出现的核心范畴、反复沉默的问题、反复偏好的文体与论证方式
从命题读到心理：把每个高频范畴翻译为一种'安顿存在的方案'——它如何回答死亡、秩序、欲望与苦难
绘出结构并检验：以边缘案例（异端、外来思想的本土化改造）检验结构模型的解释力，修订并命名核心构造
process_en: Select the intellectual corpus of a nation or culture, suspending for the while 'right-wrong judgement' and camp affiliation
Survey the propositions: the core categories that recur, the questions that are consistently silenced, the genres and argumentative forms that are habitually preferred
Read from proposition to psyche: translate each high-frequency category into a scheme for sheltering existence — how it answers death, order, desire and suffering
Draw the structure and test it: use marginal cases (heresies, the indigenisation of imported thought) to test the model's explanatory power; revise and name the central constructions
representative_cases_zh: 《中国古代思想史论》对儒道互补的诊断：儒家提供'社会性人格'的进路、道家提供'个体性解放'的退路——二者表面对立，实为同一'一个世界'观下的互补结构，士大夫'达则兼济、穷则独善'的心理机制由此而来
对墨家与兵家哲学的处理：'非攻'与'诡道'看似相反，同属实用理性——伦理效益计算（兼爱之利）与战争技术计算（利而诱之）共享'以结果衡量思想'的构造
对宋明理学的处理：'存理灭欲'的激进化不是逻辑推演的必然，而是特定时代（科举官僚制+宗法社会危机）的心理焦虑沉淀——理学史读成一部心态史
representative_cases_en: Diagnosis of Confucian-Daoist complementarity in the Histories of Ancient Chinese Thought: Confucianism supplies the approach of 'social personhood', Daoism the retreat of 'individual liberation' — opposed in appearance, complementary in substance under one 'single-world' outlook, whence the literatus's mechanism of 'serve in success, withdraw in failure'

Treatment of Mohist and military philosophy: 'condemning aggression' and 'the way of deception' seeming opposites, both practical reason — ethical cost-benefit (the profit of universal love) and tactical calculation (bait the profitable) sharing the construction 'measure thought by outcome'

Treatment of Neo-Confucianism: the radicalisation of 'preserve principle, extinguish desire' not a logical necessity but the sedimented psychic anxiety of a specific age (examination bureaucracy plus crisis of the patriarchal order) — the history of the School of Principle read as a history of mentalities
modern_applications_zh: 跨文化产品与传播研究：把'用户不做什么'当作需求证据——未被使用的高级功能暴露的是文化心理结构而非设计缺陷；本地化要改的是心理默认值而非语言表层
企业组织诊断：把会议纪要、邮件措辞与汇报文体当作'组织心理'的切片——哪些话题永远缺席、哪些委婉语高频出现，比使命宣言更真实
国民性与消费研究：把消费偏好追问到'安顿存在的方案'层面——品类兴衰背后是心理构造的变迁（如'悦己消费'对应的个体化进程）
modern_applications_en: Cross-cultural product and communication studies: taking 'what users do not do' as demand evidence — unused advanced features expose cultural-psychological structure, not design flaws; localisation must change psychological defaults, not the linguistic surface

Corporate organisational diagnosis: minutes, email diction and reporting genres as sections of 'organisational psyche' — which topics are forever absent, which euphemisms run at high frequency, truer than any mission statement

National character and consumption research: tracing preferences down to 'schemes for sheltering existence' — behind the rise and fall of categories, the migration of psychic constructions ('self-pleasing consumption' and the individualisation process)
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
黄宗羲（思想史前辈：《明儒学案》'一行之编'的学案体——中国学术史上最早的'心理地层学'尝试之一）
迈蒙尼德（对照：同样在异质传统（希腊理性/犹太启示）之间做'结构调停'的思想史家）

modes.domain_zh: 实践哲学方法论/把'度'（恰当的分寸）确立为一切存在与认识的第一范畴：人类与世界的关系首先是操作性的——先有'做多少、做到哪里'的分寸掌握，后有概念与逻辑；度的掌握是技艺不是计算
modes.domain_en: Practical-philosophical methodology / establishing 'degree' (du, the apt measure) as first category of all being and knowing: the human relation to the world is operational first — the mastery of 'how much, up to where' precedes concept and logic; the grasping of degree is a craft, not a computation
modes.definition_zh: 实践哲学方法论/李泽厚晚年把整个'人类学历史本体论'压在'度'这一个字上：人类之所以能存在，靠的不是先掌握概念再行动，而是在使用-制造工具的活动中先掌握了'恰当的分寸'——火候、剂量、力度、时机的'恰到好处'；'度'先于一切语言与逻辑（婴儿与工匠都懂'过犹不及'），概念是对成功的分寸把握的事后命名；'度'不可被规则穷尽——同一个'中庸'，在具体情境中如何拿捏，永远是技艺与判断而非公式的应用；因此他反对一切'本质主义'：重要的不是'是什么'而是'做到什么程度'——真理问题被改写为技艺问题：人是靠'度的把握'活在世界上、也在'度的掌握'中生成自我的
modes.definition_en: Practical-philosophical methodology / in his late system Li Zehou rests the whole Anthropological-Historical Ontology on the single word 'degree': what lets humankind exist is not conceiving concepts before acting, but first mastering, in the use and making of tools, the 'apt measure' — the恰到好处 of heat, dose, force and timing; 'degree' precedes all language and logic (infant and craftsman both know 'going too far is as bad as falling short'), and concepts are after-the-fact names for successfully grasped measures; 'degree' cannot be exhausted by rules — how the same 'doctrine of the mean' is held in a concrete situation remains forever craft and judgement, never the application of a formula; hence his anti-essentialism: what matters is not 'what it is' but 'to what degree it is done' — the problem of truth rewritten as a problem of craft: man lives in the world by grasping degree, and becomes himself in the mastering of it
modes.source_chapter: 《人类学历史本体论》(2008) 与《历史本体论·己卯五说》：'度就是人类生存的第一范畴——由度而产生数、量、形式与逻辑'
modes.key_quote_zh: 一切深道理，最后都落在'分寸'二字上——不是'是什么'，而是'做到几成'；人不是想明白才活的，是拿捏明白了才活的。
modes.key_quote_en: Every deep truth ends in the word 'measure' — not 'what it is' but 'how far to carry it'; man does not live by thinking things clear, but by getting the grasp right.
key_concepts: 操作优先 primacy of operation（先会做后会说：分寸的掌握先于概念的命名——逻辑是操作的纪念碑）
primacy of operation (doing before saying: the grasp of measure precedes the naming of concepts — logic is the monument of operations)
度的技艺性 the craft of degree（不可公式化：同样的原则在不同情境中要求不同的度——中庸不是平均值而是具体的恰到好处）
the craft of degree (irreducible to formula: the same principle demands different degrees in different situations — the mean is not the average but the concrete aptness)
由度生量、由量生理 measure begets number, number begets principle（数量、形式、逻辑范畴都是人类对'度'的把握的抽象化——数学的根在'拿捏'）
measure begets number, number begets principle (quantity, form and logical categories all abstractions of the grasped measure — the root of mathematics lies in 'getting the grip')
火候意识 consciousness of the moment（时机与剂量不可外推：跨过临界点性质改变——行动者必须有'停在何处'的判断）
consciousness of the moment (timing and dosage not extrapolable: cross the critical point and quality changes — the actor must hold the judgement of 'where to stop')
process_zh: 把任务翻译为操作：明确'成功'在行为层面的样子——不是理念正确而是动作到位
寻找度的参数：列出该任务中可调的量（强度、速度、频次、剂量）与各自的临界点
以实践校准：小步试探-观察反馈-再调整，把'原则'落实为'火候'；记录失败案例中过与不及的位置
命名与传承：把校准出的分寸写成'可领悟但不可照抄'的操作要领——给后来者判断的空间而非公式的锁链
process_en: Translate the task into operation: define what 'success' looks like at the level of action — not correctness of idea but rightness of execution
Find the parameters of degree: list the adjustable quantities (intensity, speed, frequency, dose) and their critical points
Calibrate in practice: probe in small steps, observe feedback, adjust again — settling the 'principle' into 'mastery of the moment'; record where excess and defect lay in failed cases
Name and transmit: write the calibrated measure as know-how 'graspable but not copyable' — leaving successors room for judgement rather than a chain of formulae
representative_cases_zh: 《历史本体论》对'烹饪'的原型使用：调和五味没有公式，靠'火候'与'尝'——中国'治大国若烹小鲜'的政治智慧正是度本体的文化表达；李泽厚以此说明'中庸'的原初意义是操作的分寸而非道德教条
《批判哲学的批判》再版序中对'实践'的再定义：实践不是抽象的'劳动'而是'使用-制造工具的具体活动'——在其中度（力度、角度、次序）是先于语言的掌握对象
晚年访谈中论'告别革命'：改良与革命的取舍不是原则问题而是度的问题——'要看付出的代价与得到的成果的比例'——把政治判断从主义之争拉回分寸之争
representative_cases_en: The archetypal use of cooking in Historical Ontology: blending the five flavours has no formula, only 'heat' and tasting — 'governing a great state as one cooks a small fish' as the cultural expression of the ontology of degree; thereby the original sense of the 'doctrine of the mean' is shown as operational measure, not moral dogma

The redefinition of 'practice' in the preface to the reissue of Critique of Critical Philosophy: practice not abstract 'labour' but the concrete activity of using-making tools — wherein degree (force, angle, sequence) is the object grasped prior to language

On 'farewell to revolution' in late interviews: the choice of reform over revolution not a matter of principle but of degree — 'look at the ratio of cost paid to result gained' — pulling political judgement from the war of isms back to the war of measures
modern_applications_zh: 管理实务：把'KPI'还原为'度'的代理指标——任何被测量的量都只是分寸的影子；高绩效组织的关键是培养'火候判断'的资深者而非算法化一切
产品迭代方法论：'小步快跑'即度的操作化——以最小剂量试探临界点，避免一次性'过度优化'跨过用户容忍的临界
谈判与沟通技艺：训练'停在何处'的判断——让步的剂量、追问的深度、幽默的浓度都是度；可教的是要领与案例，不可教的是情境中的拿捏
modern_applications_en: Management practice: reducing the 'KPI' to a proxy of 'degree' — every measured quantity is but the shadow of a measure; the key to high performance is cultivating veterans of 'moment-judgement' rather than algorithmising everything

Product iteration methodology: 'small steps, fast pace' as the operationalisation of degree — probing the critical point in minimal doses, avoiding one-shot over-optimisation past users' threshold of tolerance

The craft of negotiation and communication: training the judgement of 'where to stop' — the dose of concession, the depth of questioning, the strength of humour, all matters of degree; teachable are the essentials and the cases, unteachable the grasp within the situation
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
孙子（操作智慧源头：'以迂为直''其用战也贵胜'——古典军事技艺中的度之把握）
亚里士多德（平行参照：'中道'（mesotes）学说——实践智慧（phronesis）不可还原为规则）

modes.name_en: The Double Reduction of History and Ethics
modes.category: 历史哲学/二律背反思辨
modes.domain_zh: 历史哲学方法论/对任何历史事件与人物做'两重还原'：历史主义还原（它相对于当时条件是否进步）与伦理主义还原（它对个体生命与福祉的代价）——两个尺度不可互相取消，真实的历史判断必须悬置在两者之间
modes.domain_en: Methodology of the philosophy of history / subjecting every event and figure to a 'double reduction': the historicist reduction (was it progressive relative to its conditions) and the ethicist reduction (what it cost individual lives and welfare) — two measures that cannot cancel each other, between which any honest historical judgement must be suspended
modes.definition_zh: 历史哲学方法论/李泽厚在《中国近代思想史论》后记中提出著名的'二律背反'：评价历史时，历史主义的尺度说'为了文明的进步，代价可以忍受'，伦理主义的尺度说'任何以牺牲具体人为代价的进步都必须被追问'——两个尺度各自都有道理，也都不能独自成立；中国近代史上的革命与改良、新文化运动与传统、改朝换代与生灵涂炭，全都同时活在两个尺度之下；方法论上要求：对任何大历史叙事先做两重还原——先做历史主义还原（把它放回当时的可能性空间，问它'推动了什么'），再做伦理主义还原（数一数它'牺牲了谁、牺牲了多少、是否可替代'）——最后不做机械综合，而是把这'不可解决的张力'本身作为结论交给读者：历史理解始于承认两套价值尺度无法通约
modes.definition_en: Methodology of the philosophy of history / in the postface to the Histories of Modern Chinese Thought Li Zehou posed the famous antinomy: the historicist measure says 'for the progress of civilisation, cost may be endured', while the ethicist says 'any progress bought with the sacrifice of concrete persons must be interrogated' — each measure reasonable, neither able to stand alone; revolution and reform in modern Chinese history, the New Culture Movement and tradition, dynastic change and the drowning of lives — all live at once under both measures; methodologically: subject every grand narrative to the double reduction — first the historicist (replace it in its space of possibility, ask what it 'advanced'), then the ethicist (count whom it 'sacrificed, how many, whether irreplaceably') — and finally make no mechanical synthesis, but hand the insoluble tension itself to the reader as the conclusion: historical understanding begins in admitting that two scales of value have no common currency
modes.source_chapter: 《中国近代思想史论》后记（1979）：'历史主义与伦理主义的二律背反……我把这个矛盾保留下来，不予解决'
modes.key_quote_zh: 历史有自己的账本，良心有自己的账本——两本都合乎道理，两本都无法销掉对方；成熟的判断，是同时看得见两本账。
modes.key_quote_en: History keeps its ledger, conscience keeps its own — both accounts make sense, and neither can strike out the other; a mature judgement sees both ledgers at once.
key_concepts: 历史主义尺度 the historicist measure（问：相对于当时的可能性空间，该事件推进了文明到何处——反对以今天的标准苛求古人）
the historicist measure (asking: relative to the space of possibility of its time, how far did the event advance civilisation — refusing to indict the past by today's standards)
伦理主义尺度 the ethicist measure（问：它以多少具体生命的苦难为代价，代价是否必要与可替代——拒绝把人当作'进步的燃料'）
the ethicist measure (asking: at what cost in concrete lives, and was the cost necessary and irreplaceable — refusing to treat persons as 'fuel of progress')
拒绝综合 refusing synthesis（两个尺度分别成立、互相不可通约——'不予解决'不是懒惰而是诚实：解决了的'历史哲学'都是意识形态）
refusing synthesis (both measures stand, and have no common currency — 'leaving it unsolved' is not laziness but honesty: every 'philosophy of history' that resolves it is an ideology)
代价敏感性 cost-sensitivity（一切'必要的牺牲'叙事都要接受'是否真必要'的追问——为'大局'辩护者必须先数清大局账下的死者）
cost-sensitivity (every narrative of 'necessary sacrifice' subject to the question 'was it truly necessary' — who defends the 'greater picture' must first count the dead on its books)
process_zh: 选定历史事件/人物/政策，分别收集'文明推进'与'个体代价'两组证据
做历史主义还原：还原当时的约束条件与可能性空间，估计该行动相比替代方案推进了什么
做伦理主义还原：清点代价的承担者、规模与可替代性——检验'必要牺牲'的必要性本身
并置两个结论而不强行综合：写出两本账，标注不可通约之处，把张力作为思考的最终成果交付
process_en: Select the event, figure or policy; gather separately the evidence of 'civilisational advance' and of 'individual cost'
Run the historicist reduction: reconstruct the constraints and possibility-space of the time; estimate what the action advanced against alternatives
Run the ethicist reduction: enumerate the bearers, scale and replaceability of the cost — testing the very necessity of the 'necessary sacrifice'
Set the two conclusions side by side without forced synthesis: write both ledgers, mark the incommensurables, deliver the tension itself as the final product of thinking
representative_cases_zh: 对太平天国的双重评价：历史主义尺度上它冲击了旧秩序并暴露了旧制度的死结；伦理主义尺度上其内耗与战乱造成数千万人的死亡——李泽厚拒绝对任一尺度做装饰性处理，坚持'两本账同时摊开'
对新文化运动'全盘反传统'的处理：历史主义尺度上它是必要的思想启蒙，为现代转型扫清心理障碍；伦理主义尺度上它造成的传统断裂与代际失语是真实的文化创伤——二律背反在文化领域同样成立
晚年'告别革命'命题的两重结构：历史主义地看，二十世纪革命付出的代价巨大且多数目标可用改良达到；伦理主义地看，拒绝革命首先是对个体生命不再被'大词'征用的辩护——该命题的全部力量恰恰在于它同时站在两个尺度上
representative_cases_en: The double judgement of the Taiping Rebellion: on the historicist measure it shattered the old order and exposed the dead knot of the old system; on the ethicist measure its internecine war cost tens of millions of lives — refusing any ornamental handling of either measure, insisting 'both ledgers lie open at once'

The treatment of the New Culture Movement's wholesale anti-traditionalism: historically a necessary intellectual clearing for modern transformation; ethically a real cultural trauma of rupture and generational muteness — the antinomy holds in culture as in war

The double structure of the late 'farewell to revolution': historically, the twentieth-century revolutions paid vast costs for aims mostly reachable by reform; ethically, refusing revolution is first a defence of individual life against conscription by 'grand words' — the proposition's force lies precisely in standing on both measures at once
modern_applications_zh: 重大决策复盘方法论：组织级'两本账'制度——任何战略转变必须同时出具'业务成果账'与'人员代价账'，禁止用第一本销掉第二本
历史争议与公共讨论的讨论纪律：给'进步叙事'与'代价追问'各留法定席位——教育的目标不是给标准答案而是训练同时持握两个尺度的能力
科技伦理评估：对任何'技术进步必然论'先做伦理还原——效率提升的代价由谁承担、是否可替代；再对'技术恐惧论'做历史主义还原——拒绝新工具的历史成本曾由谁支付
modern_applications_en: Methodology of major-decision retrospectives: an organisational 'two-ledger' rule — any strategic turn must issue both a 'business-outcome ledger' and a 'human-cost ledger', the first never permitted to strike out the second

Discipline for public discussion of historical controversy: reserved seats for both the 'progress narrative' and the 'cost interrogation' — the aim of education is not the standard answer but the capacity to hold both scales at once

Technology ethics assessment: before any 'progress is inevitable' claim, the ethicist reduction — who bears the cost of efficiency and can it be replaced; before any 'fear of technology' claim, the historicist reduction — who once paid the historical cost of refusing new tools
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
董仲舒（对照：同样直面'历史代价'问题，但以天道论证秩序——李泽厚以二律背反保留张力；主库 M01'天人感应法'为其代表模式）
黄宗羲（伦理主义尺度的中国思想史先声：'天下之治乱不在一姓之兴亡，而在万民之忧乐'）

modes.domain_zh: 认识论与思想史方法论/诊断一种传统'理性'的实用化构造：真理标准滑向效用、概念服从于操作、形而上学让位于治术——看清其实践成就与理论盲区由同一构造造成
modes.domain_en: Epistemological and historiographical methodology / diagnosing the praxis-bound construction of a tradition's 'reason': truth drifting to utility, concepts subordinated to operation, metaphysics ceding to the arts of governance — seeing that its practical triumphs and theoretical blind spots issue from one and the same construction
modes.definition_zh: 认识论与思想史方法论/李泽厚把中国思想的底层认识构造命名为'实用理性'：它不拒绝抽象，但要求抽象最终为'安身立命'与'治国平天下'服务——概念的价值取决于可操作性而非自洽性；这造成了双面后果：积极面是极强的适应力、工程智慧与'实事求是'的修正能力（没有死守教条的传统负担），消极面是理论系统性弱、纯思辨与形式逻辑不发达、容易被'有用即真理'滑向机会主义；方法论上要求：诊断一个传统的理性形态时，先找它的'真理判据'——由什么决定一个说法被接受（逻辑证明？经典权威？功效验证？政治需要？），再追踪这一判据造成的结构性长处与结构性盲区——成与败是同一枚硬币
modes.definition_en: Epistemological and historiographical methodology / Li Zehou names the deep epistemic construction of Chinese thought 'practical reason': not refusing abstraction, but demanding that abstraction finally serve 'settling one's life' and 'ordering the realm' — the worth of a concept determined by operability rather than self-consistency; the consequence is double-faced: positively, great adaptability, engineering wisdom and the capacity for correction called 'seeking truth from facts' (no dead weight of dogma), negatively, weak theoretical systematics, undeveloped pure speculation and formal logic, and the slide into opportunism via 'the useful is the true'; methodologically: to diagnose the rational shape of a tradition, first find its 'criterion of truth' — what decides that a claim is accepted (logical proof? scriptural authority? efficacy test? political need?), then trace the structural strengths and structural blind spots that this criterion produces — success and failure are two faces of one coin
modes.source_chapter: 《中国古代思想史论》(1985)：'所谓实用理性，就是……关注于现实社会生活，不作纯粹抽象的思辨……事事强调实用、实际、实行'
modes.key_quote_zh: 同一个把'管用'当尺子的头脑，造得出万里长城，也造不出欧几里得——长处与盲区是同一构造的两面，认不清这一点，就会把短处当美德或把长处当缺陷。
modes.key_quote_en: The same mind that takes 'it works' for its ruler can build the Great Wall but not Euclid — strength and blind spot are two faces of one construction; fail to see this, and you will mistake the weakness for a virtue or the strength for a defect.
key_concepts: 真理判据定位 locating the criterion of truth（问：一个说法靠什么被接受——证明、功效、权威还是权力；判据决定整个认识生态）
locating the criterion of truth (ask: by what is a claim accepted — proof, efficacy, authority or power; the criterion shapes the whole epistemic ecology)
构造双面性两面记账 both faces of one construction（实用化的每一长处对应一种理论盲区——适应性对应系统性弱，重行对应轻思辨）
both faces of one construction (every strength of praxis-orientation corresponds to a theoretical blind spot — adaptability to weak systematics, prizing action to undervaluing speculation)
范畴的功能化 the functionalisation of categories（概念不被定义而被使用：'天''道''理'都是操作概念——范畴史即工具史）
the functionalisation of categories (concepts used rather than defined: Heaven, the Way, Principle as operational concepts — the history of categories as the history of tools)
盲区补偿设计 designing compensation for the blind spot（认清构造性短板后以制度或外来传统补偿——如引入形式逻辑训练与'为知识而知识'的悬置空间）

designing compensation for the blind spot (after diagnosing the structural weakness, compensate by institution or imported tradition — e.g. training in formal logic and a protected space of 'knowledge for its own sake')
process_zh: 选定诊断对象（一种文化传统、一个组织或一门学科的思维方式）
定位其真理判据：追踪代表性争论中'最终靠什么说服人'——收集功效、权威、逻辑、政治四种判据的使用频率
写出双面账：从该判据推出结构性长处与结构性盲区各一列，并各配三个实证案例
设计补偿机制：针对盲区提出不推翻传统的前提下的制度性补偿——并评估补偿本身的副作用
process_en: Select the diagnostic object (a cultural tradition, an organisation, a discipline's way of thinking)
Locate its criterion of truth: trace, in representative controversies, 'what finally persuades' — tally the use of efficacy, authority, logic and power as criteria
Write the two-sided account: from that criterion derive one column of structural strengths and one of structural blind spots, each with three empirical cases
Design compensation: institutional remedies for the blind spot that do not overturn the tradition — and assess the side-effects of the remedy itself
representative_cases_zh: 《中国古代思想史论》对兵家与农医技艺传统的处理：兵家'算胜'传统与中医'辨证'传统都把概念当操作工具——这是中国'技术早熟'的认识论根源，也是'科学革命未在中国发生'（李约瑟难题的李泽厚式回答：不缺技术，缺的是'无用之学'的制度空间）的一个思想史解释
对汉语言文字与思维方式关系的处理：汉字的非形态性与联想性强化了直观综合、弱化了形式推演——实用理性有语言学层面的沉淀（此论承接并修正了当时流行的语言决定论）
对'实事求是'传统的再解释：从《汉书》到延安，这一口号的反复激活恰恰证明实用理性的自我修正能力——但它修正的方向永远受'实用判据'约束：能修正'政策'而难以自发修正'范式'
representative_cases_en: The treatment of the military and the medical-technical traditions: the strategist's 'calculation wins' and the physician's 'differentiating syndromes' both use concepts as operational tools — the epistemic root of China's 'early technology', and one intellectual-historical answer to why the scientific revolution did not happen there (Li Zehou's version of Needham's question: not technique that was lacking, but institutional space for 'useless learning')

On the relation of the Chinese language to habits of thought: the non-inflectional, associative script strengthening intuitive synthesis and weakening formal deduction — practical reason sedimented at the linguistic layer (revising the linguistic determinism then in vogue)

The re-reading of 'seeking truth from facts': its repeated re-activation from the Han History to Yan'an proves practical reason's self-corrective power — yet correction always bounded by the utility criterion: policy can be revised, but paradigms rarely revise themselves from within
modern_applications_zh: 学科建设诊断：识别一个团队'什么算证据'的隐性判据——销售数据压倒用户研究、老板偏好压倒实验结果等；设计给'无用之学'（基础研究、红队质疑）留出的制度化空间
跨文化合作方法论：预判'实用理性传统'与'证明理性传统'团队的分歧模式——前者要原型与效果，后者要定义与证明；把判据差异提前写进协作契约
个人思维体检：自测'我用什么判据接受一个观点'——若功效判据独大，需警惕机会主义化；刻意引入'自洽性'与'反例检验'作为第二判据
modern_applications_en: Diagnosis of discipline-building: identify a team's implicit criterion of 'what counts as evidence' — sales data over user research, the boss's taste over the experiment; carve institutional space for 'useless learning' (basic research, red-team doubt)

Cross-cultural collaboration: anticipate the disagreement patterns of 'practical-reason' and 'proof-reason' teams — the former wants prototype and effect, the latter definition and proof; write the criterion gap into the collaboration contract in advance

A personal audit of thinking: test 'by what criterion do I accept a view' — where the utility criterion rules alone, guard against opportunism; deliberately install self-consistency and counter-example testing as a second criterion
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
墨子（实用理性在先秦的最强形态：'三表法'以功效为真理判据——其强度与局限同为李泽厚分析的样本；主库中相关模式为孙武 M-SW-002'不战全胜'所收）
康德（对照系：'纯粹理性'与'实践理性'的严格分界——实用理性正是对这一分界的跨越式重组）

modes.name_en: The Perspective of the Culture of Joy
modes.domain_zh: 文化哲学方法论/识别一种文化安顿'人生苦难'的底层方案：超越型文化把救赎放在彼岸，'乐感文化'把意义放在现世的情感生活与人际关系之中——从节日、饮食、伦理与文学中读出一个文明'如何不靠天堂也能活下去'的答案
modes.domain_en: Cultural-philosophical methodology / identifying a culture's deep scheme for settling 'the suffering of life': transcendent cultures put salvation in a beyond, the 'culture of joy' puts meaning in the emotional life and human relations of this world — reading from festival, food, ethics and literature how a civilisation 'lives on without heaven'
modes.definition_zh: 文化哲学方法论/李泽厚追问一个被忽视的根本问题：在没有强大彼岸宗教的中国，数千年里人们靠什么承受苦难与死亡？他的答案是'乐感文化'——不是否认苦难，而是把'生的意义'安放在现世人际与情感之中：亲子之爱、师友之信、山水之乐、节庆团圆，都是'此岸的救赎'；连审美都承担了宗教功能——'以美育代宗教'；方法论上要求：比较不同文明时，先问各自的'苦难安顿方案'——它把意义放在何处（彼岸/来世/现世/后代），再由这一方案反推其伦理重心（罪感文化重灵魂审判、耻感文化重社会评价、乐感文化重情感圆满）与其艺术形态（悲剧传统 vs 大团圆传统）；'乐'不是肤浅的快乐主义，而是'明知人生有限仍以深情活在当下'的存在论决断
modes.definition_en: Cultural-philosophical methodology / Li Zehou asks a fundamental question long overlooked: in China, without a powerful religion of the beyond, by what did people endure suffering and death for millennia? His answer is the 'culture of joy' — not denying suffering, but lodging 'the meaning of living' in worldly relations and feeling: the love of parent and child, trust between teacher and friend, the delight in mountains and waters, festival and reunion, each a 'salvation on this shore'; even aesthetics carries a religious function — 'aesthetic education in place of religion'; methodologically: in comparing civilisations, first ask each one's 'scheme for settling suffering' — where it lodges meaning (the beyond, the afterlife, this world, posterity), then infer from that scheme the ethical centre of gravity (guilt-culture weighing the soul, shame-culture social judgement, joy-culture emotional fullness) and the artistic morphology (tragedy versus the happy-ending tradition); 'joy' is no shallow hedonism but an existential resolve 'to live this life with deep feeling, knowing it is finite'
modes.source_chapter: 《华夏美学》与《中国古代思想史论》：'中国文化的特质是'乐感文化'——在现世人生的情感满足中安顿存在，'未知生，焉知死'
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有天堂的民族也要活，而且要活出滋味——把救赎从天上搬回人间的一桌饭、一场团圆、一次山水之游里：这不是肤浅，是更难的勇气。
modes.key_quote_en: A people without heaven must live all the same, and live with savour — carrying salvation down from the sky into a shared meal, a reunion, an excursion among hills and streams: not shallowness, but the harder courage.
key_concepts: 苦难安顿方案定位 locating the scheme of settling suffering（每个文明都要回答'苦难与死亡的意义'——先找它的答案放在何处，再解释其余一切）
locating the scheme of settling suffering (every civilisation must answer 'the meaning of suffering and death' — find first where it lodges the answer, and explain all the rest from there)
此岸救赎 salvation on this shore（意义内置于现世关系与情感：血缘、师友、山水、节庆——'一个世界'不需要另一个世界的担保）
salvation on this shore (meaning embedded in worldly relations and feeling — kinship, friendship, landscape, festival; 'one world' needs no guarantee from another)
审美替代宗教 aesthetics in place of religion（当彼岸缺位，艺术与美感承担终极关怀——美成为'有限人生的无限证明'）
aesthetics in place of religion (with the beyond absent, art and beauty carry ultimate concern — beauty as the 'infinite proof of a finite life')
乐而不肤浅 joy without shallowness（乐感以'深知苦难'为前提——大团圆传统的成熟形态不是回避悲剧而是'承担后的和解'）
joy without shallowness (joy presupposes deep knowledge of suffering — the mature happy-ending not the avoidance of tragedy but 'reconciliation after bearing it')
process_zh: 选定比较对象：两种文明/两种组织的'意义方案'
定位各自的苦难安顿：其核心叙事把救赎/意义放在何处？由哪些仪式与制度承载？
由方案反推表征：伦理重心（罪/耻/情）、艺术形态（悲剧/团圆/抒情）、时间取向（末世/轮回/当下）
检验并应用：用该框架解释具体的伦理争议、艺术偏好或激励设计差异——并检查是否把'乐感'误读为'享乐'或把'超越'误读为'逃避'
process_en: Select the comparanda: the 'meaning-schemes' of two civilisations or two organisations
Locate each one's settling of suffering: where do its core narratives put salvation/meaning, and by what rites and institutions are they carried?
Infer the surface from the scheme: ethical centre of gravity (guilt/shame/feeling), artistic morphology (tragedy/happy ending/lyric), orientation of time (apocalypse/reincarnation/the present)

Test and apply: use the frame to explain concrete ethical disputes, artistic preferences or differences in incentive design — while guarding against misreading 'joy' as 'hedonism' or 'transcendence' as 'escape'
representative_cases_zh: 《华夏美学》对'大团圆'的再解释：中国叙事以团圆收束不是不敢直面悲剧，而是乐感文化的'承担后的和解'——窦娥的冤屈必须以感应天地的昭雪收束，因为意义必须在此世兑现；西方悲剧把矛盾交给彼岸或命运，中国戏曲把矛盾交还给人间的秩序与情感
对'孝'与祖先祭祀的处理：祖先崇拜是中国式的'不朽'方案——个体生命通过血脉与记忆的延续而免于湮灭，'慎终追远'是现世的永生术，无需灵魂审判的法庭
对'山水诗画'传统的处理：自然审美在中国承担了西方'自然神学'的功能——士大夫在山水中的'安顿'是'一个世界'内部的超越：不离开此岸而获得彼岸式的解脱
representative_cases_en: The re-reading of the 'happy ending' in Chinese Aesthetics: the Chinese narrative closes in reunion not from fear of tragedy, but as the joy-culture's 'reconciliation after bearing' — Dou E's wrong must end in heaven-echoing vindication, because meaning must be cashed in this world; Western tragedy hands contradiction to the beyond or to fate, Chinese drama hands it back to human order and feeling

On 'filial piety' and ancestor worship: the ancestral cult as a Chinese scheme of 'immortality' — the individual life spared annihilation through the continuity of blood and memory; 'careful over death and distant sacrifice' as this-worldly eternal life, needing no court of soul-judgement

On the tradition of landscape poetry and painting: natural beauty in China carrying the function of Western 'natural theology' — the literatus's 'settlement' in mountains and waters a transcendence within 'one world': a beyond-like release without leaving this shore
modern_applications_zh: 跨文化管理与激励设计：识别成员的'意义方案'差异——为乐感取向的团队设计现世回报（成长、关系、口碑），为超越取向设计使命叙事；激励错配常源于误把对方的'救赎'当成自己的
品牌与产品设计：为'一个世界'文化的用户设计'此岸的仪式感'——日常产品的节庆化、食物的情感叙事、'传家'属性的商品化，都是乐感文化的现代变现
危机沟通与哀伤辅导：理解不同文化的哀悼语法——不强行引入彼岸叙事，而是在现世关系中为丧失者重建意义（持续性的联结、纪念的仪式、集体的讲述）
modern_applications_en: Cross-cultural management and incentive design: identifying differences in members' 'meaning-schemes' — designing worldly returns (growth, relationship, reputation) for joy-oriented teams, mission narratives for transcendent ones; misaligned incentives often come from mistaking the other's 'salvation' for one's own

Brand and product design: for users of 'one-world' culture, designing 'rituals on this shore' — the festivalisation of everyday products, the emotional narrative of food, the commodification of 'heirloom' qualities, all modern monetisations of the culture of joy

Crisis communication and grief counselling: understanding each culture's grammar of mourning — not importing a beyond-narrative by force, but rebuilding meaning for the bereaved within worldly relations (continuing bonds, rites of remembrance, collective telling)
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
孔子（乐感文化的原型表述：'饭疏食饮水，曲肱而枕之，乐亦在其中矣'——现世之乐作为存在方案）
莲花生（对照系：彼岸超越传统的极端形态——中阴教法把意义完全安放在死后旅程，与'一个世界'互为镜像）

modes.domain_zh: 文化变革方法论/嫁接而非移植：把现代性的'体'（社会化大生产、科学技术、现代生活形态）真正接过来，同时以中国的'用'（本土心理与文化形式）消化它——既反对'中体西用'的表面文章，也反对'全盘西化'的拔根手术
modes.domain_en: Methodology of cultural transformation / grafting rather than transplanting: truly taking over the 'substance' of modernity (socialised production, science and technology, modern life-forms) while digesting it through the Chinese 'application' (native psychology and cultural forms) — against both the surface painting of 'Chinese substance, Western application' and the uprooting surgery of wholesale Westernisation
modes.definition_zh: 文化变革方法论/李泽厚把张之洞'中体西用'的旧公式整个翻转：现代化不可能只要'器物'不要'体'——真正的'体'不是形而上的'道统'而是现代大工业生产与科技所要求的生活方式与思维方式的总体；但引入'西体'必须由'中用'消化：外来制度与观念只有在与本土文化心理结构的嫁接中才能成活——直接移植必遭排异；方法论上要求：引进任何外部模式时区分三层——'体'（该模式赖以成立的物质与制度基础，必须整体接受）、'用'（它被使用的具体形式，必须本土重造）、'皮'（它的文化装饰，可以丢弃）；并预先评估排异反应：该模式与本土心理结构的冲突点在哪里，需要何种过渡形态（如'乡村股份制'之于现代公司制）；这是一门'器官移植外科'的方法论：供体要完整，接口要精细，排异要预案
modes.definition_en: Methodology of cultural transformation / Li Zehou turns Zhang Zhidong's old formula wholly upside down: modernisation cannot take the 'implements' without the 'substance' — true substance is not a metaphysical 'orthodox way' but the whole of life-forms and habits of thought demanded by modern industry and science; yet the imported 'Western substance' must be digested by the 'Chinese application': foreign institutions and ideas survive only grafted onto the native cultural-psychological structure — direct transplant meets rejection; methodologically: in importing any external model, distinguish three layers — 'substance' (the material and institutional basis on which the model stands; accept it whole), 'application' (the concrete forms of its use; remake them natively), 'skin' (its cultural decoration; discard at will); and assess rejection in advance: where will the model collide with the native psychic structure, and what transitional forms are needed (the rural share-cooperative as against the modern corporation)? A methodology of transplant surgery: the donor organ whole, the interface fine, the rejection pre-planned
modes.source_chapter: 《中国现代思想史论》(1987)：'西体中用'——'现代的'体必须真正建立，而它必须通过中国自己的'用'来实现
modes.key_quote_zh: 嫁接不是换头，也不只是浇水——砧木还是自己的，接穗必须是良种：成活的秘密在接口，不在口号。
modes.key_quote_en: Grafting is not changing the head, nor merely watering — the rootstock remains one's own, the scion must be a good variety: the secret of survival lies in the interface, not in the slogan.
key_concepts: 体用三层剥离 the three-layer separation（体=物质-制度基础，用=使用形式，皮=文化装饰——混淆三层是引进失败的头号原因）
the three-layer separation (substance = material-institutional basis, application = form of use, skin = cultural decoration; confusing the layers is the number-one cause of failed importation)
排异反应预判 pre-judging the rejection（外来模式与本土心理结构的冲突点要预先测绘——每个'先进制度'都带着自己的文化假设清单）
pre-judging the rejection (mapping in advance where the foreign model will collide with the native psychic structure — every 'advanced institution' carries its own list of cultural assumptions)
过渡形态设计 designing transitional forms（直接移植不成活时设计中间态：既有本土合法性又向目标形态演进——过渡不是妥协而是嫁接技术本身）

designing transitional forms (where direct transplant fails, build intermediate states with native legitimacy yet evolving toward the target — transition not as compromise but as the grafting technique itself)
砧木自觉 rootstock self-awareness（消化能力取决于对自身文化心理结构的认识深度——不知自己的'用'，就无法让任何'体'成活）
rootstock self-awareness (digestive capacity depends on how deeply one knows one's own cultural-psychological structure — without knowing one's 'application', no 'substance' can be made to live)
process_zh: 拆解拟引进模式的三层：它的'体'（成立条件）、'用'（操作形式）、'皮'（装饰性外衣）分别是什么
测绘本土砧木：盘点自身的制度土壤、心理结构与既有实践——标出与模式的兼容区与冲突区
设计嫁接方案：体必须整体引入（明确不可打折的部分），用必须本土重造（明确必须改造的部分），皮明确丢弃
试点-观察排异-调整接口：以小范围试验监测排异反应，迭代过渡形态，最后总结'成活的接口'写成移植记录
process_en: Dissect the three layers of the model to be imported: what is its 'substance' (conditions of viability), 'application' (operational form), 'skin' (decorative coat)?
Map the native rootstock: inventory one's own institutional soil, psychic structure and existing practice — mark the zones of compatibility and collision with the model
Design the graft: substance imported whole (state what admits no discount), application remade natively (state what must be reworked), skin explicitly discarded
Pilot, observe rejection, adjust the interface: monitor rejection in a small trial, iterate the transitional form, and finally write the 'record of the living interface'
representative_cases_zh: 《中国现代思想史论》对洋务运动与'中体西用'的批判：只买机器不改'体'（生产组织与社会结构）是失败的根源——反过来，'全盘西化'论者把'皮'当'体'（以为改换服装、礼仪与口号即可现代化）同样是拔根手术；李泽厚以两次失败的共同点重新定义问题
对'马克思主义中国化'的解读：马克思主义在中国的成活正是'西体中用'的最大案例——其'体'（工业化、组织化、科学世界观）被接受，其'用'（话语形式、动员方式）被彻底本土重造（从'小康''大同'的翻译到农民战争的叙事接口）
晚年对'儒学复兴'的态度：支持儒家'用'的资源（情本体、度的智慧、家庭伦理的现代转化）进入现代生活，但反对把儒学再次立为'体'——'体'必须是现代的，'用'才谈得上是中国的
representative_cases_en: The critique of the Self-Strengthening Movement and 'Chinese substance, Western application': buying machines without changing the 'substance' (organisation of production and social structure) as the root of failure — while the 'wholesale Westernisation' camp, mistaking 'skin' for 'substance' (as if changing dress, etiquette and slogans made modernity), performed the uprooting surgery; from the shared failure of both, the problem is redefined

The reading of the Sinicisation of Marxism as the greatest case of 'Western substance, Chinese application' — its 'substance' (industrialisation, organisation, a scientific worldview) accepted, its 'application' (discourse and mobilisation forms) wholly remade natively, from translating it through 'well-off' and 'Great Harmony' to the narrative interface of peasant war

The late stance on the 'revival of Confucianism': supporting the entry of Confucian 'application' resources (the emotion-substance, the wisdom of degree, a modern transformation of family ethics) into modern life, opposing the re-enthronement of Confucianism as 'substance' — substance must be modern; only then can application be Chinese
modern_applications_zh: 跨国公司本土化方法论：把'全球化标准'拆解为体/用/皮三层——合规与质量体系（体）不打折，流程与沟通形式（用）本土重造，总部文化仪式（皮）允许简化；以排异监测（离职率、投诉结构）调整接口
技术引进与创新政策：区分'技术之体'（必须完整引进+消化）与'创新生态之用'（必须本土生长）——历史上'只买设备不建生态'的失败即体用错置
组织变革与文化融合：并购后的整合按三层推进——财务与合规体系（体）统一，业务流程（用）双向适配，品牌与仪式（皮）保留被并购方——并用'过渡形态'（双品牌、平行流程）管理排异期
modern_applications_en: Methodology of multinational localisation: dissecting the 'global standard' into substance/application/skin — compliance and quality systems (substance) without discount, process and communication forms (application) remade natively, headquarters rituals (skin) simplified at will; rejection monitored (attrition, complaint structure) to adjust the interface

Technology import and innovation policy: separating the 'substance of technology' (import and digest whole) from the 'ecosystem of innovation' (must grow natively) — the historical failure of 'buying equipment without building the ecology' as the misplacing of substance and application

Organisational change and post-merger integration in three layers — finance and compliance (substance) unified, business processes (application) adapted in both directions, brand and ritual (skin) left to the acquired side — with 'transitional forms' (dual brand, parallel processes) managing the rejection period
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
张之洞（公式来源与靶子：'中体西用'——李泽厚将其倒转并精确化）
宫崎滔天（对照：跨文化理想主义的移植者——其失败显示'只有皮与体、没有用'的移植极限）

modes.domain_zh: 思辨方法论/当两个各自成立的命题互相冲突时，拒绝过早综合：把矛盾作为'必须同时为真'的张力结构长期持握——在两极之间工作而不在两极之间逃走；综合只在历史与实践中自然生成，不可由思辨强行宣布
modes.domain_en: Speculative methodology / when two independently valid propositions conflict, refuse the premature synthesis: hold the contradiction long as a tension-structure 'both sides of which must be true' — working between the poles, not fleeing between them; synthesis is generated naturally only in history and practice, never proclaimed by speculation
modes.definition_zh: 思辨方法论/康德以'二律背反'表明理性越过边界即自相冲突；李泽厚把这一发现改造成日常的思维纪律：他一生的核心命题几乎都是成对出现而'不予解决'的——历史主义与伦理主义、启蒙与救亡、个体与集体、积淀与突破；方法上要求：遇到深刻冲突时先做'双方最强论证'检验（如果一方能被轻易驳倒，说明冲突还不深刻，问题还没问到位）；确认冲突不可消解后，不选边、不折中，而是'持立'——把两极当作必须同时携带的行李生活与工作；判断性的综合允许出现，但只能由实践提出（'度的把握'），不能由理论宣布；这是对一切'辩证法表演'（宣称矛盾'已经被扬弃'）的解毒剂
modes.definition_en: Speculative methodology / Kant showed with the antinomies that reason self-contradicts when it oversteps its bounds; Li Zehou reworks this discovery into an everyday discipline of thought: his central propositions almost all come in pairs 'left unsolved' — historicism and ethics, enlightenment and salvation, individual and collective, sedimentation and breakthrough; methodologically: on meeting a deep conflict, first run the 'strongest-version-of-both-sides' test (if either side falls easily, the conflict is not yet deep and the question not yet truly asked); once the conflict proves irresolvable, take no side and no middle, but 'hold' — carrying both poles as luggage that must travel together; judgemental synthesis may appear, but only proposed by practice (the grasp of degree), never declared by theory; this is the antidote to every 'dialectical performance' that proclaims the contradiction 'already sublated'
modes.source_chapter: 《中国近代思想史论》后记与《人类学历史本体论》：'我保留这个矛盾，不予解决——也许它本来就不可解决'
modes.key_quote_zh: 深刻的矛盾不欠你一个答案——它欠你的是耐力；谁宣称'扬弃'了它，谁多半只是站在了其中一极而不自知。
modes.key_quote_en: A deep contradiction owes you no answer — it owes you endurance; whoever claims to have 'sublated' it has usually, without knowing, simply taken his stand on one of its poles.
key_concepts: 最强论证检验 the strongest-version test（先让双方以最强形态出场——轻易可驳的冲突不是二律背反而是误解或懒惰）
the strongest-version test (let both sides first appear at their strongest — a conflict easily resolved is not an antinomy but a misunderstanding or laziness)
拒绝虚假综合 refusing the false synthesis（警惕宣称矛盾已被'扬弃'的辩证表演——被宣布的综合只是站队的修辞）
refusing the false synthesis (beware the dialectical performance proclaiming the contradiction 'sublated' — a declared synthesis is merely the rhetoric of taking sides)
持立技术 the technique of holding（把两极写成并列的约束条件而非待选答案：每项决策都问'此选择在两本账上各记什么'）
the technique of holding (write the poles as parallel constraints, not rival answers: for every decision ask 'what does this choice record on each ledger')
实践综合优先 practice-proposed synthesis（综合若出现，须由实践中的度提出并经时间检验——理论只负责维持张力不被遗忘）
practice-proposed synthesis (where synthesis appears it must be proposed by the degree-grasp of practice and tested by time — theory's job is only to keep the tension from being forgotten)
process_zh: 把冲突写成两个'最强命题'：各自给出最强论证与最强的反方论证——确认双方都不可轻易驳倒
查找虚假综合的痕迹：检查现有'解决方案'是否暗地里只采纳了一极——把被牺牲的一极恢复为明确约束
建立双约束决策格式：此后每项判断必须同时出具对两极的交代，禁止只按一本账结账
为'实践综合'留观察窗：记录实践中自然生成的调和方案及其长期后果——理论的职责是守门而非宣判
process_en: Write the conflict as two 'strongest propositions': give each its best case and the strongest case against it — confirm that neither falls easily
Search for traces of false synthesis: check whether the current 'solution' has secretly adopted one pole — restore the sacrificed pole as an explicit constraint
Establish a dual-constraint decision format: every judgement hereafter must account to both poles at once, settling accounts with neither ledger alone

Keep an observation window for 'practice-proposed synthesis': record the reconciliations practice generates naturally and their long-term consequences — theory's duty is to keep the gate, not to pronounce
representative_cases_zh: '启蒙与救亡'的双变量分析（《中国现代思想史论》的核心框架）：救亡压倒启蒙是近代史的事实，但李泽厚拒绝把'救亡'判定为错误——他把两者写成必须同时携带的结构：没有现代个体启蒙，救亡的成果会被旧心理回收；没有救亡的紧迫，启蒙只是书斋清谈——80 年代'新启蒙'正是在承认这对张力下重启
'积淀与突破'的成对持立：文化心理结构的稳定性（积淀）与个体的创造性突围（突破）互相需要又互相冲突——艺术史与思想史的全部动力都在这对张力中，任何宣称'纯自由创造'或'结构完全决定'的理论都被他判为单极化
晚年论'告别革命'的持立结构：他既坚持伦理尺度对革命代价的追问，又拒绝全盘否定革命的遗产——专访中明言'我不否定革命的历史作用，但我主张把革命从唯一选项的位置上请下来'——两本账同时持有，不做单边清账
representative_cases_en: The two-variable frame of 'enlightenment and salvation' (the core of the Histories of Contemporary Chinese Thought): salvation overwhelming enlightenment is the fact of modern history, yet Li refuses to rule 'salvation' an error — both written as a structure to be carried together: without the enlightenment of the modern individual, the fruits of salvation are repossessed by the old psyche; without the urgency of salvation, enlightenment is only salon talk — the 'new enlightenment' of the 1980s reopened precisely in acknowledgement of this tension

The paired holding of 'sedimentation and breakthrough': the stability of the cultural-psychological structure and the individual's creative突围 needing and conflicting with each other — the whole dynamic of art and thought living in this tension, any theory claiming 'pure free creation' or 'total structural determination' ruled a one-pole collapse

The holding structure of the late 'farewell to revolution': insisting on the ethical interrogation of revolutionary cost while refusing to repudiate the revolutionary legacy wholesale — 'I do not deny the historical role of revolution, but I would take revolution down from the only seat' — both ledgers held, no one-sided settlement
modern_applications_zh: 战略决策中的'双目标治理'：把'增长与合规''效率与韧性'写成并列约束并建立双指标治理——凡宣称'已平衡'的部门须出示两本账的原始记录
组织伦理争议的裁决格式：重大争议先做双方最强论证听证，再宣布'本裁决维持张力'的部分与'实践检验中'的部分——禁止用结论掩盖未解决的冲突
个人价值观的成熟化训练：识别自己宣称'看开了'的矛盾（事业与家庭、理想与现实）——检验是否只是单极化伪装；为两极写明各自的不可让渡底线
modern_applications_en: 'Dual-objective governance' in strategy: growth and compliance, efficiency and resilience written as parallel constraints under dual-metric governance — any department claiming 'balance achieved' must produce the raw ledgers

An adjudication format for organisational ethical disputes: hear both sides' strongest arguments first, then declare which part of the ruling 'holds the tension' and which is 'under practical test' — conclusions must not bury unresolved conflict

A training for the maturing of personal values: identify the contradictions one claims to have 'made peace with' (career and family, ideal and reality) — test whether it is one-pole collapse in disguise; write down the non-negotiable floor of each pole
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
康德（方法源头：二律背反学说——理性冲突的合法化）
达尔文（平行参照：以'持续张力'而非'最终和谐'解释生命的演化论思维）

modes.domain_zh: 哲学方法论/把理性主义的最终归宿还原为'情'：一切抽象价值（自由、正义、道德）若不能落回活生生的情感体验，就是空转的符号；哲学的终点不是真理体系而是心理的真实——'情本体'即'人如何在有限的此生安顿深情'
modes.domain_en: Philosophical methodology / reducing the final home of rationalism to 'emotion': every abstract value (freedom, justice, morality) that cannot fall back into living feeling is a symbol idling in the air; philosophy's terminus is not a system of truths but the reality of the psyche — the 'emotion-substance' being 'how one lodges deep feeling in this finite life'
modes.definition_zh: 哲学方法论/李泽厚晚年以'情本体'收束自己的全部体系：从康德式的'理性如何可能'出发，走到最后的问题却是'人的深情如何安放'——一切道德若只是义务的自律就是冰冷的形式，必须沉淀为'意愿如此'的情感（'内在自然的人化'）；一切自由若不能体验为幸福感就是空洞的权利；方法论上要求：检验任何价值体系与决策框架时，做'情本体还原'——追问它在活生生的心理经验中对应什么情感状态，若还原不出（只有逻辑没有体感、只有义务没有意愿、只有正确没有冷暖），则判定其为未完成的结构；'情本体'同时是对两边的拒绝：拒绝以宗教超越贬低现世情感，也拒绝以生物本能取消文化情感——'情'是文化塑造过的自然、自然化了的超越
modes.definition_en: Philosophical methodology / in old age Li Zehou closed his whole system with the 'emotion-substance': setting out from the Kantian 'how is reason possible', the final question became 'how is deep feeling to be lodged' — all morality, if mere self-legislation of duty, is a cold form and must sediment into the emotion of 'willing it so' (the humanisation of inner nature); all freedom, if not experienced as happiness, is an empty right; methodologically: when testing any value-system or decision framework, run the 'emotion-substance reduction' — ask what feeling-state it corresponds to in living experience; if none can be found (logic without bodily sense, duty without willingness, correctness without warmth), judge the structure unfinished; the emotion-substance refuses both extremes: the religious beyond that demeans worldly feeling, and the biological instinct that cancels cultural feeling — 'emotion' as nature shaped by culture, and transcendence naturalised
modes.source_chapter: 《人类学历史本体论》与《该中国哲学登场了？》：'情本体'——'文化以心理为终局积淀，心理以情感为最终真实'
modes.key_quote_zh: 道理讲到最后，要落在人心的一下发热上——落不下来的道理，逻辑上再漂亮，也只是空中转圈的符号。
modes.key_quote_en: Every argument, at the end, must land on a warmth in the human heart — what cannot land, however elegant its logic, remains a symbol circling in the air.
key_concepts: 内在自然的人化 the humanisation of inner nature（道德从外在义务沉淀为内在意愿——'我要做'替代'我该做'，情感是完成的形态）
the humanisation of inner nature (morality sedimenting from outward duty into inward willingness — 'I will' replacing 'I should', emotion as the completed form)
情理交融 the fusion of feeling and reason（情不是理性的杂质而是理性的完成态——'合情合理'是一个词组而非两个标准）
the fusion of feeling and reason (emotion not an impurity of reason but its completed state — 'reasonable and feeling-right' as one phrase, not two standards)
空转符号检验 the idling-symbol test（凡不能落回体感与情感状态的价值/原则/指标，判定为符号空转——修辞上的正确、经验上的零度）
the idling-symbol test (any value, principle or metric that cannot fall back into felt experience is a symbol idling — correct in rhetoric, zero in experience)
深情作为存在论深度 deep feeling as existential depth（'情'承担终极关怀：对人的深情即有限人生的意义来源——替代彼岸的另一种'超越'）
deep feeling as existential depth (emotion carrying ultimate concern: deep feeling for persons as the source of meaning in a finite life — another 'transcendence' in place of the beyond)
process_zh: 选定待检验的体系/决策/说服文本，列出其全部核心主张
逐条做情感还原：每条主张在真实心理经验中对应何种情感状态——找到具体的体感与情境证据
标记空转符号：还原失败的主张单独列出——分析它们是装饰、是过渡还是未完成的承诺
重接接口：为空转符号设计情感落点（仪式、故事、关系设计），或诚实承认该主张目前只是'纸面上的'
process_en: Select the system, decision or persuasion-text under test and list all its core claims
Run the emotional reduction line by line: what feeling-state does each claim answer to in real psychological experience — with concrete bodily and situational evidence
Mark the idling symbols: list the claims that fail reduction — analysing whether they are decoration, transition, or unfinished promise
Rewire the interface: design an emotional landing (ritual, story, relation-design) for each idling symbol, or honestly admit the claim remains 'on paper'
representative_cases_zh: 对儒家'仁'的重释（《论语今读》）：'仁'不是抽象德目而是情感的现实化——亲子之爱被提升为普遍伦理的基点，'老者安之，朋友信之，少者怀之'全部落在具体关系情感上；李泽厚以此说明儒家伦理两千年不坠的情感根基
对康德道德律的批评性收编：绝对命令作为形式可以成立，但作为动机不完整——真正被遵循的道德律必然已沉淀为'愿意如此'的情感；'位我上者灿烂星空，道德律令在我心中'的下一句应当是'而心中之律早已带着体温'
晚年对'人生意义'的回答：不接受宗教式解答也不接受虚无——意义在'对具体的人的深情'之中；'学以成人的最终课程是学会爱'——把哲学问题归还给心理与生活
representative_cases_en: The reinterpretation of Confucian 'ren' (benevolence) in Reading the Analects Today: not an abstract virtue-item but feeling made real — parental love elevated as the ground of universal ethics, 'the old given rest, friends given trust, the young given nurture' all landing on concrete relational feeling; thereby the emotional foundation of an ethics that held for two millennia

The critical annexation of Kant's moral law: the categorical imperative valid as form, incomplete as motive — a moral law truly followed must already have sedimented into the emotion of 'willing it so'; after 'the starry heavens above me and the moral law within me' there should stand: 'and the law within me has long carried a body's warmth'

The late answer to 'the meaning of life': accepting neither the religious solution nor the nihilist — meaning in 'deep feeling for concrete persons'; 'the final lesson of learning to become human is learning to love' — returning the philosophical question to the psyche and to life
modern_applications_zh: 组织价值观落地方法：对每条价值观做'情感还原审计'——它能唤起员工的何种真实情感？还原失败的价值观要么重新设计落点（故事、仪式、案例）要么诚实下架
用户体验的深度度量：在功能指标之上增加'情本体层'——用户对该产品是否存有'深情'（长期依恋、主动讲述、情感投射）；留存率的根在情感不在习惯
说服与传播设计：任何倡导先找'情感落点'再谈论据——只有逻辑没有体感的论证在认知上成立而在行动上失效；检验标准：听者能否复述出'这让我心里哪一下发热'
modern_applications_en: A method for landing organisational values: an 'emotional-reduction audit' of each value — what real feeling can it summon in employees? Values that fail get a redesigned landing (story, ritual, case) or are honestly taken down

A deep measure of user experience: above functional metrics, an 'emotion-substance layer' — does the user hold 'deep feeling' toward the product (long attachment, voluntary telling, emotional projection); the root of retention is in feeling, not habit

Design of persuasion and communication: for any advocacy, find the 'emotional landing' before the arguments — argument with logic but no bodily sense holds cognitively and fails behaviourally; the test: can the listener name 'which warmth in the heart this touched'
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
孔子（情感伦理的原型：'仁'以亲子之爱为根——儒家两千年情感的哲学化）
康德（对照系与出发点：义务论的形式主义——情本体正是对'动机空壳'的补全）

modes.domain_zh: 存在论与历史哲学方法论/在'历史必然'与'文化结构'之外为个体偶然性留出本体论席位：历史由亿万'一次性'的个体选择与相遇构成——结构解释一切，唯独解释不了'为什么是这个人、在这个时刻、做了这件不可重复的事'
modes.domain_en: Ontological and historiographical methodology / reserving, beyond 'historical necessity' and 'cultural structure', an ontological seat for individual contingency: history is made of millions of once-only choices and encounters — structure explains everything except 'why this person, at this moment, did this unrepeatable thing'
modes.definition_zh: 存在论与历史哲学方法论/李泽厚的'积淀说'极易被读成文化决定论，他晚年在《人类学历史本体论》中专门加固了另一端：个体不是结构的执行程序——每个人的存在都是'一次性的、偶然的、不可重复的'；历史必然性只是统计趋势，而任何具体历史时刻都由无法还原为趋势的个体决断与偶然相遇打开（他反复引用：没有偶然的个体选择，秦始皇之后未必有汉制，五四之后未必有某种主义的中国化）；方法论上要求：解释任何历史事件或组织命运时，在结构分析之外强制附加'偶然性审计'——列出当时的个体决断点（谁在什么时刻可以做出不同的选择）、信息与相遇的偶然性（哪些纯靠运气）、以及'换一个人历史是否改写'的反事实检验；这不是否认规律，而是给自由与责任留出位置：正因为存在是偶然的，个体的选择才真实
modes.definition_en: Ontological and historiographical methodology / the 'sedimentation' thesis reads easily as cultural determinism, so late in the Anthropological-Historical Ontology Li Zehou deliberately fortified the other end: the individual is no executing programme of structure — each existence is 'once-only, contingent, unrepeatable'; historical necessity is a statistical trend, while every concrete moment of history is opened by individual decisions and chance encounters irreducible to trend (as he repeated: without contingent individual choice, after Qin Shihuang there need have been no Han institutions, after May Fourth no particular sinicisation of an ideology); methodologically: in explaining any historical event or organisational fate, append beyond the structural analysis a mandatory 'contingency audit' — listing the individual decision-points of the moment (who, at what hour, could have chosen otherwise), the contingency of information and encounter (what rested on pure luck), and the counterfactual test 'with another person, would history have been rewritten'; not a denial of law but a seat reserved for freedom and responsibility: precisely because existence is contingent, individual choice is real
modes.source_chapter: 《人类学历史本体论》(2008)：'偶然性是存在的本体属性——个体的每一次选择都在重写结构的边界'
modes.key_quote_zh: 结构算得出大潮，算不出谁先跳进水里——历史每一页都是必然的语法、偶然的笔迹；所以人要为自己的笔迹负责，也只有这样，'人'才不是结构的复读机。
modes.key_quote_en: Structure can compute the tide but not who first leaps into the water — every page of history is necessity's grammar in contingency's handwriting; therefore each is answerable for his hand, and only so is 'man' not the复读机 of structure.
key_concepts: 偶然性审计 the contingency audit（在结构解释之后强制追问：当时的个体决断点在哪里、哪些环节纯系偶然）
the contingency audit (after the structural explanation, forced questioning: where were the individual decision-points, which links rested on pure chance)
一次性存在 once-only existence（每个人的存在不可重复也不可替代——结构论必须给'此人'而非'任何人'留位置）
once-only existence (each existence unrepeatable and irreplaceable — structural theory must reserve a seat for 'this person', not 'any person')
反事实改写检验 the counterfactual-rewrite test（'换一个人/换一个时机，结局是否不同'——差异越大，偶然性的本体权重越高）
the counterfactual-rewrite test ('another person, another hour — would the outcome differ'; the wider the difference, the heavier the ontological weight of contingency)
自由与责任的锚 anchoring freedom and responsibility（正因存在偶然，选择才真实、责任才成立——决定论是责任的最深形式化）
anchoring freedom and responsibility (because existence is contingent, choice is real and responsibility holds — determinism is responsibility's deepest formalisation)
process_zh: 先完成结构分析：承认趋势、约束与文化沉淀的真实作用——把它们写足
做偶然性审计：列出该事件全部个体决断点、信息偶然与相遇偶然——标注每一处的'可替换度'
做反事实改写检验：替换关键人物/时机，检验结局稳定性——把'结构决定'与'个人书写'的边界画出来
回到责任与自由：把审计结论转化为'此刻的我们处在哪些决断点上'——历史学的终点是行动者的清醒
process_en: First complete the structural analysis: admit the real force of trend, constraint and cultural sediment — write them in full
Run the contingency audit: list every individual decision-point, every contingency of information and encounter, marking each link's 'replaceability'
Run the counterfactual-rewrite test: substitute the key figure or the timing and test the stability of the outcome — drawing the boundary between 'structure decides' and 'persons write'
Return to responsibility and freedom: convert the audit into 'at which decision-points do we stand now' — the terminus of historiography is the lucidity of the actor
representative_cases_zh: 对'历史必然性'的持续修正：李泽厚反复以秦汉之际、明清之际与近代转型为例说明——趋势（集权化、商业化和现代化压力）真实存在，但每一转折的具体形态都系于关键人物的偶然决断；'如果没有汉武帝的独尊儒术，儒学未必以那种形态成为正统'——结构给了舞台，个体写了剧本
对五四一代的处理：他既承认新文化运动的结构性条件（科举废除、留学生群体、出版业），又强调陈独秀、胡适等人'恰好在那个时刻以那种方式出现'的偶然性——同一结构条件下完全可以有另一种更温和或更激进的启蒙
晚年对个人命运的哲学总结：他把自己一生的漂泊（大陆-美国、中心-边缘）也纳入'偶然'的思考——'我的人生一半是自己选的，一半是历史随手安排的；哲学能做的，是把随手安排也活成自己的选择'
representative_cases_en: The continual correction of 'historical necessity': again and again, the Qin-Han transition, the Ming-Qing transition and the modern transformation serve as examples — trends (centralisation, commercialisation, the pressure to modernise) real, yet the concrete shape of every turning hinged on the contingent decisions of key figures; 'without Han Wudi's enthroning of the classics, Confucianism need not have become orthodox in that form' — structure gave the stage, individuals wrote the script

The treatment of the May Fourth generation: structural conditions of the New Culture Movement admitted (the abolition of the examinations, the returned-student cohort, the publishing industry), while stressing the contingency of 'Chen Duxiu and Hu Shi appearing just at that hour in just that way' — under the same structural conditions a milder or a more radical enlightenment was entirely possible

The late philosophical summing of personal fate: his own drifting (mainland-America, centre-margin) drawn into the reflection on contingency — 'half my life I chose, half history arranged at random; what philosophy can do is live even the random arrangement as one's own choice'
modern_applications_zh: 组织复盘的'决断点地图'：结构归因（市场、制度、技术）之外，强制标注关键个体决断点与纯运气环节——防止'必然如此'叙事掩盖责任与机会
人才与继任规划：承认'此人不可替代'的真实性——关键岗位的继任不是找'同款'而是重新审计'换人之后哪些路径改变'；偶然性审计应进入并购与投资尽调
个人决策哲学：识别自己人生中已关闭与仍敞开的决断点——以'不可重复性'作为郑重对待选择的心理杠杆：正因不能重来，此刻才值得全副认真
modern_applications_en: A 'map of decision-points' for organisational retrospectives: beyond structural attribution (market, institution, technology), mandatory marking of key individual decision-points and pure-luck links — preventing the 'it was inevitable' narrative from burying both responsibility and opportunity

Talent and succession planning: admitting the reality of 'this person is irreplaceable' — succession for key seats not a search for 'the same model' but a fresh audit of 'which paths change when the person changes'; the contingency audit should enter M&A and investment due diligence

A personal philosophy of decision: identify the decision-points in one's own life already closed and still open — the unrepeatable as the psychological lever for taking choices seriously: precisely because there is no replay, this hour deserves one's whole seriousness
representative_figures: 李泽厚（核心）
康德（自由问题的源头：必然与自由的二律背反——个体偶然存在法是其历史化）
达尔文（平行参照：变异的偶然性与选择的偶然性——演化史上的'一次性事件'思维）

H-ISA-001.school: 卡斯蒂利亚'新君主制'（王权集权与国家构建）
H-ISA-001.historical_significance: 卡斯蒂利亚女王（1451-1504），'天主教双王'之一：以秘密婚姻联合阿拉贡王冠、以内战后十五年不间断的制度施工（圣兄弟会治安体系、货币财政改革、corregidor 王室市长制、宗教裁判所的司法集权）把一个被贵族撕裂的王国改造成近代欧洲第一台'新君主制'国家机器；以十年格拉纳达战争的资产负债表式经营完成收复失地运动的终章；以一纸敕令派遣哥伦布开启大西洋时代，并在次年推动《托尔德西里亚斯条约》锁定航海成果——一个女人的四项决定（联姻、加冕、战争、西航）共同画出了近代西班牙与拉丁美洲的版图
H-ISA-001.historical_significance_en: Queen of Castile (1451-1504), one of 'the Catholic Monarchs': through a secret marriage she united the crown of Aragon; through fifteen years of unbroken institutional construction after the civil war (the Santa Hermandad's system of order, monetary and fiscal reform, the corregidor system of royal magistrates, the judicial centralization of the Inquisition) she reforged a kingdom torn by nobles into early modern Europe's first machine of the 'New Monarchy'; through the balance-sheet conduct of the ten-year Granada war she brought the reconquista to its close; and with a single patent she commissioned Columbus, opening the Atlantic age, then pushed the Treaty of Tordesillas the next year to lock in its gains — four decisions of one woman (marriage, coronation, war, westward voyage) together drew the map of modern Spain and Latin America
H-ISA-001.unique_thinking: 伊莎贝拉的独特思维不在于任何单一领域的深度，而在于'把一切工具化的统摄力'：婚姻是并表方案、信仰是财政资产、战争是制度工场、继承是组合管理、遗诏是治理合同。她的每一项行动都同时 operating 在两个层面——眼前的事件层面与长远的制度层面；格拉纳达围城的同时她在改铸货币，哥伦布陈情的六年里她在备置条件而不是修补方案。她从不发明工具，只做最清醒的工具使用者：把许可倒序（既成事实）、把账本分立（王冠联合）、把符号入表（十字军什一税）、把条款咬合（遗诏）——四类操作在她手中反复出现，构成一套完整的'主权方法论'
H-ISA-001.unique_thinking_en: Isabella's distinctiveness lies not in depth in any single field but in a governing power of instrumentalization: marriage a consolidation plan, belief a fiscal asset, war an institutional workshop, succession a portfolio, the will a governance contract. Every one of her actions operated on two levels at once — the immediate event and the long-run institution; she reminted coinage during the siege of Granada, and through the six years of Columbus's petitions she stocked conditions rather than patching the plan. She invented no tools; she was their clearest user: inverting permission (the accomplished fact), separating ledgers (the union of crowns), placing symbols on the ledger (the crusade tithe), interlocking clauses (the will) — four operations recurring throughout her hand, composing a complete methodology of sovereignty
H-ISA-001.civilization_zh: 十五世纪下半叶的伊比利亚现场：1451年生于卡斯蒂利亚中部的马德里加尔——父王胡安二世早逝、异母兄恩里克四世在位，王廷被贵族派系撕成碎片；少女时代在阿雷瓦洛与塞戈维亚的冷宫式监护中度过，身边环绕着觊觛王位的贵族与摇摆的廷臣；1468年《托罗之约》承认其为阿斯图里亚斯女亲王，1469年十八岁力排众议与阿拉贡的斐迪南秘密成婚——一道诏书、一次乔装、一场没有王室祝福的婚礼，换来卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡两顶王冠的联合；1474年兄死，她在塞戈维亚圣米格尔广场顶着内战加冕为王——葡萄牙入侵、贵族叛乱、王国金币贬值同时压来；1476年创立圣兄弟会（Santa Hermandad）以城镇民兵恢复治安，1476-1478年托莱多与布尔戈斯的改革议会在货币、财政、司法上重建王国信用；1478年获教皇敕令设立卡斯蒂利亚宗教裁判所，1480年托莱多议会定型其组织；1482-1492年十年格拉纳达战争——亲临前线、以后勤与营地建造指挥战争；1492年攻克格拉纳达、驱逐犹太人、派遣哥伦布——同一年做成的三件改写世界史的事；晚年丧子丧媳（胡安王子与伊莎贝拉公主相继早逝、疯女胡安娜成为继承人），1504年在梅迪纳德尔坎波离世。她的一生是'在婚姻里做主权交易、在战争里做制度建设、在信仰里做政治清洗'的完整标本。
H-ISA-001.civilization_en: The Iberian scene of the later fifteenth century: born in 1451 at Madrigal de las Altas Torres in the heart of Castile — her father John II dead early, her half-brother Henry IV reigning, the court torn to shreds by noble factions; a girlhood spent under cold, guardianship-style custody at Arevalo and Segovia, ringed by nobles coveting the throne and wavering courtiers; the Concord of Toros in 1468 recognized her as Princess of Asturias, and in 1469, at eighteen, she defied every counsel to marry Ferdinand of Aragon in secret — a forged papal bull, a disguised journey, a wedding without royal blessing, traded for the union of the crowns of Castile and Aragon; in 1474, at her brother's death, she was crowned at Segovia's Plaza de San Miguel amid civil war — Portuguese invasion, noble rebellion and a debased coinage pressing in at once; in 1476 she founded the Santa Hermandad, a town militia restoring public order, and the reform Cortes of Toledo and Burgos (1476-78) rebuilt the kingdom's credit in coin, finance and justice; in 1478 a papal bull established the Castilian Inquisition, whose organization was fixed at the Cortes of Toledo in 1480; from 1482 to 1492 the ten-year Granada war — she went to the front in person and commanded through logistics and camp-building; in 1492 Granada fell, the Jews were expelled, and Columbus sailed — three world-history-changing acts completed in a single year; her later years were eaten by grief — Prince John and Princess Isabella died one after the other, mad Juana became heir — and she died at Medina del Campo in 1504. Her life is a complete specimen of 'sovereignty negotiated through marriage, institution built through war, and political cleansing enacted through faith.'

cross_references.description_zh: 孙思邈直接继承张仲景的辨证论治框架并把它工程化：《千金要方》几乎完整收录《伤寒论》条文而以方类证重排，'同病异治、异病同治'的辨证核心在孙思邈手中扩展为妇孺食养针药全领域；他公开批评'江南诸师秘仲景要方不宣'，以公开化立场守护了仲景之学的传承。
cross_references.description_en: Sun Simiao inherited Zhang Zhongjing's pattern-differentiation framework and engineered it: the Qianjin Yaofang reproduces the Shanghan Lun text nearly whole, re-sorted by formula-into-pattern, and extends the core of 'same disease, different treatments' across women's and children's care, dietetics, needles and herbs; he openly attacked 'masters south of the river who keep Zhongjing's formulas secret', guarding the transmission of the Zhongjing school with a public-knowledge stance.

cross_references.description_zh: 孙思邈与李时珍相隔近千年，是'方法系统化'与'知识系统化'的对极：孙思邈把临床决策写成阶梯与伦理（怎么治），李时珍把药物世界写成分类档案（有什么药）；两者同以'千金/本草'为题眼——'人命至重有贵千金'与'本草纲目'都把医学知识的公共性置于个人声誉之上；李时珍的《本草纲目》1892种药分类法，正是孙思邈'医案档案法'在药物学维度的完成。
cross_references.description_en: A millennium apart, Sun Simiao and Li Shizhen form the poles of method-systematization versus knowledge-systematization: Sun wrote clinical decision as ladder and ethic (how to treat), Li wrote the world of drugs as a classified archive (what drugs exist); both echo 'a thousand gold' — putting the public character of medical knowledge above personal fame; Li's 1,892-drug taxonomy in the Bencao Gangmu is Sun's case-archive method completed in the pharmacological dimension.

cross_references.description_zh: 孙思邈与盖伦同为古代医学的'方法自觉'代表而取向相反：盖伦以解剖-实验把医学推向侵入性验证与个人权威（'我的文本即正统'），孙思邈以阶梯与档案把医学推向温和干预与知识公共品（'涉猎群书、博采众方'）；盖伦的传统靠权威延续千年，孙思邈的方法靠可复制的档案体系传承——权威型与系统型两种知识传承路线的经典对照。
cross_references.description_en: Sun Simiao and Galen, both exemplars of methodological self-awareness in ancient medicine, took opposite tacks: Galen drove medicine toward invasive verification and personal authority ('my texts are the canon'), Sun toward gentle intervention and knowledge as a public good ('range widely, harvest many formulas'); Galen's tradition endured a millennium on authority, Sun's on a replicable archive system — the classic contrast between authority-based and system-based knowledge transmission.

cross_references.description_zh: 孙思邈与伊本·西那（阿维森纳）各建医学总集（7世纪/11世纪）：《千金方》与《医典》同为百科全书式的临床工程；《医典》长于体系逻辑与药物试验规则，《千金方》长于伦理总纲与治疗阶梯；孙思邈收录印度耆婆医方，阿维森纳吸收盖伦-希腊传统——两位总集作者共同证明：医学成为'可积累的公共工程'是各文明的独立收敛。
cross_references.description_en: Sun Simiao and Ibn Sina (Avicenna) built medical compendia in parallel eras (7th/11th centuries): the Qianjin Fang and the Canon of Medicine as encyclopedic clinical engineering; the Canon excels in systematic logic and drug-trial rules, the Qianjin in its master ethic and treatment ladder; Sun absorbed the Indian Jivaka tradition, Avicenna the Galenic-Greek — two compilers jointly proving that medicine as accumulable public engineering is an independent convergence of civilizations.

cross_references.description_zh: 华佗与张仲景同为建安神医而路径相反：仲景以《伤寒杂病论》的条文-方剂体系把医学写成'可读的文本'，华佗以手术-麻醉-导引的操作体系把医学做成'可施的动作'——一个以书传世而体系永存，一个以技行世而书焚于狱：同代两条路线的命运对照，恰构成知识传承方式（文档 vs 身传）的最完整实验。
cross_references.description_en: Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing, divine physicians of the same Jian'an era, took opposite roads: Zhongjing wrote medicine as readable text — the pattern-formula system of the Shanghan Zabing Lun — while Hua Tuo made medicine as performable action — surgery, anesthesia and exercise; one transmitted by book with the system surviving forever, one practiced by hand with the book burned in prison: a same-era natural experiment on transmission by document versus transmission by body.

cross_references.description_zh: 华佗是孙思邈方法的四个上游之一：孙思邈'针药并用'的提法明确把'只用一种手段者非良医'与华佗方药针灸手术多栖的实践相接续；'摄养有常法'的运动常数承接五禽戏把运动写成日常处方的先例；孙思邈在《千金要方》中收录'华佗霍乱吐方'等佗方——华佗失传的体系经由孙思邈的档案法获得部分存续，恰是'文档化传承'对'身传失败'的历史补救。
cross_references.description_en: Hua Tuo is one of Sun Simiao's four upstreams: Sun's multimodal doctrine that 'the single-modality practitioner is no good physician' continues Hua Tuo's mastery of herbs, needles and surgery; Sun's constant self-regulation inherits the five-animal precedent of exercise as daily prescription; and the Qianjin Yaofang preserves formulas attributed to Tuo — the lost system partially rescued by Sun's archive method, the historical remedy of documentation for the failure of body-transmission.

cross_references.description_zh: 华佗与盖伦是古代外科的两大高峰而制度命运相反：盖伦得到罗马帝国与角斗士伤员的体系支撑，解剖-治疗传统靠权威文本传续千年；华佗在'身体发肤受之父母'的文化约束与权力征召之间独木支撑，书焚技失——外科的兴衰不只取决于技术高度，更取决于制度与传承环境：两者的对照是技术史对'环境决定论'的天然案例。
cross_references.description_en: Hua Tuo and Galen, twin peaks of ancient surgery with opposite institutional fates: Galen had the Roman empire and gladiators' wounds behind him, his anatomical-therapeutic tradition carried a millennium by authoritative texts; Hua Tuo stood alone between the cultural constraint of 'body and hair from one's parents' and the summons of power, his book burned and art lost — surgery's rise and fall depends not on technical height alone but on institutional and transmission environment: a natural case for environmental determinism in the history of technology.

cross_references.description_zh: 李时珍对华佗是档案法对失传知识的二次拯救：《本草纲目》系统收录散见于后世方书的华佗佗方与麻沸散组成线索（曼陀罗花等），并在虫部、草部多处引'佗曰'——失传内容经由晚出档案的可考残片被部分重建；华佗案也反向印证李时珍'每一药必注出处'的档案纪律：文档化不是著述偏好，而是知识存活的唯一保险。
cross_references.description_en: Li Shizhen stands to Hua Tuo as the archive rescuing lost knowledge a second time: the Bencao Gangmu systematically collects Hua Tuo's scattered formulas and the compositional clues of mafeisan (datura flower among them), citing 'Tuo said' throughout the insect and herb sections — the lost content partially rebuilt from verifiable fragments in later archives; the Hua Tuo case in turn vindicates Li's archival discipline of sourcing every drug: documentation is not a stylistic preference but the only insurance of knowledge's survival.

cross_references.description_zh: 李冶与秦九韶同代而南北分治（金元/南宋），同把中国代数推向方程化：秦九韶《数书九章》以正负开方术解高次方程数值根，李冶《测圆海镜》以天元术建立方程——一个精于'解'，一个精于'立'；两人互不知晓而方法互补，恰是宋元数学高峰的一体两面；清代焦循、李锐同时校释二人著作，才把'立'与'解'重新接通。
cross_references.description_en: Contemporaries ruling under rival regimes (Jin-Yuan north, Southern Song south), Li Ye and Qin Jiushao both drove Chinese algebra toward the equational: Qin's Shushu Jiuzhang solved high-degree equations numerically by the positive-negative root method, Li's Ceyuan Haijing established equations by tianyuan shu — one mastered 'solving', the other 'forming'; unknowing of each other yet complementary, two faces of the Song-Yuan mathematical summit; Qing scholars Jiao Xun and Li Rui annotated both, finally reconnecting forming and solving.

cross_references.description_zh: 李冶与朱世杰相隔约半个世纪而同属北方天元术传统：朱世杰《四元玉鉴》把李冶的一元天元推广为四元（天地人物），《算学启蒙》作为其入门教本复制了李冶'深书配浅书'的双轨模式；李冶封龙山讲学所维系的北方数学学脉，正是朱世杰'燕山数学'得以站立的肩膀——从一元到四元的阶梯由李冶奠基。
cross_references.description_en: Half a century apart yet of one northern tianyuan tradition: Zhu Shijie's Siyuan Yujian extended Li Ye's single-element method to four elements (heaven, earth, man, thing), and his Suanxue Qimeng primer replicated Li's twin-track model of deep book plus plain book; the northern mathematical lineage sustained by Li's Fenglong Mountain teaching is the shoulder on which Zhu's 'Yanshan mathematics' stood — the ladder from one element to four was built on Li's foundation.

cross_references.description_zh: 李冶与笛卡尔相隔近四百年而共享'设元-列方程-求解'的分析法骨架：天元术的'立天元一'与解析几何的'设坐标变量'同为未知量显式化；不同处在配套工程——笛卡尔以坐标系把代数与几何双向打通，李冶以'识别杂记'总表与《益古演段》浅写轨把方法与传承打通——两人分别补全了方程思维的不同周边。
cross_references.description_en: Nearly four centuries apart, Li Ye and Descartes share the analytic skeleton of set-the-unknown, form-the-equation, solve: tianyuan's 'establish the celestial element' and analytic geometry's coordinate variables are the same explicitation of the unknown; the difference lies in the surrounding works — Descartes joined algebra and geometry two-way with coordinates, Li joined method and transmission with the recognition register and the Yigu Yanduan plain track — each completing a different flank of equation-thinking.

cross_references.description_zh: 李冶与蒋守敬（郭守敬）同在元初为历算之学分流：郭守敬以《授时历》把数学投向天文工程（国家项目），李冶以《测圆海镜》把数学保存在个人著作与书院（文明项目）；王恂、郭守敬历法工作背后即有天元术一系的方法储备——两条路线共同证明：乱世之后数学的存续既需要国家工程，也需要'孤本守心'的民间学脉。
cross_references.description_en: Li Ye and Guo Shoujing, contemporaries of early Yuan, split the mathematical vocation: Guo's Shoushi Calendar threw mathematics into astronomical engineering (a state project), Li's Ceyuan Haijing kept it alive in private books and the academy (a civilizational project); the calendar work of Wang Xun and Guo Shoujing drew on method reserves of the tianyuan line — two routes jointly proving that after dynastic ruin, mathematics survives both through state engineering and through the private lineage of 'safeguarding the masterwork'.

cross_references.description_zh: 秦九韶与李冶同代而南北分治（南宋/金元），同把中国代数推向方程化：秦九韶《数书九章》以正负开方术解高次方程数值根、以大衍术处理同余，李冶《测圆海镜》以天元术建立方程——一个精于'解'，一个精于'立'；两人互不知晓而方法互补，恰是宋元数学高峰的一体两面；清代焦循、李锐同时校释二人著作，才把'立'与'解'重新接通。
cross_references.description_en: Contemporaries ruling under rival regimes (Southern Song south, Jin-Yuan north), Qin Jiushao and Li Ye both drove Chinese algebra toward the equational: Qin's Shushu Jiuzhang solved high-degree equations numerically by positive-negative extraction and congruences by the dayan method, Li's Ceyuan Haijing formed equations by tianyuan shu — one mastered 'solving', the other 'forming'; unknowing of each other yet complementary, two faces of the Song-Yuan mathematical summit; Qing scholars Jiao Xun and Li Rui annotated both, finally reconnecting forming and solving.

cross_references.description_zh: 秦九韶与高斯相隔五百五十年而在两处独立抵达同一数学：秦氏大衍求一术系统解决一次同余方程组，高斯《Disquisitiones Arithmeticae》（1801）以公理化语言重建同余理论并给出存在性证明——'中国剩余定理'的发现权在数学上归属两人；同样，秦氏正负开方术的嵌套求值与高斯同时代霍纳（1819）的算法重名。跨文明的两次'再发现'证明：深刻的数学结构会被不同文明各自找到一次。
