cross_references.description_en: Five and a half centuries apart, Qin Jiushao and Gauss reached the same mathematics independently: Qin's dayan rule of one solved simultaneous linear congruences, while Gauss's Disquisitiones Arithmeticae (1801) rebuilt congruence theory in axiomatic language with existence proofs — the Chinese Remainder Theorem is mathematically credited to both; likewise Qin's nested evaluation in root extraction shares its name with Horner's (1819) algorithm of Gauss's era. Two cross-civilizational 'rediscoveries' prove that deep mathematical structures are found once by every civilization that needs them.

cross_references.description_zh: 秦九韶的'术-草-图'三层体例与欧几里得《几何原本》的'定义-公设-证明'结构构成东西方方法论文本的两种原型：欧氏从公理演绎出全部命题、依赖逻辑链的不可断性，秦氏对每题给出可复演的完整演算、依赖程序链的不可断性——一个以逻辑保证普遍，一个以程序保证普遍；两者共同奠基了'知识必须可被异时异地的读者独立重走'的现代标准。
cross_references.description_en: Qin's three-layer format of statement, working and figure, and Euclid's Elements structure of definitions, postulates and proofs, are the two prototypes of methodological text East and West: Euclid derives every proposition from axioms, staking universality on an unbreakable logical chain; Qin gives each problem a fully reproducible computation, staking universality on an unbreakable procedural chain — one guarantees the universal by logic, the other by procedure; together they ground the modern standard that knowledge must be independently re-walkable by readers elsewhere and later.

cross_references.description_zh: 秦九韶与朱世杰相隔约半个世纪而同属宋元数学高峰的两大支柱：秦九韶把方程求解与同余求解推到极限（高次方程数值解、大衍术），朱世杰《四元玉鉴》把李冶的一元天元推广为四元并发展高阶等差级数——一个精于'一元之解'，一个精于'多元之立'；《算学启蒙》与《四元玉鉴》的深浅双轨复制了秦氏'术草图'的可教设计——宋元数学的顶峰由'解'与'立'两条路线共同托起。
cross_references.description_en: Half a century apart, Qin Jiushao and Zhu Shijie are the twin pillars of the Song-Yuan summit: Qin pushed equation-solving and congruence-solving to their limits (numerical roots of high-degree equations, the dayan method), while Zhu's Siyuan Yujian extended Li Ye's single-element method to four and developed higher-order series — one mastering the 'solving of one variable', the other the 'forming of many'; the deep-plain pairing of the Suanxue Qimeng and Siyuan Yujian replicated Qin's teachable three-layer design — the summit of Song-Yuan mathematics held up by both the solving and the forming routes.

cross_references.description_zh: 马端临与司马迁相隔一千三百年而同守'网罗放失旧闻'之志：太史公'厥协六经异传，整齐百家杂语'确立多源采信的史家原型，马端临'凡百家传记，但有一说可取者，无不搜罗'把这一征集面推向典章制度史的极限——一个以人物列传存文明，一个以制度条目存文明；《史记》的'网罗'是抢救性收集，马端临的'网罗'是系统化征考，从天才的直觉到可传承的体例，正是史学方法成熟的两级台阶。
cross_references.description_en: A millennium and three centuries apart, Ma Duanlin kept faith with Sima Qian's ambition of 'netting the lost tales of the realm': the Grand Historian's 'concord of the six schools' and 'ordering of the hundred schools' set the archetype of multi-source collection, and Ma's 'whatever one usable account exists, it is gathered in' pushed that collecting net to the limits of institutional history — one preserving civilization through lives, the other through institutional entries; Sima Qian's netting was rescue gathering, Ma's was systematic examination: from genius's intuition to transmissible format, the two steps of historiography's maturing.

cross_references.description_zh: 马端临与黄宗羲同为王朝倾覆后的'存文献者'而路径互补：黄宗羲以《明儒学案》存一代学脉、以'学案体'为思想立传，马端临以《文献通考》存一代典章、以'分目立类'为制度立谱——一个存'人'与'学'，一个存'制'与'事'；两人都拒仕新朝而以著述为遗民之业，都以'会通'对治断代之偏；学案体的'序录-学案-附录'三层与通考的'总序-小序-按语'三层，是同一导读设计在思想史与制度史中的两个完成态。
cross_references.description_en: Ma Duanlin and Huang Zongxi, both 'preservers of documents' after a dynasty's fall, took complementary paths: Huang saved a generation's intellectual lineage in the Mingru Xue'an, writing biography for thought with the xue'an format; Ma saved a generation's institutions in the Wenxian Tongkao, writing genealogy for governance with topical division — one preserving 'persons and learning,' the other 'institutions and affairs'; both refused the new dynasty, making writing their loyalist vocation, both countering dynastic fragmentariness with concourse; the xue'an's three layers (survey, cases, appendix) and the Tongkao's three layers (general preface, sectional prefaces, editorial notes) are the same guiding design completed in intellectual and institutional history.

cross_references.description_zh: 马端临与沈括同出两宋而方向相反：沈括以《梦溪笔谈》把'见闻'写成百科——现象与技艺的即时记录者；马端临以《文献通考》把'记录'织成体系——典章与制度的长时段织工；一个信'亲验'（以实验与勘测修正文本），一个信'征考'（以出处与对勘修正传闻）；沈括代表宋代知识文化的'横向博物'，马端临代表其'纵向通考'——两者合观，方见两宋知识工程的完整光谱：从记录一切到贯通一切。
cross_references.description_en: Both of the Song world yet moving in opposite directions: Shen Kuo's Brush Talks wrote 'what was seen and heard' into an encyclopedia — an instant recorder of phenomena and techniques; Ma Duanlin's Tongkao wove 'what was recorded' into a system — a long-duration weaver of institutions and governance; one trusted 'personal verification' (correcting texts by experiment and survey), the other 'documentary examination' (correcting hearsay by provenance and collation); Shen Kuo is Song knowledge culture's horizontal natural history, Ma Duanlin its vertical comprehensive examination — together they span the full spectrum of the Song knowledge enterprise, from recording everything to connecting everything.

cross_references.description_zh: 马端临的对象纬、物异门的处理与王充《论衡》的疾虚妄一脉相承：王充把灾祥从'天谴'还原为'自然之变'，马端临在象纬、物异门'记其事而不附会其义'——记录与解释分轨，超验叙事被降格为待考条目；两人相隔千余年而共享同一史学立场：史官的职责是存真，不是证道；这一'记录不解'的体例设计，使《通考》的类目架构本身成为理性化的标本。
cross_references.description_en: Ma Duanlin's handling of the astrology and anomalies sections descends from Wang Chong's campaign against the false in the Lunheng: Wang Chong restored omens from 'heavenly chastisement' to 'natural change,' and Ma Duanlin in the xiangwei and wuyi sections 'recorded the event without appending the meaning' — record and interpretation on separate tracks, transcendent narrative demoted to entries pending examination; a millennium apart they share one historiographic stance: the historian's duty is to preserve the true, not to prove the Way; this 'record without interpreting' format makes the Tongkao's very architecture a specimen of rationalization.

cross_references.description_zh: 胡三省与李冶同为宋元之际的遗民学者，同面对'学问如何活过王朝更替'的方法问题而路径互补：李冶以孤本裁决存其精思（'独《测圆海镜》不可燔'），胡三省以可复制重写抗兵火（《通鉴广注》毁于 1276 而三年重撰）——一个靠聚焦保全，一个靠复现重建；两人又同以'后世必有知者'临终托付，同为延时承认的范例。
cross_references.description_en: Hu Sanxing and Li Ye, both loyalist scholars of the Song-Yuan transition, faced the same methodological problem — how learning outlives dynasties — by complementary paths: Li trusted the verdict of a sole masterpiece ('only the Ceyuan Haijing must not burn'), Hu trusted reproducible rewriting (the Guangzhu burned in 1276, rewritten in three years) — one preserved by focus, one rebuilt by reproduction; both died entrusting their work to 'knowers in later generations', twin exemplars of delayed recognition.

cross_references.description_zh: 胡三省与孙思邈相隔六百年而共享'以个案积累成体系'的工程路径：孙思邈《千金方》以医案档案法把临床经验编成可检索体系，胡三省以《音注》把史事考证编成六层注释体系——两人都拒绝一次性巨构，都以毕生日课把增量知识织入同一结构，且都活成了其领域的'标准参考实现'。
cross_references.description_en: Six centuries apart, Hu Sanxing and Sun Simiao share the engineering path of building a system from accumulated cases: Sun's Qianjin Fang turned clinical experience into a retrievable case-archive, Hu's Yinzu turned historical criticism into a six-stratum commentary system — both rejecting one-shot monuments, both weaving incremental knowledge by lifelong daily rhythm into one structure, both becoming the standard reference implementation of their fields.

cross_references.description_zh: 胡三省与董仲舒代表史学的两种立场：董仲舒以'天人三策'进入权力核心、以经学塑造制度——学者与权力合一；胡三省在宋亡后拒绝一切征辟，以注文的缝隙安放兴亡之论——学者与权力绝缘而与时间结盟。前者示范了建制内影响的峰值，后者示范了建制外存续的韧性；两者共同划定了'策士'与'注者'两种学者生存策略的边界。
cross_references.description_en: Hu Sanxing and Dong Zhongshu embody two stances of scholarship: Dong entered the seat of power with the 'three对策 on Heaven and Man', shaping institutions through the classics — scholar and power fused; Hu, after the Song fell, refused every summons and set his judgments on rise and fall in the seams of annotation — scholar severed from power, allied with time. The first shows the peak of influence within institutions, the second the resilience of survival outside them; together they bound the two strategies of the counsellor and the annotator.

cross_references.description_zh: 胡三省与张载同属'为往圣继绝学'的北方-浙东学脉谱系：张载以关学在北宋确立'学以载道'的独立学术人格，胡三省以遗民注史在宋元之际把这一人格推向'国可亡而史不可灭'的极端形态；浙东史学（及清代章学诚'六经皆史'）上承关学'以礼为教'的经世传统，胡三省的'以注存史'正是该传统在亡国条件下的方法论变体。
cross_references.description_en: Hu Sanxing and Zhang Zai belong to one lineage of 'continuing the interrupted learning for the sages': Zhang Zai's Guanxue established in Northern Song the independent scholarly personhood of 'learning bearing the Way'; Hu, annotating history as a loyalist at the Song-Yuan transition, pushed that personhood to its extreme — 'the state may perish; history must not'. The Eastern-Zhejiang school (and Zhang Xuecheng's 'the six classics are all history') inherits the Guanxue tradition of statecraft through learning; Hu's 'history preserved in annotation' is that tradition's methodological variant under dynastic collapse.

cross_references.description_zh: 金圣叹与黄宗羲同为明清之际的江南遗民，同以'体制外的著述'承载亡国之痛而体裁互补：黄宗羲以史论与学案存文献、续学统（明儒学案），金圣叹以评点存文章、立小说本体（才子书）；一个把政治判断写进史学体裁，一个把政治判断写进'惊恶梦'的叙事切口——同一'不仕之节'的两种表达，一严一狂，殊途而同归于'国亡而学不亡'。
cross_references.description_en: Jin Shengtan and Huang Zongxi, both Jiangnan loyalists at the Ming-Qing transition, carried the pain of a fallen dynasty through extrainstitutional writing in complementary genres: Huang preserved documents and continued the scholarly lineage through historical essays and case-books (the Mingru Xue'an); Jin preserved writing and grounded fiction's autonomy through commentary (the books of genius); one wrote political judgment into the historiographical genre, the other into a narrative cut of 'a dreadful dream' — one refusal of office, two expressions, one stern one wild, converging on 'the state perished; the learning did not'.

cross_references.description_zh: 金圣叹与王充相隔十五个世纪而同守'文本自主判断'的批评家立场：王充《论衡》'疾虚妄'以经验证据拒斥权威经义，金圣叹以'因文生事'拒斥'载道'文学观——两人都拒绝向官方标准申请合法性，都用自己的评价体系重排典籍地位（《论衡》自列八十五篇，金圣叹自立'才子书'名单）；王充为理性批判立法，金圣叹为审美批判立法。
cross_references.description_en: Fifteen centuries apart, Jin Shengtan and Wang Chong held the same critic's stance of autonomous textual judgment: Wang's Lunheng 'attacking the false' with evidential rigor against orthodox classics, Jin's 'generating events from writing' against the instrumental 'carrying-the-Way' view of literature — both refusing to petition official standards for legitimacy, both reseating the canon by their own systems (Wang listing his own eighty-five pian; Jin erecting the 'books of genius'); Wang legislated for rational criticism, Jin for aesthetic criticism.

cross_references.description_zh: 金圣叹与司马迁代表叙事写作的两种生成逻辑：司马迁'以文运事'——事实先在而文字追摹，实录是最高律令；金圣叹'因文生事'——文字先行而事件随生，虚构自有其合法性。金圣叹以这条界线把小说从史传中解放出来，却同时承认《史记》为'才子书'之一——分界而不同贬，划清叙事学疆界的同时向叙事大师致意。
cross_references.description_en: Jin Shengtan and Sima Qian embody two generative logics of narrative: Sima 'drives events by writing' — facts precede, words pursue them, fidelity the supreme law; Jin 'generates events from writing' — words first, events arising with them, fiction legitimate in itself. Jin drew this line to liberate the novel from historiography, yet ranked the Shiji among the books of genius — a boundary without disparagement, mapping narratology while saluting its master.

cross_references.description_zh: 金圣叹与董仲舒代表文学家与制度关系的两极：董仲舒以'天人三策'进入权力核心、以经学塑造帝国意识形态——著作的价值由制度承认加冕；金圣叹明亡不仕、以民间评点自立法度——著作的价值由市场流通加冕。前者示范'建制内经典化'的峰值，后者示范'体制外经典化'的可行性：中国书籍史因此有了'钦定'与'自选'两条并行的经典化通道。
cross_references.description_en: Jin Shengtan and Dong Zhongshu mark two poles of the writer's relation to institutions: Dong entered the seat of power with the 'three responses on Heaven and Man', shaping imperial ideology through the classics — a work's value crowned by institutional recognition; Jin, refusing office after the Ming fell, legislated for himself through private commentary — a work's value crowned by circulation in the market. The first shows the peak of canonization within the establishment, the second the viability of canonization outside it: Chinese book history thus holds two parallel channels, 'imperially sanctioned' and 'self-selected'.

cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯温与张载共享'为天下立法'的经世抱负而路径不同：张载以《横渠四句》立'为天地立心'的哲学纲领、以井田理想试于乡治——学者在民间立法；刘伯温以时务十八策进入权力核心、以《大明律》成文化天下——谋士在庙堂立法。两人同出'关洛—浙东'的经世谱系，一个示范了理念立法的高度，一个示范了成文立法的工程。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bowen and Zhang Zai share the statecraft ambition of 'legislating for the world' by different routes: Zhang set the philosophical charter of 'fixing the heart for heaven and earth' and tested the well-field ideal in rural governance — a scholar legislating among the people; Liu entered the seat of power with the Eighteen Policies and codified the realm in the Great Ming Code — a strategist legislating at court. Both descend from the statecraft lineage of Guan-Luo and Zhedong; one shows the height of legislating in ideas, the other the engineering of legislating in statutes.

cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯温与黄宗羲同为浙东学人、同面对'学者与皇权如何相处'的命题而给出镜像答案：刘伯温入局佐命、立法垂典，终以功成身退保全于猜忌之世；黄宗羲拒仕新朝、以《明夷待访录》为君主制度立批判之典。一个在体制内立法，一个在体制外立法——《明夷待访录·原法》'有治法而后有治人'，正是对刘伯温参与制定的那部《大明律》未竟之业的隔代接续。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bowen and Huang Zongxi, both sons of Zhedong learning, faced the same question — how a scholar stands to imperial power — and gave mirror answers: Liu entered the founding, codified institutions, and preserved himself by timely withdrawal in an age of suspicion; Huang refused the new dynasty and codified a critique of monarchy in Waiting for the Dawn. One legislated within the system, one outside — and the Waiting for the Dawn's 'first there must be good laws, then there can be good men' is precisely a later-generation continuation of the unfinished work of the Great Ming Code Liu helped draft.

cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯温与董仲舒同为'帝师型'学者而术数立场相反：董仲舒以灾异谴告建构天人感应、把天象立为制约君权的实体——占候是政治神学；刘伯温一生精于象纬而断言'占之者心也，非卦也'——占候被还原为时机工程与人心判断。同样面对'天象与政治'的接口，一个把接口本体化，一个把接口工具化，两条路线共同构成中国术数政治学的两极。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bowen and Dong Zhongshu, both 'teacher to the emperor' scholars, took opposite stands on the mantic arts: Dong built the heaven-human resonance on disaster admonitions, making the sky a substantive check on the ruler — divination as political theology; Liu, a lifetime master of the asterisms, concluded 'what divines is the mind, not the hexagram' — divination reduced to timing engineering and human judgment. Facing the same interface of sky and politics, one ontologized it, the other instrumentalized it; together they mark the two poles of Chinese astro-politics.

cross_references.description_zh: 刘伯温与金圣叹同为浙江文人、同以'体制外文体'存思想而命运两极：刘伯温以寓言（《郁离子》）藏批判于虚构、以仕进与身退完成思想的完整生命周期；金圣叹以评点立'才子书'、以狂士之身死于哭庙。两人都证明'文体即生存策略'——寓言让刘伯温穿越元末言祸，评点让金圣叹穿越明清易代的文字狱前夜；一个用文体换来了进退自如，一个用文体守住了最后的心声。
cross_references.description_en: Liu Bowen and Jin Shengtan, both literati of Zhejiang, stored thought in 'extra-systemic genres' with opposite fates: Liu hid critique in allegory (the Yulizi) and completed his thought's full life-cycle through service and withdrawal; Jin founded the 'talented-writer books' in commentary and died the wild scholar at the Weeping Temple. Both prove 'genre is survival strategy' — allegory carried Liu through the speech-perils of late Yuan, commentary carried Jin to the eve of the Qing's literary inquisitions; one traded genre for freedom of advance and retreat, the other kept genre as his last utterance.

cross_references.description_zh: 义净与郑和同为明代以前中国南海航海记录的开创者而取向相反：郑和以国家舰队七下西洋，牵星过洋、针路簿记，留下官方航海档案；义净以一人商船西行求法，逐程记录季风、国度与航程时日，留下民间求法的航行实录。一个是'国家的海洋'，一个是'信仰的海洋'——两者共同构成唐明两代南海知识体系的两极，也共同把航线从经验变成可复用的公共数据。
cross_references.description_en: Yijing and Zheng He, both founders of Chinese maritime records of the Southern Ocean before the modern age, took opposite bearings: Zheng He sailed with state fleets on seven voyages, star-guided, compass-route books in hand, leaving the official nautical archive; Yijing sailed west as one pilgrim on merchant ships, logging leg by leg the monsoons, kingdoms and passage days, leaving the private record of religious travel. One is the ocean of the state, the other the ocean of faith — together they mark the two poles of the Tang-and-Ming knowledge system of the southern seas, and together turned routes from experience into reusable public data.

cross_references.description_zh: 义净与朱舜水同为'文化跨海移植'的巨匠而方向相对：朱舜水明亡后蹈海东渡，把礼制、营造、实学带到日本水户，在异邦保存文明；义净唐初蹈海南渡，把律法、声明、行持从印度带回本土，在故土移植文明。一个'送出去'，一个'带回来'——两人共同证明：文明的存续不系于一地一国的存亡，而系于是否有人愿意渡海并设计好渡海的每一个环节。
cross_references.description_en: Yijing and Zhu Shunshui, both master engineers of 'transplanting culture across the sea', sailed in opposite directions: after the Ming fell, Zhu crossed the sea east to Japan, bringing ritual, architecture and practical learning to Mito, preserving a civilization abroad; at the Tang's height Yijing crossed the sea south and returned, bringing Vinaya, grammar and practice from India home, transplanting a civilization in his native land. One 'sent out', one 'brought back' — together they prove that civilization's survival rests not on any one land or dynasty but on whether someone will cross the sea and design every link of the crossing.

cross_references.description_zh: 义净与香农同以'信息跨系统传递'为核心关切而立场两极：香农把信息抽象为与意义无关的比特，追求传输效率的最大化；义净坚持意义与载体不可分割，名相咒语必须存原音原形、亲验必须抵达现场——翻译即是有损压缩，宁牺牲流畅不牺牲真义。一个把'传'优化到极致，一个把'真'守护到极致，共同构成信息传递问题中效率与保真的两端。
cross_references.description_en: Yijing and Claude Shannon, both centered on 'transmitting information across systems', stand at opposite poles: Shannon abstracted information into bits indifferent to meaning, maximizing transmission efficiency; Yijing insisted meaning and carrier are inseparable — technical terms and mantras must keep their original sound and form, verification must reach the site — translation is lossy compression, and fluency may be sacrificed but truth may not. One optimized transmission to the limit, the other guarded fidelity to the limit: the two ends of efficiency and faithfulness in the problem of communicating across systems.

cross_references.description_zh: 义净与司马迁同以'为人物立传'保存集体记忆而对象互补：司马迁为帝王将相之外的刺客、游侠、货殖者立传，把边缘人物写进正史；义净为五十余位无名求法僧立传，把同行者而非自己写进西行史。一个'究天人之际'的历史全景，一个'不书其名谁识斯俊'的求法名录——两人共同把'无名者的贡献'变成历史书写的正当对象。
cross_references.description_en: Yijing and Sima Qian, both preserving collective memory through biography, complemented each other's subjects: Sima Qian wrote lives of assassins, wandering knights and merchants — the marginal, into official history; Yijing wrote lives of more than fifty unnamed pilgrim monks, his fellow travelers rather than himself into the history of the westward quest. One the panoramic history 'exploring heaven and human affairs', the other the roster 'if their names are not written, who will know these worthies' — together they made the unnamed's contribution a legitimate object of historical writing.

cross_references.description_zh: 丘处机与司马迁同以'行走的记录'对抗遗忘而对象相反：司马迁行走天下是为了把过去写进历史，丘处机西行万里时让弟子逐日记录是为了把当下留给未来。《长春真人西游记》与《史记》同属'行走的档案'传统——历史不只来自书斋的整理，更来自脚步与笔的同步。
cross_references.description_en: Qiu Chuji and Sima Qian both fought forgetting with 'the walking record', toward opposite objects: Sima Qian walked the realm to write the past into history, while Qiu, marching west, had his disciple log each day to hand the present to the future. The Journey to the West of the Perfected Changchun and the Records of the Grand Historian belong to one tradition of 'the walking archive' — history comes not only from the study's sorting but from footsteps and brush in step.

cross_references.description_zh: 丘处机与莲花生同以'教团与权力的接口设计'传法存教：莲花生入吐蕃以密法收编苯教神祇，把阻力转化为护法；丘处机赴大雪山以'敬天爱民'接口收编草原权力，把征服者转化为教团的保护人。两人都证明了：传教者最大的道场不在山林，而在与权力对话的那张桌子上。
cross_references.description_en: Qiu Chuji and Padmasambhava both designed the interface between school and power to plant their teachings: Padmasambhava entered Tibet subsuming Bon deities under the dharma, turning resistance into guardianship; Qiu went to the Hindu Kush and interfaced with steppe power through 'revere heaven, love the people', turning the conqueror into the school's patron. Both proved the preacher's greatest sanctuary is not the mountain grove but the table where power is spoken with.

cross_references.description_zh: 丘处机与马可·奥勒留同为'权力的对话者'而方向两极：奥勒留在权力内部以《沉思录》自我审计，约束的是自己；丘处在权力外部以万里之行进言止杀，约束的是他人。一个证明内省可以撑起德政的底线，一个证明外人的一句话也可能改写征服的路线。
cross_references.description_en: Qiu Chuji and Marcus Aurelius, both interlocutors of power, faced opposite directions: Aurelius, inside power, audited himself in the Meditations, binding himself; Qiu, outside power, walked ten thousand li to counsel the khan to spare the slaughter, binding others. One proved introspection can hold the floor of virtue in government; the other, that an outsider's single word may yet bend the route of conquest.

cross_references.description_zh: 丘处机与香农同关'如何以最小的信息达成最大的效果'而载体相反：香农把信息压缩到极致以通过信道，丘处机把一生的进言压缩成'止杀'一言以通过权力的耳朵——前者追求比特的最小冗余，后者追求言语的最小剂量最大杠杆，共同揭示'少即是多'的信息论本质。
cross_references.description_en: Qiu Chuji and Claude Shannon, both concerned with achieving the greatest effect from the least information, chose opposite carriers: Shannon compressed messages to pass the channel; Qiu compressed a lifetime of counsel into the single word 'spare the killing' to pass the ear of power — one pursued minimal redundancy of bits, the other minimal dosage with maximal leverage of speech; together they reveal the information-theoretic essence that less is more.

cross_references.description_zh: 王重阳与丘处机是师与徒的两代传教工程：王重阳以'活死人墓'与山东五会完成从零到一的布网，丘处机以万里西行与一言止杀完成从一到天下的放大。重阳设计了'分而不裂'的七真格局，丘处机正是其中被这套设计放大到极致的节点——师创制度，徒用制度。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chongyang and Qiu Chuji are two generations of one evangelizing project: the founder, with the living-dead tomb and the five Shandong congregations, wove the network from zero to one; the disciple, with the ten-thousand-li journey and one word that stayed the slaughter, scaled it from one to all under heaven. Chongyang designed the seven-lineage order that branches without breaking; Qiu was the very node that design amplified to the utmost — the teacher made the institution, the disciple worked it.

cross_references.description_zh: 王重阳与莲花生同以'收编而非消灭'植入新教团：莲花生入吐蕃把苯教神祇收编为护法，王重阳在山东把儒佛经典与信众收编进'三教合一'的框架。两人都懂得：新事物的生路不在旧事物的废墟上，而在把旧事物改造成自己的接口。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chongyang and Padmasambhava both planted a new school by absorbing rather than destroying: Padmasambhava entering Tibet subsumed Bon deities as dharma-protectors; Wang in Shandong folded Confucian and Buddhist classics and faithful into the frame of the Three Teachings as one. Both knew the new thing lives not on the ruins of the old but by rebuilding the old as its own interface.

cross_references.description_zh: 王重阳与孔子同为'带七十二/七位弟子而教'的创始人：孔子以因材施教分出德行、言语、政事、文学四科，王重阳刻意培养七位性情各异的弟子使身后分派即扩容。两人都把弟子群体本身设计成事业的分布式版本。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chongyang and Confucius both founded by teaching a small band — seven and seventy: Confucius split his teaching among four studies by each pupil's cast; Wang deliberately shaped seven disciples of differing temperament so that posthumous branching was expansion by design. Both made the disciple body itself the distributed version of the work.

cross_references.description_zh: 王重阳与张载同为宋金之际重构精神传统的关中人：张载以气本论重建儒门宇宙论、身后由门人整理《正蒙》而传关学，王重阳生前即主动立教、立会、立嗣、立文本。一个把立言留给身后，一个把自己的名字压在事业的每一块砖上——同代关陇人对'传承'的两种答案。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chongyang and Zhang Zai, men of the same Guanzhong generation, both rebuilt a spiritual tradition at the Jin-Song transition: Zhang Zai reconstructed the Confucian cosmos on qi, his Correcting Ignorance compiled by disciples after death to found the Guanxue school; Wang in his lifetime actively founded the school, the congregations, the succession, the texts. One left the writing to posterity; the other pressed his own name into every brick of the work — two answers to legacy from the same Guanzhong generation.

cross_references.description_zh: 耶律楚材与丘处机同在蒙古宫廷以'止杀'为业，路径互补成一对：丘处机以宗教领袖身份一次性进言（一言止杀），耶律楚材以文臣身份长期执行（把止杀做成课税与守令制度）；一个证明'一句话'能打开窗口，一个证明'一套制度'能把窗口变成门。
cross_references.description_en: Yelü Chucai and Qiu Chuji both made 'spare the slaughter' their trade in the Mongol court, on complementary paths: Qiu, as a religious patriarch, spoke once — the one word that stayed the killing; Chucai, as a civil minister, executed for years, making sparing an institution of tax offices and magistrates. One proved a single sentence can open the window; the other, that institutions can turn the window into a door.

cross_references.description_zh: 耶律楚材与董仲舒同为'以一套学说为政权设计制度'的人，而接口相反：董仲舒向汉武帝提供天命-大一统的理论包装，使儒学成为帝国的官方语法；楚材向大汗提供岁入账目与历算服务，使儒法成为帝国的行政语法。两者共同证明：进入权力靠的从来不是学说本身，而是学说被需要的方式。
cross_references.description_en: Yelü Chucai and Dong Zhongshu both designed institutions for a regime through a body of doctrine, with opposite interfaces: Dongzhongshu offered Emperor Wu the theology of mandate and grand unity, making Confucianism the empire's official grammar; Chucai offered the khan revenue accounts and calendrical service, making Confucian law the empire's administrative grammar. Both prove entry to power comes never from doctrine itself but from the way doctrine is needed.

cross_references.description_zh: 耶律楚材与迈蒙尼德同为'异族/动荡政权中的文明托命人'：迈蒙尼德在萨拉丁的埃及以医学侍苏丹而写成《迷途指津》，以希腊理性为犹太教辩护；楚材在蒙古宫廷以术数侍大汗而立课税选士之制，以汉法为中原文明续命。两人都证明：在征服者的屋檐下，专业知识是文明唯一的通行证。
cross_references.description_en: Yelü Chucai and Maimonides were both bearers of a civilization under an alien, turbulent power: Maimonides, physician to Saladin's sultan, wrote the Guide for the Perplexed, defending Judaism with Greek reason; Chucai, diviner to the Great Khan, built tax statutes and examinations, extending the life of Chinese civilization under the Mongols. Both proved that under the conqueror's roof, expert knowledge is the only passport a civilization holds.

cross_references.description_zh: 耶律楚材与马可·奥勒留同为'以哲学养成的权力内部人'而对象相反：奥勒留以斯多葛哲学约束自己行使的权力，写下沉思以自我审计；楚材以佛禅定力与儒家经世约束他人行使的权力，写下文簿法条以制度审计。一个向内修己，一个向外立法——共同揭示权力驯化的两条路：己与制。
cross_references.description_en: Yelü Chucai and Marcus Aurelius were both philosophers inside power, facing opposite objects: Aurelius used Stoic discipline to bind the power he himself wielded, writing meditations as self-audit; Chucai used Chan stillness and Confucian statecraft to bind the power others wielded, writing ledgers and statutes as institutional audit. One cultivated inward, the other legislated outward — the two roads of taming power: the self and the system.

cross_references.description_zh: 雍正与黄宗羲同处一个时代而结论相反：黄宗羲从'积累莫返之害'诊断出税制积弊，主张以制度制衡君主（学校议政、有治法而后有治人）；雍正则正是那个以君主之力把税制做对、把法度做实的人。一个是站在体制外的制度批判者，一个是体制内的制度执行者——两人共同证明：同一套制度问题，批判与建设用的是同一门学问。
cross_references.description_en: Yongzheng and Huang Zongxi shared an age with opposite conclusions: Huang diagnosed the compounding harms of taxation and called for institutions to balance the ruler — schools deliberating, law before men; Yongzheng was the very ruler who got the tax base right and made the law bite from within the system. One an institutional critic outside the machine, one an institutional executor inside it: together they prove criticism and construction of the same problems draw on the same science.

cross_references.description_zh: 雍正与耶律楚材同为'以制度驯服征服式权力'的财政设计者：楚材以课税所替代劫掠，把蒙古帝国拉向文治；雍正以火耗归公替代灰色加派，把宽弛帝国重建成高效科层。两人都证明：财政制度的重排是一切治理改造的第一杠杆。
cross_references.description_en: Yongzheng and Yelü Chucai were both fiscal designers taming predatory power with institutions: Chucai's tax commissions replaced plunder and pulled the Mongol empire toward civil rule; Yongzheng's meltage reform replaced gray exactions and rebuilt a lax empire into an efficient bureaucracy. Both prove the rearrangement of fiscal institutions is the first lever of all governance reform.

cross_references.description_zh: 雍正与董仲舒都为'君主与官僚体系'设计操作系统而接口相反：董仲舒向君主供给合法性神学（天命、大一统），改造君主与天下的关系；雍正向官僚体系供给信息系统与激励结构（密折、养廉、考成），改造君主与官僚的关系。一个设计统治的叙事，一个设计统治的机器。
cross_references.description_en: Yongzheng and Dong Zhongshu both designed the operating system of ruler and bureaucracy, with opposite interfaces: Dong supplied the ruler legitimacy-theology — mandate, grand unity — remaking the ruler's relation to the world; Yongzheng supplied the bureaucracy information systems and incentive structures — memorials, allowances, audits — remaking the ruler's relation to his officials. One designed the narrative of rule, the other its machinery.

cross_references.description_zh: 雍正与马可·奥勒留是'绝对权力内部人'的两极：奥勒留以斯多葛自省约束自己，写《沉思录》向内审计；雍正以密折、审计与法度约束整个官僚系统，向制度外部审计。一个信任自我纪律，一个只信系统设计——共同提出那个永恒问题：权力究竟应当被修己驯服，还是被结构驯服？
cross_references.description_en: Yongzheng and Marcus Aurelius are the poles of the man inside absolute power: Aurelius bound himself with Stoic self-examination, the Meditations an inward audit; Yongzheng bound the whole officialdom with memorials, audits and statute, an outward, structural audit. One trusted self-discipline, the other only system design — together posing the eternal question: is power to be tamed by self-cultivation or by structure?

cross_references.description_zh: 孝庄与雍正同为清初权力机器的锻造者而路径相反：雍正以制度权力正面重塑帝国（密折、军机处、追比亏空），孝庄以非制度影响力在幕后护住帝国（不垂帘、织网、教养幼主）——一个把权力制度化，一个把影响力去制度化；祖孙二人共同证明：同一台机器，可以正面操作，也可以影子操作。
cross_references.description_en: Xiaozhuang and Yongzheng both forged the Qing machine of power by opposite routes: Yongzheng reshaped the empire frontally through institutions — secret memorials, the Grand Council, the chasing of deficits — while Xiaozhuang shielded it from behind through un-institutionalized influence — no curtain, a woven net, the rearing of child emperors. One institutionalized power, the other de-institutionalized influence; grandmother and grandson together prove one machine may be run in the open or run in shadow.

cross_references.description_zh: 孝庄与耶律楚材同为'征服王朝转向文治'的关键推手：楚材以课税所与文簿把蒙古帝国拉离劫掠经济，孝庄以满汉平衡与儒家教育把清政权拉向治理——两人都明白：马上得来的天下，必须在马下重新编程。
cross_references.description_en: Xiaozhuang and Yelü Chucai were both pivot hands turning conquest dynasties toward civil rule: Chucai's tax commissions and ledgers pulled the Mongol empire off plunder, Xiaozhuang's Manchu-Han balance and Confucian schooling pulled the Qing toward governance — both knew an empire won on horseback must be reprogrammed off it.

cross_references.description_zh: 孝庄与王重阳同在乱世中保全与延续，对象相反：王重阳以宗教组织（活死人墓、三教会、全真网络）在权力之外存续文明火种；孝庄在权力核心以隐形运作（不垂帘、折中继统）存续政权火种——一个在庙堂之外修道统，一个在庙堂之内护治统。
cross_references.description_en: Xiaozhuang and Wang Chongyang both preserved and continued amid chaos, with opposite objects: Wang, outside power, kept the embers of civilization alive through religious organization — the tomb of the living dead, the Three Teachings assembly, the Quanzhen web; Xiaozhuang, at the core of power, kept the polity alive by invisible operation — no curtain, brokering successions. One tended a lineage of the Way beyond the court, the other guarded the lineage of governance within it.

cross_references.description_zh: 孝庄与马可·奥勒留都身处最高权力的旋涡而不被其吞噬，方式相反：奥勒留以斯多葛自省向内约束自己，写《沉思录》做'向内的审计'；孝庄以人际网络与名分系统向外编织约束，让权力在无形中相互抵消——一个信任内在纪律，一个信任关系结构。
cross_references.description_en: Xiaozhuang and Marcus Aurelius both stood in the whirl of supreme power unswallowed, by opposite means: Aurelius bound himself inward with Stoic self-examination, the Meditations an audit turned inward; Xiaozhuang wove constraint outward through networks and the order of titles, letting powers cancel one another unseen — one trusted inner discipline, the other the structure of relations.

cross_references.description_zh: 林则徐与雍正同以'把问题工程化'见长而对象相反：雍正把帝国内部的治理问题全部转成系统设计（密折、军机处、摊丁），对帝国外部一无所知也无须知道；林则徐把帝国外部的威胁转成知识工程（译馆、具结、船炮），却终究受制于他无力改造的内部系统——一个改造了机器而放任了边界，一个看清了边界而动不了机器；两人相加，恰好画出晚清'制度已熟而世界已变'的全部困境。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Zexu and Yongzheng both excelled at turning problems into engineering, upon opposite objects: Yongzheng converted the empire's internal governance into system design — secret memorials, the Grand Council, the tax-on-land — knowing and needing nothing of the world outside; Lin converted the external threat into an engineering of knowledge — the bureau, the bond, the ships and guns — yet remained bound by the internal system he could not remake. One rebuilt the machine and left the boundary blind; the other saw the boundary and could not move the machine: together they trace the whole predicament of a late Qing whose institutions were mature while the world had changed.

cross_references.description_zh: 林则徐与迈蒙尼德同是'在母体文明受迫时以外邦语言保存并转化知识'的人：迈蒙尼德以阿拉伯语写犹太法典、以医学进宫廷，让流散的传统接通最先进的知识体系；林则徐设译馆译西报西书，让封闭的帝国接通对手的法理与地理——两人都证明：文明的存续不取决于拒绝外来语言，而取决于有没有人愿意当那座桥。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Zexu and Maimonides both preserved and transformed knowledge in an alien tongue while their mother civilization was under pressure: Maimonides wrote the Jewish law in Arabic and served the court as physician, wiring a scattered tradition to the most advanced learning of his day; Lin founded a bureau to render Western papers and books, wiring a closed empire to the jurisprudence and geography of its adversary — both prove that a civilization's survival turns not on refusing the foreign language but on there being someone willing to be the bridge.

cross_references.description_zh: 林则徐与赫茨尔同面对'民族的生存空间被外部力量重排'而方向相反：赫茨尔在维也纳的沙龙里用一支笔为无地的民族发明一个国家，把危机写成纲领与谈判；林则徐在帝国的体系里以一省之力实测、购炮、垦边，把危机做成工程与清册——一个在体制外发明新容器，一个在体制内做到极限；前者说明危机可以催生新的政治想象，后者说明危机中个体的程序化坚韧同样是历史的资粮。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Zexu and Herzl both faced a people's living space rearranged by outside force, in opposite directions: Herzl, in the salons of Vienna, invented a state for a landless nation with a pen, writing the crisis into program and negotiation; Lin, within the imperial order, measured, bought cannon and opened the frontier with one province's strength, making the crisis into engineering and ledgers — one invented a new vessel outside the system, the other pushed the old system to its limit. The one shows crisis can breed new political imagination; the other, that procedural tenacity of the individual within crisis is itself provision for history.

cross_references.description_zh: 林则徐与马可·奥勒留同把'自我治理'当作公共责任的底层设施：奥勒留以斯多葛的'二分法'把可控之事（自己的判断）与不可控之事（帝国的命运）分开，在权力中心保持内心秩序；林则徐以'苟利国家生死以'把祸福从决策中删除，在荣辱两端保持同一工作姿态——一个向内立宪，一个向外担当，都以不被外部评价支配的心智完成对时代的责任。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Zexu and Marcus Aurelius both made the governance of the self the substructure of public duty: Aurelius, by the Stoic dichotomy, parted what lies in his power (his own judgment) from what does not (the fate of the empire), keeping inner order at the center of power; Lin, by 'if it profits the nation, I would give my life,' deleted fortune from decision, keeping one working posture across honor and disgrace. One legislates inward, the other takes the burden outward; both discharged their duty to the age with a mind not ruled by external verdict.

cross_references.description_zh: 左宗棠与林则徐是'经世致用'谱系最直接的传灯：1850 年湘江夜话，林则徐把西域图志与见闻托付给布衣左宗棠，预言'西定新疆，舍君莫属'——三十年后左宗棠正是带着这份知识地图收复新疆；两人共享'以知识先行于武力、以实学替代空谈'的方法论，林则徐开译馆看世界，左宗棠办船政造世界。
cross_references.description_en: Zuo Zongtang and Lin Zexu are the most direct transmission of the statecraft-and-practice lineage: in the night talk on the Xiang in 1850, Lin entrusted his western maps and knowledge to the commoner Zuo, foretelling 'for the pacification of the west there is none but you' — thirty years later Zuo retook Xinjiang carrying that knowledge map. Both share the method of knowledge before arms and real learning before empty talk: Lin opened the translation bureau to see the world, Zuo founded the dockyard to build it.

cross_references.description_zh: 左宗棠与雍正同为'把问题工程化'的极致，而权力位置相反：雍正坐在系统顶端改造系统（密折、军机处、财政），左宗棠站在系统边缘却把边远省份与边疆做成自己的系统（幕府财政、屯田、建省）；雍正的工程靠皇权强制，左宗棠的工程靠算账说服——一个证明顶端的权力可以重塑结构，一个证明边缘的精确计算也可以。
cross_references.description_en: Zuo Zongtang and Yongzheng are both extremes of turning problems into engineering, from opposite positions of power: Yongzheng, at the system's summit, rebuilt the system (secret memorials, the Grand Council, the treasury); Zuo, at its edge, made the far provinces and the frontier into systems of his own (tent finance, colonies, provincehood). Yongzheng's engineering leaned on imperial compulsion, Zuo's on accounts that persuade — one proves the summit's power can reshape structure, the other that precise computation at the margin can too.

cross_references.description_zh: 左宗棠与耶律楚材同是'让被战争摧毁的地区重新能自我供养'的重建者：耶律楚材以定额税制与编户把蒙古征服变成可治理的财政，左宗棠以屯田建省把收复的疆土变成自负盈亏的行省——两人都明白：打下来只是开始，能养活自己才算拥有。
cross_references.description_en: Zuo Zongtang and Yelv Chucai are both rebuilders who made war-ravaged lands sustain themselves: Yelv, by fixed quotas and registered households, turned the Mongol conquest into governable finance; Zuo, by colonies and provincehood, turned recovered territory into a province that balanced its own books — both understood that taking a land is only the beginning; owning it means feeding it.

cross_references.description_zh: 左宗棠与马可·奥勒留同为'责任先于自我的践行者'：奥勒留在帝位的重负下以斯多葛自律保持内心秩序，左宗棠在布衣与侯相的巨大落差间以'心忧天下'保持同一姿态——一个向内治理自我，一个向外治理疆土，但都把'该做的事'置于'我的得失'之上；两人临终都不在享乐中而在职责中。
cross_references.description_en: Zuo Zongtang and Marcus Aurelius are both practitioners of duty before self: Aurelius, under the weight of empire, kept inner order by Stoic discipline; Zuo, across the vast gap between commoner and chancellor, kept one posture of 'worry for all under heaven' — one governing the self inward, one governing territory outward, both placing what ought to be done above their own gain; both died in their duty, not in their pleasures.

cross_references: M-GSJ-001（历本测验法——全部十模式的认识论基座：'历之本在于测验'是郭守敬方法的总纲）
M-GSJ-002（简仪去环法——仪器战线的减法革命：仪式部件是精度的敌人）
M-GSJ-003（高表景符法——误差源消除的完整案例：消灭于产生处，优于修正于读数处）
M-GSJ-005（废元截历法——前提审计的删除试验：幽灵前提不辩而废）
M-GSJ-010（以海为基准法——基准革命：通约先于裁决，方法的最后一块基石）
M-ZHH-001（张衡：验之以事法——承前：同一'观测优先'立场在汉代的原点，郭守敬将其工程化）
M-NEW-001（牛顿：公理化综合法——对照：郭守敬以仪器与数据总装历法，牛顿以公理体系总装力学）
M-HZX-002（黄宗羲：史料批判法——平行：同为'以可靠源头裁决不可直接验证之学'的进路）

cross_references.description_zh: 赫歇尔与牛顿同为英国科学革命的高峰，而路径相反：牛顿以数学从先验结构推出宇宙（写《原理》时几乎不做实验观测），赫歇尔以仪器从观测累积宇宙（一生几乎不写数学论文）；一个证明'计算可以抵达星辰'，一个证明'更大的镜子可以看见计算没有预见的东西'——两人合起来正是'理论-观测'双轮的两极，赫歇尔的双星引力确认正是牛顿定律在恒星尺度的第一次直接胜利。
cross_references.description_en: Herschel and Newton are twin summits of the English scientific revolution by opposite routes: Newton derived the universe from prior structure by mathematics (writing the Principia hardly observing), Herschel accumulated the universe from observation by instruments (a lifetime almost without mathematical papers) — one proved calculation could reach the stars, the other that a larger mirror could see what calculation had not foreseen; together they are the two poles of the theory-observation double wheel, and Herschel's confirmation of binary gravitation was Newton's laws' first direct victory at stellar scale.

cross_references.description_zh: 赫歇尔与达尔文同是'长期耐心观测压倒短期聪明'的典范：达尔文以二十年积累才发表物种起源，赫歇尔以五十年日志与二十年追踪才确认双星绕转——两人都相信慢现象需要慢数据，都把'记录完备'置于'抢先发表'之上；也都得到家庭网络的关键支撑（赫歇尔的卡罗琳、达尔文的胡克与赖尔）。
cross_references.description_en: Herschel and Darwin are alike exemplars of long patient observation over short cleverness: Darwin twenty years of accumulation before the Origin, Herschel fifty years of logs and twenty of tracking before confirming binary orbits — both held that slow phenomena need slow data, both set complete records above being first to print, and both leaned on a family network of support (Herschel's Caroline; Darwin's Hooker and Lyell).

cross_references.description_zh: 赫歇尔与爱因斯坦同为宇宙认知的分水岭而方法相异：爱因斯坦在书桌上以思想实验重构时空，几乎不需要新仪器；赫歇尔在花园里以更大的镜子扩展视野，几乎不做理论推演——一个证明'思辨可以走在观测之前'，一个证明'观测可以走在思辨之前'；宇宙学的实际进步依赖两者的交替：赫歇尔式的计数与爱因斯坦式的重构互为对方的问题来源。
cross_references.description_en: Herschel and Einstein are both watersheds of cosmic knowing by differing means: Einstein restructured space-time at his desk with thought experiments, hardly needing new instruments; Herschel widened the view in his garden with larger mirrors, hardly theorizing — one proved speculation can outpace observation, the other that observation can outpace speculation; cosmology's real advance has alternated between them, Herschel's counts and Einstein's reconstructions each supplying the other's questions.

cross_references.description_zh: 赫歇尔与麦克林托克同是'在漫长孤独的观测里相信自己的眼睛'的坚守者：她的转座子被冷落三十年终获诺奖，他的星云假说被冷落数十年终获证实——两人都以'数据完备到陌生人可续'为信条，都以家庭式小团队（她的玉米地、他的地下室）对抗学界的喧嚣，都把'看见别人视而不见的东西'当作毕生的职业。
cross_references.description_en: Herschel and McClintock are alike in trusting their own eyes through long solitary observation: her transposons ignored for thirty years before the Nobel, his nebular hypothesis neglected for decades before vindication — both held that data should be complete enough for a stranger to continue, both met the world's noise with a family-sized team (her cornfield, his cellar), and both made 'seeing what others look past' their life's profession.

cross_references.description_zh: 道尔顿与牛顿同为'让自然交出数字'的大师，而起点相反：牛顿从现象上行到普遍引力定律，再以定律统一天上地下；道尔顿从两千年前的哲学猜想下行到实验室的称量，以数字反推概念——两人都相信'自然之书用数学写成'，都为自己发明了所需的工具（流数法/原子量表），都不允许'说得通'替代'算得出'。
cross_references.description_en: Dalton and Newton are both masters of making nature surrender numbers, from opposite starts: Newton rose from phenomena to universal gravitation and unified heaven and earth by it; Dalton descended from a two-thousand-old philosophical conjecture to the laboratory balance, inferring concepts from numbers — both believed the book of nature written in mathematics, both invented the tools they needed (fluxions, the atomic-weight table), and both refused to let 'plausible' stand in for 'computable'.

cross_references.description_zh: 道尔顿与达尔文同是'慢数据养出大学说'的典范：道尔顿五十七年气象日志养出原子论，达尔文二十年积累养出物种起源——两人都在没有大问题的年代坚持记录，都把'长期台账'当作理论的期权，都在数据复利到临界点时一举提现；两人也都以谦虚的文风包装锋利的主张。
cross_references.description_en: Dalton and Darwin are alike exemplars of slow data raising great theory: fifty-seven years of weather logs raising atomism, twenty years of accumulation raising the Origin — both kept records through years when no great question offered, both held the long ledger as theory's option, both cashed in at the moment the data compounded past threshold; both wrapped sharp claims in modest prose.

cross_references.description_zh: 道尔顿与爱因斯坦代表定标科学的两极：爱因斯坦以思想实验重构已有概念的根基（同时性、引力），几乎不进实验室；道尔顿以称量与计数给尚无根基的概念（原子）造出第一版数值身份——一个证明'概念批判可以走在测量之前'，一个证明'测量可以走在概念澄清之前'；原子论的最终形态（阿伏伽德罗-坎尼扎罗标准）证明两条路线缺一不可。
cross_references.description_en: Dalton and Einstein are the two poles of calibration science: Einstein restructured the foundations of given concepts — simultaneity, gravitation — by thought experiment, hardly entering a laboratory; Dalton weighed and counted a rootless concept, the atom, into its first numerical identity — one proved conceptual critique can precede measurement, the other that measurement can precede conceptual clarification; the final form of atomism (the Avogadro-Cannizzaro standard) proved both routes indispensable.

cross_references.description_zh: 道尔顿与麦克林托克同是'在自己的异常感知上建立学派'的人：麦克林托克在玉米地里看见别人看不见的转座子、冷落三十年而不改；道尔顿在自家眼睛里发现别人看不见的色盲、把它做成一门研究——两人都信任'我看见的与教科书不同'这一事实，都以独自的长期观察对抗学界的定见，最终都被时间完全证实。
cross_references.description_en: Dalton and McClintock are alike in founding a science on their own anomalous perception: she saw in the maize field transposons no one else saw and held for thirty years unshaken; he found in his own eyes a color blindness no one else perceived and made it a study — both trusted the fact that what they saw differed from the textbook, both met the learned world's settled opinion with solitary long observation, and both were wholly vindicated by time.

cross_references.description_zh: 彭加勒与牛顿都是'以数学结构统一物理'的巨匠，而方法相反：牛顿从现象上行，以流数法与引力定律把天与地焊成一体；彭加勒从危机下行，以对称与不变量给原理定基——两人都相信自然之书的深层是数学结构，都不满足于'解释现象'而追求'结构必然'；三体问题上牛顿方程遇到不可解，恰由彭加勒的定性理论接手——接力棒从定量精确交给了定性精确。
cross_references.description_en: Poincare and Newton are both masters of unifying physics by mathematical structure, by opposite routes: Newton rose from phenomena, welding heaven and earth with fluxions and the law of gravitation; Poincare descended from crisis, founding principles on symmetry and invariants — both believed the deep layer of nature's book mathematical, neither content to 'explain phenomena' without 'structural necessity'; where Newton's equations met the unsolvable three-body problem, Poincare's qualitative theory took up the work — the baton passed from exact quantity to exact quality.

cross_references.description_zh: 1905 年狭义相对论由彭加勒与爱因斯坦两条独立路径同时逼近：彭加勒守护'相对性原理'并证明洛伦兹变换成群、给出四维形式；爱因斯坦以同时性的概念批判重建时空本体——一个把相对论当'原理+对称'来守护，一个把它当'时空的物理学'来重建；广义相对论的最终综合证明两条路径互为补充：原理的守护者与概念的重建者共同抵达了同一座建筑。
cross_references.description_en: Special relativity was approached in 1905 by two independent roads, Poincare's and Einstein's: Poincare guarding the principle of relativity, proving the Lorentz transformations a group, supplying the four-dimensional form; Einstein rebuilding spacetime's ontology by the critique of simultaneity — one keeping relativity as principle plus symmetry, the other as the physics of spacetime itself; general relativity's synthesis proved the roads complementary: the principle's guardian and the concepts' rebuilder arriving at one building together.

cross_references.description_zh: 彭加勒与达尔文对'偶然'的态度构成两极：达尔文把偶然当作机制的原料——变异无方向而选择有方向，偶然被接纳为演化的引擎；彭加勒把偶然解剖成三类并各配对策——偶然不是引擎而是待解读的信号；一个在偶然里建理论（进化），一个对偶然做手术（概率哲学），共同把十九世纪'偶然的耻辱'变成了二十世纪'偶然的科学'。
cross_references.description_en: Poincare and Darwin stand at the poles on 'chance': Darwin took chance as the raw material of mechanism — variation undirected, selection directed, chance welcomed as evolution's engine; Poincare dissected chance into three types with a remedy each — chance not engine but signal to be read; one built theory inside chance (evolution), the other operated on it (philosophy of probability), together turning the nineteenth century's 'disgrace of chance' into the twentieth century's 'science of chance.'

cross_references.description_zh: 彭加勒与麦克林托克都是'在无人看见处看见结构'的人：麦克林托克在玉米地里看出转座子、被冷落三十年而结构终究被证实；彭加勒在微分方程的荒原上看出轨道的'形状'、被精确主义冷落数十年而混沌理论终究证明他看到的地形是真的——两人都以定性直觉对抗当时的定量正统，都相信'结构先于数字'，都被时间完全兑现。
cross_references.description_en: Poincare and McClintock both saw structure where no one else looked: she saw transposons in the maize field, cold-shouldered thirty years, the structure at last confirmed; he saw the trajectories' 'shape' in the wilderness of differential equations, slighted by exactitude for decades, chaos theory at last proving his terrain real — both opposing qualitative intuition to the quantitative orthodoxy, both trusting structure before numbers, both wholly redeemed by time.

cross_references.description_zh: 黑格尔与费尔巴哈是'体系与方法'的师生辩证法：黑格尔把精神推上绝对之位、以辩证法展开全部现实；费尔巴哈保留了老师的辩证-历史方法，却把'绝对精神'倒转为人的思维本质的投射——'思辨哲学是神学的最后一根支柱'；继承方法而倒转结论，他成为黑格尔学派解体的第一爆破手，也是马克思'把辩证法倒过来'的前站。
cross_references.description_en: Hegel and Feuerbach form a teacher-student dialectic of system and method: Hegel enthroned spirit as absolute and unfolded all reality dialectically; Feuerbach kept the teacher's dialectical-historical method while inverting 'absolute spirit' into the projection of human thought — 'speculative philosophy is theology's last prop'; inheriting the method and inverting the conclusions, he was the first blaster in the Hegelian school's demolition and the way-station to Marx's standing Hegel on his feet.

cross_references.description_zh: 费尔巴哈与马克思是'批判接力'的上下游：马克思承认'我们一时都成为费尔巴哈派了'，承接其感性优先与宗教批判（'人民鸦片'直接生长于'苦难的止痛剂'分析）；又在《关于费尔巴哈的提纲》中指出其局限——感性被直观而非被实践——把'解释世界'推进到'改变世界'；费尔巴哈自己晚年加入社会民主党，默许了这场超越。
cross_references.description_en: Feuerbach and Marx are upstream and downstream of one critique: Marx confessed 'we all became at once Feuerbachians,' inheriting the primacy of sense and the critique of religion (the 'opium of the people' grows straight from the analysis of suffering's painkiller); yet in the Theses on Feuerbach he named the limit — the sensuous contemplated, not practiced — advancing from interpreting the world to changing it; Feuerbach in old age joined the Social Democrats, silently conceding the surpassing.

cross_references.description_zh: 费尔巴哈与克尔凯郭尔在同一面墙的两侧凿门：两人都认定黑格尔的体系遗落了'现实的人'——费尔巴哈向左凿，以感性、类本质与'我与你'把人还给大地；克尔凯郭尔向内凿，以单一信仰者的颤抖把人还给自身；一个以'神学是人本学'消解神学，一个以'信仰是激情'重建神学——倒转与跃迁，同一诊断的两种处方。
cross_references.description_en: Feuerbach and Kierkegaard cut doors on opposite sides of one wall: both found Hegel's system missing the real human — Feuerbach cut left, restoring man to earth through the sensuous, species-being and 'I and thou'; Kierkegaard cut inward, restoring the single believer in trembling; one dissolved theology as anthropology, one rebuilt faith as passion — inversion and leap, two prescriptions for one diagnosis.

cross_references.description_zh: 费尔巴哈与达尔文同是'把人从特殊创世位置上请下来'的平行者：达尔文以自然选择把人从造物的宝座移入物种的谱系，费尔巴哈以人本学把神从造物主的宝座移回人的内心——两人都遭到'贬低人类'的指控，也都回答：被归还的不是尊严而是幻觉；人的尊严在自然与人间，不在天上的特批。
cross_references.description_en: Feuerbach and Darwin are parallels in dethroning man's special creation: Darwin moved man from creature's throne into the genealogy of species by natural selection; Feuerbach moved God from the creator's throne back into the human heart by anthropology; both were accused of degrading mankind, both answered that what was returned was not dignity but illusion — human dignity dwelling in nature and among men, not in a heavenly dispensation.

cross_references.description_zh: 南泉与龙树是佛教内部'破执'传统的两端：龙树以四句破、缘起归空在义理层面拆解一切实执——概念的战场；南泉以斩猫、勘辩、'拟向即乖'在生活中拆解一切事执——日常的战场；一个把'空'写成体系，一个把'平常'过成日子，两人隔着七百年共同回答同一问题：执著如何被松动——龙树证明概念经不起分析，南泉证明习惯经不起现场检验。
cross_references.description_en: Nansen and Nagarjuna are the two poles of Buddhism's inner tradition of cutting attachment: Nagarjuna with the tetralemma and the emptiness of dependent origination dismantled all conceptual grasping — the battlefield of concepts; Nansen with the cat, the examinations and 'intend toward it and you stray' dismantled all practical grasping — the battlefield of the everyday; one wrote 'emptiness' as a system, one lived 'the ordinary' as days; across seven centuries they answer one question — how is grasping loosened: Nagarjuna proved concepts fail under analysis, Nansen proved habits fail under live testing.

cross_references.description_zh: 南泉与商羯罗是同世纪（八至九世纪初）佛教与吠檀多的两位'平常化大师'：商羯罗以'梵我同一'把终极实在拉回每个人的自我——最远的真理被安放在最近处；南泉以'平常心是道'把道拉回吃饭穿衣——最高的真理被安放在最低处；两人都面对'修行是否需要特殊状态'的问题而给出同构答案：不需要——差别只在商羯罗以不二论消解二元，南泉以勘验消解虚饰。
cross_references.description_en: Nansen and Shankara are the two masters of 'ordinariness' of the same age (early ninth century), of Buddhism and Vedanta: Shankara with 'Brahman is the self' drew ultimate reality back into each person's own self — the farthest truth housed nearest; Nansen with 'the ordinary mind is the Way' drew the Way back to eating and dressing — the highest truth housed lowest; both faced whether practice needs special states and answered in the same structure: it does not — the difference only that Shankara dissolved duality by non-dualism, Nansen dissolved pretense by examination.

cross_references.description_zh: 南泉与莲花生是同期佛教东西两翼的'极端教学者'：莲花生以降伏、伏藏与本尊相应在藏地立教——以威猛相调伏刚强；南泉以斩猫、勘辩与'打杀圣语'在中土传禅——以极端相截断妄执；两人都相信：温和的说教对某些执念无效，必须以对方无法回避的现场事件完成教学——一个是法术的戏剧，一个是公案的戏剧，同属'以事代言'的教学谱系。
cross_references.description_en: Nansen and Padmasambhava are the extreme teachers of Buddhism's two wings in the same era: Padmasambhava founded the teaching in Tibet by subjugation, hidden treasures and deity yoga — the wrathful form taming the stubborn; Nansen transmitted Chan in China by the cat, the examinations and 'killing the sacred phrase' — the extreme act severing delusion; both believed mild preaching fails against certain attachments, and the teaching must be completed by a live event the other cannot evade — one the drama of mantra, one the drama of koan, both in the lineage of teaching by deed rather than word.

cross_references.description_zh: 南泉与王阳明相隔千年而同唱'平常'：王阳明以'心即理''知行合一'把天理从经典拉回此心，'满街都是圣人'与南泉'平常心是道'共享把最高价值平民化的直觉；两人都坚持真理不在特殊的经典时刻而在日用伦常——阳明在事上磨练，南泉在勘辩中检验；不同的是阳明把平常导向道德行动，南泉把平常导向对一切'特殊'的拆穿。
cross_references.description_en: Nansen and Wang Yangming, a millennium apart, sing the same 'ordinary': Yangming's 'mind is principle' and 'unity of knowledge and action' pulled heavenly principle from the classics back into this mind, and 'the streets are full of sages' shares Nansen's intuition of 'the ordinary mind is the Way' — democratizing the highest value; both insist truth lies not in special scriptural moments but in daily life — Yangming polished it on affairs, Nansen tested it in examinations; the difference: Yangming led the ordinary toward moral action, Nansen toward the unmasking of every 'special.'

cross_references.description_zh: 阿蒙森与麦哲伦是两次'全球闭环'的完成者：麦哲伦以一人一生的赌注证明地球可以被航行一周，阿蒙森以四役接力填完地球最后的空白地图；两人都把'路线'当作头号战略资产——麦哲伦赌一条海峡的存在，阿蒙森赌一条对手走不了的冰川；都死于途中（麦哲伦死于菲律宾的介入冲突，阿蒙森死于巴伦支海的救援），都由船员而非本人完成最后一程：麦哲伦的船队由埃尔卡诺带回，阿蒙森的南极由他自己带回、北极点由 Norge 号带回——'目标比人活得久'是他们共同的签名。
cross_references.description_en: Amundsen and Magellan are the completers of the world's two great closures: Magellan staked a life to prove the earth could be sailed around, Amundsen filled the map's last blank spaces in a relay of four campaigns; both treated the route as the leading strategic asset — Magellan wagered on a strait's existence, Amundsen on a glacier the rival could not walk; both died en route (Magellan in Philippine entanglement, Amundsen in the Barents rescue), both outlasted by their crews — Magellan's fleet brought home by Elcano, Amundsen's pole flown home by the Norge: 'the objective outlives the man' is their shared signature.

cross_references.description_zh: 阿蒙森与库克同为把'远征'科学化的领航者：库克以海图、维生素与船员纪律把十八世纪的远征死亡率降到近乎现代水平，阿蒙森以冗余细节、爱斯基摩技术与小队自持把二十世纪的极地死亡率降到零；两人都拒绝'英雄主义消耗'——库克不許船员吃未知食物，阿蒙森不许队员思考零下五十度的动作；差别在库克的战场是船与海图，阿蒙森的战场是雪橇与装备清单——远征的科学化在两人手中各推进了一个世纪。
cross_references.description_en: Amundsen and Cook are twin navigators who made exploration scientific: Cook with charts, antiscorbutics and shipboard discipline drove eighteenth-century expedition mortality to near-modern levels; Amundsen with redundant detail, Inuit technique and the self-sufficient small team drove polar mortality to zero; both refused the consumption of heroics — Cook forbade unknown foods, Amundsen forbade thought at minus fifty; the difference only that Cook's battlefield was ship and chart, Amundsen's sledge and equipment list — each moved the science of exploration a century.

cross_references.description_zh: 阿蒙森与利德尔·哈特共享同一条军事-探险方法论的根：'间接路线'——哈特论证避开敌人最强正面、沿'抵抗力最小'的路线达成决定；阿蒙森选海伯格冰川而不是斯科特的 Beardmore，选狗橇而不是人力，选南半球春末的窗口而不是赌运气——每一步都是'以准备的优势代替力量的对抗'；两人都相信胜利在开战前已被后勤与路线决定——哈特把它写成军事教义，阿蒙森把它走成雪地车辙。
cross_references.description_en: Amundsen and Liddell Hart share the root of one military-exploratory method, the indirect approach: Hart argued for avoiding the enemy's strongest front and deciding along the line of least resistance; Amundsen chose the Axel Heiberg Glacier over Scott's Beardmore, dogs over man-hauling, the late-spring window over luck — every step trading preparation's advantage for force's confrontation; both believed victory is decided by logistics and route before the battle — Hart wrote it as doctrine, Amundsen drove it into the snow as wheel tracks.

cross_references.description_zh: 阿蒙森与孙武在'先胜后战'上隔代同声：孙子言'胜兵先胜而后求战，败兵先战而后求胜'，阿蒙森言'胜利等待一切准备就绪的人'——两句话是同一条定律在兵法与极地的平行表述；孙子的'多算胜，少算不胜'对应阿蒙森的死法清单与逐度补给站；'庙算'发生在开战前的庙堂，Framheim 的六个月制备发生在出发前的冰架——两人都把'不算而战'定义为最大的败因。
cross_references.description_en: Amundsen and Sun Wu speak across the ages with one voice on winning before fighting: Sun Tzu — 'the victorious army wins first and seeks battle after; the defeated fights first and seeks victory after'; Amundsen — 'victory awaits him who has everything in order'; two parallel statements of one law, in war and in the ice; Sun Tzu's 'many calculations win, few lose' answers Amundsen's death list and depots by the degree; the temple council before battle, the six months of Framheim before the march — both define fighting without calculation as the greatest cause of defeat.

tags: 胜利等待一切准备就绪

cross_references.description_zh: 德雷克与麦哲伦同为完成环球航行的人，也是同一条航线的'继承者与挑战者'：麦哲伦证明地球可以被航行一周，德雷克沿他的海峡进入他从未想过的用途——把环球航线变成打击西班牙帝国的战刀；两人都以远洋证明了'地图之外'的实测价值（麦哲伦实测太平洋的广度，德雷克实测火地岛以南的开阔海），都以'一人一船'把战略想象推进到帝国尺度；差别在麦哲伦为'第一次'而战、死于介入冲突，德雷克为'第二次'而战、把第一次的航线变成武器——环球航行从壮举变成方法论，是在德雷克手里完成的。
cross_references.description_en: Drake and Magellan are the two completers of the circumnavigation, on the same route as heir and challenger: Magellan proved the earth could be sailed around; Drake entered his strait to an unimagined use — turning the circumnavigation into a blade against the Spanish empire; both proved by ocean the value of testing beyond the map (Magellan the breadth of the Pacific, Drake the open sea south of Tierra del Fuego), both advancing strategic imagination to imperial scale with one man and one ship; the difference — Magellan fought for the 'first time' and died in an entanglement, Drake fought for the 'second' and made the first's route a weapon: the circumnavigation passed from feat to methodology in Drake's hands.

cross_references.description_zh: 德雷克与库克同为把远洋航行科学化的英国人，路径却相反：德雷克以'掠夺养测绘'——环球航行的科学成果由战利品付费，情报为打击服务；库克以'测绘养和平'——远征由皇家学会与海军供养，科学目的本身即任务。德雷克的图是进攻的底图，库克的图是安全的底图；一个把未知变成武器射程，一个把未知变成死亡率的下降——英国海权的两面（力量与知识）在他们身上各走到极致。
cross_references.description_en: Drake and Cook are the two Englishmen who made ocean voyaging scientific, by opposite roads: Drake with 'plunder paying for survey' — the science of the circumnavigation funded by prizes, intelligence serving attack; Cook with 'survey feeding peace' — expeditions financed by the Royal Society and the Admiralty, the scientific end the mission itself; Drake's charts are base maps of attack, Cook's of safety — one turning the unknown into weapon range, the other into falling mortality — the two faces of English sea power, force and knowledge, each carried to its extreme.

cross_references.description_zh: 德雷克与利德尔·哈特隔着三百年共享'间接路线'的根：哈特论证避开敌人最强正面、沿'抵抗力最小'的路线达成决定；德雷克用实践做了同一件事——不与无敌舰队在海上决战其最强的接舷战术，而烧其港口、断其白银、以射程与机动改写交战规则；哈特把'打击经济线'写成教义时举的历史例证正是德雷克式的破交战——一个把间接路线写成理论，一个把它提前三百年走成了惯例。
cross_references.description_en: Drake and Liddell Hart share, across three centuries, the root of the indirect approach: Hart argued for avoiding the enemy's strongest front and deciding along the line of least resistance; Drake practiced it — no decision battle against the Armada's strongest boarding tactics, but burned the port, cut the silver, and rewrote the rules of engagement with range and maneuver; when Hart made economic interdiction doctrine, Drake's kind of commerce war was his very example — one wrote the indirect approach as theory, the other walked it into custom three hundred years earlier.

cross_references.description_zh: 德雷克与孙武在'以迂为直'与'攻其必救'上隔代同声：孙子言'先知迂直之计者胜'、'攻其所必救'，德雷克一生都在打西班牙'必救'之处——珍宝航线是帝国必救的钱脉，加的斯是海军必救的母港；孙子的'因粮于敌'（取用于敌国）与德雷克的'以战养战'（缴获即给养）是同一条后勤定律在海陆两域的平行表述——两人都把后勤与经济线视为胜负的真正前线。
cross_references.description_en: Drake and Sun Wu speak across the ages on 'making the devious the direct' and 'attacking what must be rescued': Sun Tzu — victory to him who masters the devious and the direct, and strike where the enemy must hasten to save; Drake spent his life striking Spain's 'must-save' places — the treasure route the empire's lifeline, Cadiz its navy's home port; Sun Tzu's 'forage on the enemy' and Drake's 'live by plunder' are one law of logistics in two domains — both holding the economic line, not the battle line, to be the true front.

cross_references.description_zh: 孔子与澹台灭明是师徒关系中最著名的'误判-反转'案例：孔子以'状貌甚恶'判其材薄，又以'以言取人失之宰予，以貌取人失之子羽'自省——圣人亲自示范了识人的两种系统性偏差（言与貌）及其修正；澹台灭明则以受业不怨、退而修行回答了'被老师看走眼怎么办'——一方提供了误判的样本与自省的范式，一方提供了被误判者的最优响应；师徒二人共同构成了先秦'识人与被识'的完整教学案例。
cross_references.description_en: Confucius and Zantai Mieming form the most famous misjudgment-and-reversal case in the teacher-student record: the master judged him 'of slight ability' by his looks and then corrected himself — 'judging by speech, I lost Zai Yu; judging by looks, I lost Ziyu' — the sage personally demonstrating the two systematic biases of reading men, speech and face, and their amendment; Zantai answered 'what to do when your teacher misreads you' by taking his degree without resentment, withdrawing and cultivating; one side supplied the specimen of misjudgment and the paradigm of self-correction, the other the optimal response of the misjudged; together teacher and student compose the complete early-Chinese case study of judging and being judged.

cross_references.description_zh: 子游与澹台灭明是'识人于小节'的一对见证者与被见证者：子游治武城以弦歌，问属吏行事而得'行不由径，非公事不至偃室'之答——他是史上第一位从'两条路'里认出人才的长官；澹台灭明则是第一个把'小路上的表现'当作人格文件提交的人；孔门重'观过知仁'，两人把这一认识论落实为可操作的人事实践：长官看小路，属吏走大路——一次问答完成双向验证。
cross_references.description_en: Ziyou and Zantai Mieming are the witness and the witnessed of 'reading men in small ways': Ziyou governed Wucheng with strings and song, asked his subordinate how he conducted himself, and drew the answer 'never the shortcut, never save on official business' — the first governor on record to recognize talent from 'two roads'; Zantai was the first to submit the conduct of small paths as a document of character; the school held 'from a man's faults you may know his virtue,' and the two made that epistemology operational practice: the governor watches the small road, the subordinate walks the great one — one question and answer completing a two-way verification.

cross_references.description_zh: 澹台灭明与荀子同属儒家'制度化'路线的两端：荀子以'礼义非人格化'把德行转化为客观规范——以程式化约束替代个人品德依赖；澹台灭明以'设取予去就'把德行写成门人可执行的规程——把取、予、去、就四道关口预先立法；两人都拒绝把儒学停留在'圣贤临场表现'层面：一个向帝国输出制度，一个向三百弟子输出规程；先秦儒学'从德目到制度'的转化，在他们手中各完成一半。
cross_references.description_en: Zantai Mieming and Xunzi stand at two ends of Confucianism's 'institutional' line: Xunzi turned virtue into objective norms by the 'de-personalization of ritual and rightness' — programmatic constraint replacing reliance on personal character; Zantai wrote virtue into a code his disciples could execute — the four gates of taking, giving, going and staying legislated in advance; both refused to leave Confucianism at the level of the sage's live performance: one exported institutions to an empire, one exported rules to three hundred disciples; between them they each completed half of the school's transformation from virtue-items to institution.

cross_references.description_zh: 澹台灭明与董仲舒是儒学'南传/制度生根'的两端：董仲舒以天人三策把儒学立为汉代官学——由上而下的制度化；澹台灭明以'设取予去就'把儒学带进吴楚民间师门——由下而上的制度化；两人都相信儒学的生命力在'可执行的规程'而非'高悬的概念'：一个为朝廷立规范，一个为三百弟子立规矩；相隔四百年，共同证明同一命题：儒学每次扩张，都以把德行写成可操作文本为前提。
cross_references.description_en: Zantai Mieming and Dong Zhongshu are the two poles of Confucianism's spread and institutional rooting: Dong Zhongshu raised the learning to state doctrine of Han by the three memorial on heaven and man — institutionalization from above; Zantai carried it among the people of Wu and Chu, setting the code of taking, giving, going, staying for a school of three hundred — institutionalization from below; both believed the learning's vitality lay in executable rules, not suspended concepts: one wrote norms for a court, one rules for disciples; four centuries apart they prove one proposition — every expansion of Confucianism has been premised on writing virtue into an operational text.

cross_references.description_zh: 忽必烈与晏阳初是'外来者如何被乡土接受'的两端样本：晏阳初以平民教育进入定县乡村，先学习、再服务、后建设——用被接受换取改革的入场券；忽必烈以受'儒教大宗师'号、用《易经》定国号进入汉地士绅的意义系统——用对方的符号体系换取治理的入场券；两人都明白：改造者的合法性不是自封的，而是被改造对象授予的；一个是知识分子的乡土路径，一个是征服者的符号路径，共同命题是'先取得承认，再实施变革'。
cross_references.description_en: Kublai and James Yen are twin studies of how an outsider wins acceptance from the乡土: Yen entered Ding County's villages through mass education — learning first, serving next, building last — buying with acceptance the ticket to reform; Kublai entered the meaning-system of the Chinese gentry by accepting 'Patron-Master of the Ru' and naming his dynasty from the I Ching — buying with the other's symbols the ticket to govern; both understood that the reformer's legitimacy is not self-conferred but granted by the reformed: one the scholar's rural path, one the conqueror's symbolic path, the shared proposition 'recognition first, transformation after.'

cross_references.description_zh: 忽必烈与麦哲伦是'大空间治理'的一对对照：麦哲伦用船队把地球缝合为可通航的整体，忽必烈用驿路、运河与海运把帝国缝合为命令与物资可达的整体——两人都在解决同一个问题：如何让遥远的空间在物理上'跑得起来'；麦哲伦死于与 local 秩序的冲突，忽必烈则把 local 秩序（地方习俗、宗教、制度）设计进统治结构——一个是路线的完成者，一个是体系的建成者；大航海与大驿站是同一时代人类对'距离'的两份答卷。
cross_references.description_en: Kublai and Magellan are a matched pair on governing great space: Magellan stitched the globe into a navigable whole with his fleet, Kublai stitched his empire into a whole where commands and goods could physically run, with post roads, canals and sea routes — both solving one problem: how to make distant space physically run; Magellan died in collision with local orders, while Kublai designed local orders — custom, religion, institutions — into his structure of rule: one the finisher of a route, one the builder of a system; the great voyages and the great relays are the same age's two answers to distance.

cross_references.description_zh: 忽必烈与武则天是'合法性工程'的对照实验：武则天以佛教《大云经》为自己女身为帝制造神学依据——用异于主流的符号强行开辟正统；忽必烈以《易经》'大哉乾元'与'儒教大宗师'——用主流符号体系把自己'收编'进正统；两人都面对'身份与皇统不符'的根本难题，解法相反：一个改造符号体系以适应自己，一个改造自己以适应符号体系；改造者的成本更高但自主性更强，收编者成本更低但被体系约束——两种合法性策略的极限对照。
cross_references.description_en: Kublai and Wu Zetian form a controlled experiment in legitimacy engineering: Wu used the Buddhist Dayun jing to make theological ground for a woman on the throne — forging orthodoxy out of symbols alien to the mainstream; Kublai used the I Ching's 'great is the origin' and 'Patron-Master of the Ru' — filing himself into orthodoxy through the mainstream's own symbols; both faced the same root problem of an identity at odds with the imperial line, with opposite solutions: one remade the symbol system to fit herself, the other remade himself to fit the symbol system; the remaker pays more but keeps autonomy, the filer pays less but is bound by the system — the limiting contrast of two legitimacy strategies.

cross_references.description_zh: 忽必烈与郭守敬是'授权者与专业者'的黄金案例：郭守敬言'历之本在于测验'，忽必烈不干预技术方案，只提供设局、立官、拨费的制度保障——《授时历》与通惠河都是'专业者全权+授权者验收'的产物；忽必烈本人不通天文水利，但他为专业判断清除了决策之外的一切障碍；郭守敬提供了专业的深度，忽必烈提供了让专业得以完成的结构——中国科技史上最伟大的历法，是两种能力（专业与授权）各自做到极致的合成品。
cross_references.description_en: Kublai and Guo Shoujing are the golden case of granter and specialist: when Guo said 'the root of the calendar lies in observation,' Kublai touched no technical plan and supplied only the institutional guarantee — a bureau, an office, funds; the Shoushi calendar and the Tonghui Canal were both products of 'specialist in full charge, granter judging by acceptance'; Kublai knew no astronomy or hydraulics, yet cleared every obstacle beyond the professionals' decisions; Guo supplied the depth of expertise, Kublai the structure that let expertise finish — the greatest calendar in Chinese science is a compound of two capacities, the specialist's and the granter's, each carried to its extreme.

cross_references.description_zh: Phase26收尾整合与Phase25收尾整合是方法人格谱系的直接父子：P25F 在五条流水线时代确立了上下文隔离岗、指纹交付与纯增量过闸，P26F 在事故与并行密度更高的末期批次继承全部十法并新增身份锚定、前缀甄别与滚动基线——谱系的连续性靠 xref 显式指认，断代即缺陷。
cross_references.description_en: The Phase 26 closing integration is the direct child of the Phase 25's: where P25F, in the age of five pipelines, established the isolated post, the fingerprint delivery and the pure-increment gate, P26F, in a late batch of higher incident and parallel density, inherits all ten methods and adds the identity anchor, prefix discrimination and the rolling baseline — the lineage's continuity hangs on explicit xrefs; a broken generation is a defect.

cross_references.description_zh: P26F 对 P24F 是'验证与场景'两脉的直接延续：P24F 的收官审计法（验收与写入同事务周期）演化为 P26F 的独立复检法（从零另写脚本的验收岗），P24F 的场景锚定法（模式必须可运行）在 P26F 的场景试车法中加硬为'读者能照做'的写作标准——两代都相信：定义的完备性不可验证，可运行的验证才可验证。
cross_references.description_en: P26F continues two lines of P24F directly: P24F's closing audit (verification inside the write's transaction) evolves into P26F's independent re-check (an acceptance post writing its scripts from zero), and P24F's scenario anchoring (a mode must run) hardens in P26F's scenario running into the writing standard 'the reader can act on it' — both generations believe a definition's completeness cannot be verified, only the verifiable can be verified.

cross_references.description_zh: P23F 与 P26F 是方法人格谱系的两端同构：P23F 第一次把'让入库不撕裂的方法'当作人物挖掘（纯增量并库、双镜像同构、悬空清零在彼时确立），P26F 在第四代把这些方法当作理所当然的基线而把重心移向身份与并行——两代对照可见方法人格的演化方向：从'数据怎么进库'到'并行中谁在交付'。
cross_references.description_en: P23F and P26F are the two ends of the method-person lineage, isomorphic in form: P23F first mined 'the method that kept ingestion from tearing' as a figure (pure-increment merging, dual mirrors, zero dangling, all established then); P26F, fourth generation, takes those methods as baseline and moves the weight to identity and parallelism — the contrast shows the lineage's direction: from 'how data enters the library' to 'who is delivering amid the parallel.'

cross_references.description_zh: Phase26收尾整合的'身份锚定法'直接来自郭守敬卡的事故教训（t_4b51be46）：郭守敬研究卡误交付邻居 payload 的事件是本批次最痛的一课，教训文件的四条（身份核对、workspace 无隔离、大文件不做内联附件、complete 前终检）被铸成 P26F 的第一个模式——师承关系在此是字面意义的：学生模式由老师的教训写成。
cross_references.description_en: The Phase 26 closing integration's identity anchor descends literally from the Guo Shoujing card's lesson (t_4b51be46): the mis-delivery of a neighbor's payload was the batch's sharpest class, and the lessons file's four points — identity checks, unisolated workspaces, no inlined attachments, a final check before complete — are cast as P26F's first mode; the teacher-student relation here is literal: the student mode is written from the teacher's lesson.

cross_references.description_zh: 张载问'定性未能不动，犹累于外物'，程颢答以《定性书》
cross_references.description_en: Zhang Zai asked about settling nature; Cheng Hao replied with On Calming the Nature

cross_references.description_zh: 周敦颐令二程'寻孔颜乐处'，程颢答为'仁者浑然与物同体'
cross_references.description_en: Zhou Dunyi posed 'seek the joy of Confucius and Yan Hui'; Cheng Hao answered with oneness

cross_references.description_zh: 程颐与程颢同为理学奠基人，但路径不同：程颢以识仁为先、动亦定静亦定为工夫入口，重顿悟本体；程颐以主敬涵养、格物穷理为工夫路径，重渐进积累。朱熹评明道如大地，伊川如秋霜——明道气象宽平，伊川严肃精密。二人同以天理为核心，但工夫论迥异：明道重体认，伊川重积累。
cross_references.description_en: Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi are co-founders of Neo-Confucianism but differ in approach: Cheng Hao uses recognizing ren first and settled in motion and stillness as cultivation entry points, emphasizing sudden apprehension of the ground; Cheng Yi uses reverence-nurturing and investigating things to exhaust principle as the cultivation path, emphasizing gradual accumulation.

cross_references.description_zh: 二程少年时奉父命从周敦颐问学一年余。周敦颐令二程寻孔颜乐处，这一追问成为二程终身受用的根本问题。程颢答为仁者浑然与物同体，程颐则以性即理也回应。周敦颐的主静工夫被程颐翻转为{主敬}——静不再是特权状态，任何处境中皆可修养。
cross_references.description_en: The two Chengs studied under Zhou Dunyi for over a year in their youth. Zhou posed seek the joy of Confucius and Yan Hui, which became the fundamental question both brothers carried throughout life.

cross_references.description_zh: 程颐与张载的哲学争论：张载以太虚即气为本体论，程颐以性即理也为本体论。张载认为理是气的运行规律，程颐认为理是先于气的宇宙本体。这一争论影响了后世理气关系的讨论，成为宋明理学内部的重要分歧。
cross_references.description_en: The philosophical debate between Cheng Yi and Zhang Zai: Zhang Zai takes Tai Xu is qi as ontology; Cheng Yi takes nature is principle as ontology.

cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲对程朱理学的批判性继承：黄宗羲反对程朱理在气先的二元论，主张理在气中。但他继承了程颐格物穷理的方法论，将其发展为史料考辨法。黄宗羲的一本万殊法与程颐的理一分殊形成有趣的对话。
cross_references.description_en: Huang Zongxi's critical inheritance of Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism: Huang opposed Cheng-Zhu's dualism of principle prior to qi, advocating principle within qi.

cross_references.description_zh: 周敦颐与张载同处北宋理学奠基期：周以'无极而太极'的理本论图式立宇宙论总纲，张以'太虚即气'的气一元论立本体，二人共同奠定理学形上学格局。
cross_references.description_en: Zhou Dunyi and Zhang Zai both founded Neo-Confucian metaphysics: Zhou's 'Wuji er Taiji' gives a principle-based cosmology, Zhang's 'the Great Void is qi' a qi-monism ontology.

cross_references.description_zh: 程颢与其弟程颐少年时师事周敦颐，周令其'寻孔颜乐处'，这一设问直接塑造了程颢'仁者浑然与物同体'的境界追求。
cross_references.description_en: Cheng Hao and his brother Cheng Yi studied under Zhou Dunyi in youth; Zhou's charge to 'seek the joy of Confucius and Yan Hui' shaped Cheng Hao's teaching of oneness with all things.

cross_references.description_zh: 程颐受周敦颐'主静立人极'与'诚'论影响，将其发展为'主敬涵养'与'性即理'的工夫—本体体系，构成濂学向洛学的转进。
cross_references.description_en: Cheng Yi inherited Zhou's 'establishing the human ultimate through stillness' and his doctrine of sincerity, developing them into 'reverent cultivation' and 'nature is principle'.

cross_references.relation_note: 朱熹(1130-1200)为陆九渊(1139-1193)同时代人，此处为思想谱系对照
cross_references.description_zh: 陆九渊与朱熹同源而反：同承二程'天理'之教，朱熹把理放在事物之上而'即物穷理'，陆九渊把理收进本心而'心即理'。鹅湖之辩是这两条路线的公开交锋——尊德性（先立大本）对道问学（泛观博览）。二人终身相辩又终身相敬，朱晚年取陆之简易，陆后学则渐融于朱学，直到王阳明重新点燃象山之脉。
cross_references.description_en: Lu and Zhu share the Cheng lineage yet invert each other: Zhu locates principle in things and studies them outward, Lu gathers principle into the mind—'mind is principle.' The Goose Lake debate staged reverence-for-virtue against inquiry-and-study; they contested all their lives yet honored each other, until Wang Yangming rekindled the Xiangshan line.

cross_references.description_zh: 程颢'天理二字自家体贴出来'与'仁者浑然与物同体'为心学埋下伏笔：陆九渊把明道'体贴'的路径推到底——本体既在自家体贴处，则不必外索，'心即理'。朱熹尊明道而折向伊川，陆九渊则自认全接明道血脉；'尊德性/道问学'两脉在二程兄弟处已见分野。
cross_references.description_en: Cheng Hao's 'self-realized Tianli' and 'one body with all things' prefigure the School of Mind: Lu radicalizes the Mingdao path—since the root is self-attained, seek nothing outside, hence 'mind is principle.' Zhu followed Yichuan; Lu claimed Cheng Hao entire.

cross_references.description_zh: 董仲舒把真理的担保放在'天'——'道之大原出于天'，人须敬畏地顺应天道秩序；陆九渊把担保移入人心——'万物皆备于我'。同样是确立道德的客观性，一个向外立天以约束君权，一个向内立心以解放个体：中国思想中'外在超越'与'内在超越'的两种方案。
cross_references.description_en: Dong Zhongshu anchors truth in Heaven, restraining the ruler by an outer order; Lu anchors it in the mind—'all things are complete in me.' Outer transcendence versus inner transcendence: two Chinese solutions to securing morality.

cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲重'制度设计'与'学术史'（学校的议政功能、学案体的知识整理），王夫之重'形而上建构'与'历史哲学'（气一元论、理势合一）；黄是制度工程师，王是体系哲学家。
cross_references.description_en: Huang Zongxi stressed institutional design and intellectual history (deliberative schools, the juan'an genre), while Wang Fuzhi built metaphysics and philosophy of history (monism of qi, unity of principle and momentum). Huang was the institutional engineer; Wang the systematic philosopher.

cross_references.description_zh: 王夫之重'历史循环论'与'气一元论'的形而上建构，顾炎武重'实证考据'与'实地调研'的现实指向；王偏哲学思辨，顾偏方法工程与知识工程。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Fuzhi stressed the metaphysical construction of historical cycles and the monism of qi, while Gu Yanwu pursued evidential scholarship and field research. Wang inclined to philosophical speculation; Gu to method engineering and knowledge engineering.

cross_references.description_zh: 朱熹以「理」为超验本体、主张「存天理灭人欲」；戴震把「理」还原为情欲之条理、斥后儒之理为「以理杀人」。二人同释一「理」字，方向截然相反：朱是形上学的道德形制，戴是经验论的启蒙伦理。
cross_references.description_en: Zhu Xi made 'principle' a transcendent ontology and urged preserving heavenly principle while extinguishing human desire; Dai Zhen reduced principle to the ordered pattern of feeling and desire, denouncing the later Confucian 'principle' as 'killing by principle.' The same character, opposite directions: Zhu's metaphysical moral order versus Dai's empiricist enlightenment ethics.

cross_references.description_zh: 顾炎武开清代考据学之先河（'经学即理学'），戴震承其路数而登峰造极：把考据从方法论提升为哲学重建（由词通道），并使皖派考据规范（段玉裁、王念孙王引之）成为乾嘉学术的正统。
cross_references.description_en: Gu Yanwu pioneered Qing evidential scholarship ('classical learning is precisely the study of principle'); Dai Zhen inherited his path and brought it to its summit, elevating philology from method to philosophical reconstruction (from words to the Way), and making the Anhui-school standards the orthodoxy of Qianlong-Jiaqing learning.

cross_references.description_zh: 王夫之与戴震都重建理欲关系（'人欲之各得即天理之大同'与'理存于欲'），但路径不同：王以气学形上学历程抵达，戴以训诂考据的经验方法抵达——一为体系哲学，一为语言学论证的启蒙伦理。
cross_references.description_en: Both Wang Fuzhi and Dai Zhen rebuilt the principle-desire relation ('the due satisfaction of each desire is the great commonality of heavenly principle' vs. 'principle resides in desire'), but by different routes: Wang through qi-learning metaphysics, Dai through the empirical method of philology—one systematic philosophy, one enlightenment ethics argued linguistically.

cross_references.description_zh: 戴震由词通道（训诂明而后义理明），章学诚由史见道（六经皆史、道在事中）——同为反宋明空言之实证路线，戴自语言文字入，章自史事制度入，构成清代方法论双峰。
cross_references.description_en: Dai Zhen reaches the Way through words (philology first), Zhang Xuecheng through history (the classics are records of affairs) — both empirical anti-empty-talk routes, one via language, one via institutions. The two were rivals in life (Zhang criticized Dai's lexicon) yet twin peaks in method.

cross_references.description_zh: 顾炎武立考据学方法（音韵证经、采铜于山）而以经学为归；章学诚承浙东史学，以史学统经学，强调别识心裁与成一家之言——顾重功夫之实，章重别裁之神。
cross_references.description_en: Gu Yanwu founded evidential method subordinated to classical studies; Zhang, heir of the eastern-Zhejiang historiographical school, subsumes classics under history and prizes independent insight — Gu values laborious verification, Zhang creative synthesis.

cross_references.description_zh: 章学诚为浙东学派殿军，承黄宗羲「学必原本于经术」而后文史学一脉；黄创学案体以明学术流变，章以「辨章学术、考镜源流」将其升级为系统的知识谱系学。
cross_references.description_en: Zhang as the last master of the eastern-Zhejiang school inherits Huang Zongxi's union of classics and history; Huang's case-history genre is systematized by Zhang into a full genealogy of knowledge.

cross_references.description_zh: 曾子为孔子晚年弟子，亲受『吾道一以贯之』之教并以『忠恕而已矣』概括孔子之道；《论语》曾子诸章是其学说的直接文献来源。
cross_references.description_en: Zengzi was a late disciple of Confucius, receiving the teaching that the Way is one thread and summarizing it as loyalty and reciprocity; the Zengzi chapters of the Analects are the direct documentary source of his thought.

cross_references.description_zh: 传统道统谱系以曾子-子思-孟子相承（唐宋建构）；可考者为《史记》载孟子『受业子思之门人』（非亲授），直接师承为后世推定，本档已作归属标注。
cross_references.description_en: The traditional lineage runs Zengzi-Zisi-Mencius (a Tang-Song construct); what is documented is the Shiji record that Mencius studied under the disciples of Zisi (not directly). The direct link is a later inference, flagged in this file.

cross_references.description_zh: 朱熹《大学章句》以《大学》经文为『孔子之言而曾子述之』、传文为『曾子之意而门人记之』，并以《论语集注》《中庸章句序》塑造了曾子的道统位置——属传统归属，本档已标注为后世建构。
cross_references.description_en: The Zhu Xi commentary took the Great Learning classic text as the words of Confucius narrated by Zengzi and the commentaries as the meaning of Zengzi recorded by disciples, shaping his place in the lineage; a traditional attribution flagged here as a later construct.

cross_references.description_zh: 杨尚昆是毛泽东政治体制建设思想的重要执行者和党的组织工作核心人物
cross_references.description_en: Yang Shangkun was an important executor of Mao Zedong's political system construction thought and a core figure in party organizational work

cross_references.description_zh: 陈云侧重务实经济思维，纪弦侧重诗学现代性建构；前者面向经济建设实践，后者面向文学艺术革新。
钱学森与纪弦都追求传统与现代的融合，但钱学森的跨学科融合法侧重于科学知识整合，纪弦的'横的移植'侧重于文学艺术的现代主义借鉴。
陆一波的现代主义理论框架侧重系统整合与创新，纪弦的'六大信条'则聚焦于诗歌领域的现代主义实践；前者重理论建构的系统性，后者重诗学理念的纯粹性与革命性。
